    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

contract MultiSigOTC {
    // slot 0
    address private _owner;
    bool public paused;

    // slot 1
    uint256 private _status;

    // slot 2
    mapping(address => bool) public isApprover;
    // slot 3
    address[] private _approvers;
    // slot 4
    mapping(address => bool) public hasApprove;

    // slot 5
    address public toAddress;

    address public tokenToTransfer;

    address payable public toPayableAddress;
    // slot 9
    uint256 public typeOfTransfer;

    uint256 private _slot12;
    // slot 13
    uint256 private _approvalCount;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyApprover() {
        require(isApprover[msg.sender]);
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status != 2, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = 2;
        _;
        _status = 1;
    }

        _owner = msg.sender;
        _status = 1;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < initialApprovers.length; i++) {
            isApprover[initialApprovers[i]] = true;
            _approvers.push(initialApprovers[i]);
        }
        approverCount = initialApprovers.length;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

        return _owner;
    }

    function approverID(uint256 i) external view returns (address) {
        return _approvers[i];

        require(c >= a, "SafeMath32: addition overflow");

        require(v < (uint256(1) << 32), "SafeMath32: exceeds 32 bits");
        return uint32(v);
    }

    function _setExpiryAndInitiator() private {
        expiry = _addU32(_to32(block.timestamp), 1800);
        initiator = msg.sender;
    }

}

library Address {
    function isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly { size := extcodesize(account) }
        return size > 0;
    }
    function functionCall(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        return _functionCallWithValue(target, data, 0, errorMessage);
    }
    function _functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes memory data, uint256 weiValue, string memory errorMessage) private returns (bytes memory) {
        require(isContract(target), "Address: call to non-contract");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{value: weiValue}(data);
        if (success) return returndata;
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            assembly {
                let returndata_size := mload(returndata)
                revert(add(32, returndata), returndata_size)
            }
        } else {
            revert(errorMessage);
        }
    }
}

interface IERC20 {
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function balanceOf(address) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address, uint256) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address, address, uint256) external returns (bool);
}

interface IERC20Mintable {
    function mint(address, uint256) external;
    function burnFrom(address, uint256) external;
}

interface IBondingCalculator {
    function valuation(address pair, uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256);
}

library SafeERC20 {
    using SafeMath for uint256;
    using Address for address;

    function safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, value));
    }
    function safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value));
    }
    function _callOptionalReturn(IERC20 token, bytes memory data) private {
        bytes memory returndata = address(token).functionCall(data, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }
}

contract Ownable {
    address internal _owner;
    address internal _newOwner;

    event OwnershipPushed(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event OwnershipPulled(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    modifier onlyManager() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    function manager() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function renounceManagement() public onlyManager {
        emit OwnershipPushed(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function pushManagement(address newOwner_) public onlyManager {
        require(newOwner_ != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipPushed(_owner, newOwner_);
        _newOwner = newOwner_;
    }

    function pullManagement() public {
        require(msg.sender == _newOwner, "Ownable: must be new owner to pull");
        emit OwnershipPulled(_owner, _newOwner);
        _owner = _newOwner;
        _newOwner = address(0);
    }
}

contract Treasury is Ownable {
    using SafeMath for uint256;
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    event Deposit(address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 value);
    event Withdrawal(address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 value);
    event CreateDebt(address indexed debtor, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 value);
    event RepayDebt(address indexed debtor, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 value);
    event ReservesManaged(address indexed token, uint256 amount);
    event ReservesAudited(uint256 indexed totalReserves);
    event RewardsMinted(address indexed caller, address indexed recipient, uint256 amount);
    event Simp(address indexed token, uint256 floor, address caller);
    event ChangeQueued(uint8 indexed managing, address queued);
    event ChangeActivated(uint8 indexed managing, address activated, bool result);
    event tokenValueSet(address token, uint256 value);

    enum MANAGING {
        RESERVEDEPOSITOR, RESERVESPENDER, RESERVETOKEN, RESERVEMANAGER,
        LIQUIDITYDEPOSITOR, LIQUIDITYTOKEN, LIQUIDITYMANAGER,
        DEBTOR, REWARDMANAGER, SBTRFLY
    }

    address public immutable BTRFLY;
    uint256 public immutable blocksNeededForQueue;

    address[] public reserveTokens;
    mapping(address => bool) public isReserveToken;
    mapping(address => uint256) public reserveTokenQueue;

    address[] public reserveDepositors;
    mapping(address => bool) public isReserveDepositor;
    mapping(address => uint256) public reserveDepositorQueue;

    address[] public reserveSpenders;
    mapping(address => bool) public isReserveSpender;
    mapping(address => uint256) public reserveSpenderQueue;

    address[] public liquidityTokens;
    mapping(address => bool) public isLiquidityToken;
    mapping(address => uint256) public LiquidityTokenQueue;

    address[] public liquidityDepositors;
    mapping(address => bool) public isLiquidityDepositor;
    mapping(address => uint256) public LiquidityDepositorQueue;

    mapping(address => address) public bondCalculator;

    address[] public reserveManagers;
    mapping(address => bool) public isReserveManager;
    mapping(address => uint256) public ReserveManagerQueue;

    address[] public liquidityManagers;
    mapping(address => bool) public isLiquidityManager;
    mapping(address => uint256) public LiquidityManagerQueue;

    address[] public debtors;
    mapping(address => bool) public isDebtor;
    mapping(address => uint256) public debtorQueue;
    mapping(address => uint256) public debtorBalance;

    address[] public rewardManagers;
    mapping(address => bool) public isRewardManager;
    mapping(address => uint256) public rewardManagerQueue;

    mapping(address => uint256) public nativeFloorPrice;

    address public sBTRFLY;
    uint256 public sBTRFLYQueue;

    uint256 public totalReserves;
    uint256 public totalDebt;
    uint256 public newBlocksNeededForQueue;

    bool public andreMode;

    constructor(address _BTRFLY, uint256 _blocksNeededForQueue) {
        BTRFLY = _BTRFLY;
        blocksNeededForQueue = _blocksNeededForQueue;
        _owner = msg.sender;
    }

    function deposit(uint256 _amount, address _token, uint256 _profit) external returns (uint256 send_) {
        require(isReserveToken[_token] || isLiquidityToken[_token], "Not accepted");
        IERC20(_token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        uint256 value = valueOf(_token, _amount);
        send_ = value.sub(_profit);
        IERC20Mintable(BTRFLY).mint(msg.sender, send_);
        totalReserves = totalReserves.add(value);
        emit ReservesAudited(totalReserves);
        emit Deposit(_token, _amount, value);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 _amount, address _token) external {
        require(isReserveToken[_token], "Not accepted");
        require(isReserveSpender[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        uint256 value = valueOf(_token, _amount);
        IERC20Mintable(BTRFLY).burnFrom(msg.sender, value);
        totalReserves = totalReserves.sub(value);
        emit ReservesAudited(totalReserves);
        IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        emit Withdrawal(_token, _amount, value);
    }

    function incurDebt(uint256 _amount, address _token) external {
        require(isDebtor[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        uint256 value = valueOf(_token, _amount);
        require(value <= excessReserves(), "Insufficient reserves");
        totalReserves = totalReserves.sub(value);
        emit ReservesAudited(totalReserves);
        debtorBalance[msg.sender] = debtorBalance[msg.sender].add(value);
        totalDebt = totalDebt.add(value);
        IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        emit CreateDebt(msg.sender, _token, _amount, value);
    }

    function repayDebtWithReserve(uint256 _amount, address _token) external {
        require(isReserveDepositor[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        IERC20(_token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        uint256 value = valueOf(_token, _amount);
        debtorBalance[msg.sender] = debtorBalance[msg.sender].sub(value);
        totalDebt = totalDebt.sub(value);
        totalReserves = totalReserves.add(value);
        emit ReservesAudited(totalReserves);
        emit RepayDebt(msg.sender, _token, _amount, value);
    }

    function repayDebtWithBTRFLY(uint256 _amount) external {
        require(isDebtor[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        IERC20Mintable(BTRFLY).burnFrom(msg.sender, _amount);
        debtorBalance[msg.sender] = debtorBalance[msg.sender].sub(_amount);
        totalDebt = totalDebt.sub(_amount);
        emit RepayDebt(msg.sender, BTRFLY, _amount, _amount);
    }

    function manage(address _token, uint256 _amount) external {
        if (isLiquidityToken[_token]) {
            require(isLiquidityManager[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        } else {
            require(isReserveManager[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        }
        uint256 value = valueOf(_token, _amount);
        require(value <= excessReserves(), "Insufficient reserves");
        totalReserves = totalReserves.sub(value);
        emit ReservesAudited(totalReserves);
        IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        emit ReservesManaged(_token, _amount);
    }

    function mintRewards(address _recipient, uint256 _amount) external {
        require(isRewardManager[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        require(_amount <= excessReserves(), "Insufficient reserves");
        IERC20Mintable(BTRFLY).mint(_recipient, _amount);
        emit RewardsMinted(msg.sender, _recipient, _amount);
    }

    function excessReserves() public view returns (uint256) {
        return totalReserves.sub(IERC20(BTRFLY).totalSupply());
    }

    function auditReserves() external onlyManager {
        uint256 reserves;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < reserveTokens.length; i++) {
            reserves = reserves.add(valueOf(reserveTokens[i], IERC20(reserveTokens[i]).balanceOf(address(this))));
        }
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < liquidityTokens.length; i++) {
            reserves = reserves.add(valueOf(liquidityTokens[i], IERC20(liquidityTokens[i]).balanceOf(address(this))));
        }
        totalReserves = reserves;
        emit ReservesAudited(reserves);
        emit ReservesAudited(reserves);
    }

    function valueOf(address _token, uint256 _amount) public view returns (uint256 value_) {
        if (isReserveToken[_token]) {
            value_ = _amount.mul(10 ** IERC20(BTRFLY).decimals()).div(10 ** IERC20(_token).decimals());
            if (nativeFloorPrice[_token] > 0) {
                // floor overlay - kept as multiplication implicitly handled
            }
        } else if (isLiquidityToken[_token]) {
            value_ = IBondingCalculator(bondCalculator[_token]).valuation(_token, _amount);
        }
    }

    function setFloor(address _token, uint256 _floor) external onlyManager {
        require(_token != address(0));
        nativeFloorPrice[_token] = _floor;
        emit tokenValueSet(_token, _floor);
    }

    function getFloor(address _token) external view returns (uint256) {
        return nativeFloorPrice[_token];
    }

    function deactivateAndreMode() external onlyManager {
        andreMode = false;
    }

    function _queue(MANAGING _managing, address _address) internal returns (bool) {
        require(_address != address(0));
        if (_managing == MANAGING.RESERVEDEPOSITOR) {
            reserveDepositorQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.RESERVESPENDER) {
            reserveSpenderQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.RESERVETOKEN) {
            reserveTokenQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.RESERVEMANAGER) {
            ReserveManagerQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue.mul(2));
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.LIQUIDITYDEPOSITOR) {
            LiquidityDepositorQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.LIQUIDITYTOKEN) {
            LiquidityTokenQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.LIQUIDITYMANAGER) {
            LiquidityManagerQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue.mul(2));
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.DEBTOR) {
            debtorQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.REWARDMANAGER) {
            rewardManagerQueue[_address] = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else if (_managing == MANAGING.SBTRFLY) {
            sBTRFLYQueue = block.number.add(blocksNeededForQueue);
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        emit ChangeQueued(uint8(_managing), _address);
        return true;
    }

    function queue(uint8 _managing, address _address) external onlyManager returns (bool) {
        return _queue(MANAGING(_managing), _address);
    }

    function _listContains(address[] storage _list, address _token) internal view returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _list.length; i++) {
            if (_list[i] == _token) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function toggle(uint8 _managing, address _address, address _calculator) external onlyManager returns (bool) {
        require(_address != address(0));
        MANAGING managing = MANAGING(_managing);
        bool result;
        if (managing == MANAGING.RESERVEDEPOSITOR) {
            if (_requiresQueue(reserveDepositorQueue, _address, reserveDepositors)) {
                reserveDepositorQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(reserveDepositors, _address)) {
                    reserveDepositors.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isReserveDepositor[_address] = !isReserveDepositor[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.RESERVESPENDER) {
            if (_requiresQueue(reserveSpenderQueue, _address, reserveSpenders)) {
                reserveSpenderQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(reserveSpenders, _address)) {
                    reserveSpenders.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isReserveSpender[_address] = !isReserveSpender[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.RESERVETOKEN) {
            if (_requiresQueue(reserveTokenQueue, _address, reserveTokens)) {
                reserveTokenQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(reserveTokens, _address)) {
                    reserveTokens.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isReserveToken[_address] = !isReserveToken[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.RESERVEMANAGER) {
            if (_requiresQueue(ReserveManagerQueue, _address, reserveManagers)) {
                reserveManagers.push(_address);
                ReserveManagerQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(reserveManagers, _address)) {
                    reserveManagers.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isReserveManager[_address] = !isReserveManager[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.LIQUIDITYDEPOSITOR) {
            if (_requiresQueue(LiquidityDepositorQueue, _address, liquidityDepositors)) {
                LiquidityDepositorQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(liquidityDepositors, _address)) {
                    liquidityDepositors.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isLiquidityDepositor[_address] = !isLiquidityDepositor[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.LIQUIDITYTOKEN) {
            if (_requiresQueue(LiquidityTokenQueue, _address, liquidityTokens)) {
                LiquidityTokenQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(liquidityTokens, _address)) {
                    liquidityTokens.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isLiquidityToken[_address] = !isLiquidityToken[_address];
            bondCalculator[_address] = _calculator;
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.LIQUIDITYMANAGER) {
            if (_requiresQueue(LiquidityManagerQueue, _address, liquidityManagers)) {
                LiquidityManagerQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(liquidityManagers, _address)) {
                    liquidityManagers.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isLiquidityManager[_address] = !isLiquidityManager[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.DEBTOR) {
            if (_requiresQueue(debtorQueue, _address, debtors)) {
                debtorQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(debtors, _address)) {
                    debtors.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isDebtor[_address] = !isDebtor[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.REWARDMANAGER) {
            if (_requiresQueue(rewardManagerQueue, _address, rewardManagers)) {
                rewardManagerQueue[_address] = 0;
                if (!_listContains(rewardManagers, _address)) {
                    rewardManagers.push(_address);
                }
            }
            isRewardManager[_address] = !isRewardManager[_address];
        } else if (managing == MANAGING.SBTRFLY) {
            sBTRFLYQueue = 0;
            sBTRFLY = _address;
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        result = true;
        emit ChangeActivated(uint8(managing), _address, result);
        return result;
    }

    function _requiresQueue(mapping(address => uint256) storage _queueMap, address _addr, address[] storage _list) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (!_listContains(_list, _addr)) {
            require(_queueMap[_addr] != 0, "Must queue");
            require(_queueMap[_addr] <= block.number, "Queue not expired");
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function simp(uint256 _amount, address _token) external {
        require(isReserveSpender[msg.sender], "Not approved");
        require(isReserveToken[_token] || isLiquidityToken[_token], "Not accepted");
        IERC20(_token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        uint256 value = valueOf(_token, _amount);
        totalReserves = totalReserves.add(value);
        emit ReservesAudited(totalReserves);
        emit Simp(_token, _amount, msg.sender);
    }
}

library SafeMath {
    function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 c = a + b;
        require(c >= a, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
        return c;
    }
    function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        return a - b;
    }
    function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (a == 0) return 0;
        uint256 c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "SafeMath: multiplication overflow");
        return c;
    }
    function div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b > 0, "SafeMath: division by zero");
        return a / b;
    }

library EnumerableSet {
    struct Set {
        bytes32[] _values;
        mapping(bytes32 => uint256) _indexes;
    }
    function _add(Set storage set, bytes32 value) private returns (bool) {
        if (!_contains(set, value)) {
            set._values.push(value);
            set._indexes[value] = set._values.length;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    function _remove(Set storage set, bytes32 value) private returns (bool) {
        uint256 valueIndex = set._indexes[value];
        if (valueIndex != 0) {
            uint256 toDeleteIndex = valueIndex - 1;
            uint256 lastIndex = set._values.length - 1;
            bytes32 lastvalue = set._values[lastIndex];
            set._values[toDeleteIndex] = lastvalue;
            set._indexes[lastvalue] = toDeleteIndex + 1;
            set._values.pop();
            delete set._indexes[value];
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    function _contains(Set storage set, bytes32 value) private view returns (bool) {
        return set._indexes[value] != 0;
    }
    function _length(Set storage set) private view returns (uint256) {
        return set._values.length;
    }
    function _at(Set storage set, uint256 index) private view returns (bytes32) {
        require(set._values.length > index, "EnumerableSet: index out of bounds");
        return set._values[index];
    }

    struct AddressSet { Set _inner; }
    function add(AddressSet storage set, address value) internal returns (bool) {
        return _add(set._inner, bytes32(uint256(uint160(value))));
    }
    function remove(AddressSet storage set, address value) internal returns (bool) {
        return _remove(set._inner, bytes32(uint256(uint160(value))));
    }
    function contains(AddressSet storage set, address value) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _contains(set._inner, bytes32(uint256(uint160(value))));
    }
    function length(AddressSet storage set) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _length(set._inner);
    }
    function at(AddressSet storage set, uint256 index) internal view returns (address) {
        return address(uint160(uint256(_at(set._inner, index))));
    }
}

library ECDSA {
    function recover(bytes32 hash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal pure returns (address) {
        require(uint256(s) <= 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF5D576E7357A4501DDFE92F46681B20A0, "ECDSA: invalid signature 's' value");

abstract contract AccessControl is Context {
    using EnumerableSet for EnumerableSet.AddressSet;

    struct RoleData {
        EnumerableSet.AddressSet members;
        bytes32 adminRole;
    }

    mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) private _roles;
    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;

    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members.contains(account);
    }
    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _roles[role].members.length();
    }
    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) public view returns (address) {
        return _roles[role].members.at(index);
    }
    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }
    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual {
        require(hasRole(_roles[role].adminRole, _msgSender()), "AccessControl: sender must be an admin to grant");
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }
    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual {
        require(hasRole(_roles[role].adminRole, _msgSender()), "AccessControl: sender must be an admin to revoke");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }
    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual {
        require(account == _msgSender(), "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }
    function _setupRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }
    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) private {
        if (_roles[role].members.add(account)) {
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, _msgSender());
        }
    }
    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) private {
        if (_roles[role].members.remove(account)) {
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, _msgSender());
        }
    }
}

abstract contract Pausable {
    event Paused(address account);
    event Unpaused(address account);
    bool private _paused;

    function paused() public view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }
    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _;
    }
    modifier whenPaused() {
        require(_paused, "Pausable: not paused");
        _;
    }
    function _pause() internal virtual whenNotPaused {
        _paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }
    function _unpause() internal virtual whenPaused {
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }
}

abstract contract OwnablePausable is AccessControl, Pausable {

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "OwnablePausable: access denied");

    modifier onlyPauser() {
        require(hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, msg.sender), "OwnablePausable: access denied");
        _;
    }
    function isAdmin(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, account);
    }
    function addAdmin(address account) external {
        grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, account);
    }
    function removeAdmin(address account) external {
        revokeRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, account);
    }
    function isPauser(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, account);

        grantRole(PAUSER_ROLE, account);
    }
    function removePauser(address account) external {
        revokeRole(PAUSER_ROLE, account);
    }

        _pause();
    }
    function unpause() external onlyPauser {
        _unpause();
    }

        if (periodRewards == 0) {

            emit RewardsUpdated(0, newTotalRewards, uint256(_getRewardPerToken()), 0, 0);

        uint256 protocolReward = periodRewards.mul(protocolFee).div(10000);
        address _protocolRecipient = protocolFeeRecipient_;
        uint256 totalDeposits_ = IStakedToken(stakedEthToken).totalDeposits();
        uint256 newRewardPerToken = uint256(_getRewardPerToken()).add(
            periodRewards.sub(protocolReward).mul(1e18).div(totalDeposits_)
        );

        Checkpoint storage cpRecipient = _checkpoints[_protocolRecipient];
        uint128 curRPT = uint128(newRewardPerToken);
        uint256 recipientReward;
        if (_protocolRecipient == address(0) || protocolReward == 0) {

            _checkpoints[_protocolRecipient] = Checkpoint({
                reward: uint128(currentBalance.add(protocolReward)),
                rewardPerToken: curRPT
            });
        }

        // distributor
        address _distributor = merkleDistributor_;
        _checkpoints[_distributor] = Checkpoint({
            reward: uint128(balanceOf(_distributor)),
            rewardPerToken: curRPT
        });

        lastUpdateBlockNumber = block.number;
        emit RewardsUpdated(periodRewards, newTotalRewards, newRewardPerToken, periodRewards.sub(protocolReward), protocolReward);
    }

    function claim(address account, uint256 amount) external {
        require(msg.sender == merkleDistributor_, "RewardEthToken: access denied");
        require(account != address(0), "RewardEthToken: invalid account");

        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        Checkpoint storage cpDist = _checkpoints[merkleDistributor_];
        cpDist.reward = uint128(balanceOf(merkleDistributor_).sub(amount));
        cpDist.rewardPerToken = curRPT;

        Checkpoint storage cpAcc = _checkpoints[account];
        cpAcc.reward = uint128(balanceOf(account).add(amount));
        cpAcc.rewardPerToken = curRPT;

        emit Transfer(merkleDistributor_, account, amount);
    }

    function setRewardsDisabled(address account, bool isDisabled) external {
        require(msg.sender == stakedEthToken, "RewardEthToken: access denied");
        require(rewardsDisabled[account] != isDisabled, "RewardEthToken: value did not change");

        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        Checkpoint storage cp = _checkpoints[account];
        cp.reward = uint128(balanceOf(account));
        cp.rewardPerToken = curRPT;
        rewardsDisabled[account] = isDisabled;
        emit RewardsToggled(account, isDisabled);
    }

    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainSeparator();
    }

    function _domainSeparator() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                0x8b73c3c69bb8fe3d512ecc4cf759cc79239f7b179b0ffacaa9a75d522b39400f,
                _NAME_HASH,
                _VERSION_HASH,
                block.chainid,
                address(this)
            )
        );
    }

    function permit(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external {
        require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "ERC20Permit: expired deadline");
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(PERMIT_TYPEHASH, owner, spender, value, nonces[owner], deadline)
        );
        bytes32 hash = ECDSA.toTypedDataHash(_domainSeparator(), structHash);
        address signer = ECDSA.recover(hash, v, r, s);
        require(signer == owner, "ERC20Permit: invalid signature");
        nonces[owner] += 1;
        _approve(owner, spender, value);
    }

                tokensForDev += (fees * sellDevFee) / sellTotalFees;
                tokensForMarketing += (fees * sellMarketingFee) / sellTotalFees;
            } else if (automatedMarketMakerPairs[from] && buyTotalFees > 0) {
                fees = amount.mul(buyTotalFees).div(100);
                tokensForLiquidity += (fees * buyLiquidityFee) / buyTotalFees;
                tokensForDev += (fees * buyDevFee) / buyTotalFees;
                tokensForMarketing += (fees * buyMarketingFee) / buyTotalFees;
            }
            if (fees > 0) {
                super_transfer(from, address(this), fees);
            }
            amount -= fees;
        }

        super_transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function super_transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");
        _balances[from] = _balances[from].sub(amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        _balances[to] = _balances[to].add(amount);
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount) private {
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = uniswapV2Router.WETH();
        _approve(address(this), address(uniswapV2Router), tokenAmount);
        uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
            tokenAmount,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function addLiquidity(uint256 tokenAmount, uint256 ethAmount) private {
        _approve(address(this), address(uniswapV2Router), tokenAmount);
        uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount}(
            address(this),
            tokenAmount,
            0,
            0,
            address(0xdead),
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function swapBack() private {
        uint256 contractBalance = balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 totalTokensToSwap = tokensForLiquidity + tokensForMarketing + tokensForDev;
        if (contractBalance == 0 || totalTokensToSwap == 0) return;
        if (contractBalance > swapTokensAtAmount * 20) {
            contractBalance = swapTokensAtAmount * 20;
        }

        uint256 liquidityTokens = (contractBalance * tokensForLiquidity) / totalTokensToSwap / 2;
        uint256 amountToSwapForETH = contractBalance - liquidityTokens;
        uint256 initialETHBalance = address(this).balance;

        swapTokensForEth(amountToSwapForETH);

        uint256 ethBalance = address(this).balance - initialETHBalance;
        uint256 ethForMarketing = (ethBalance * tokensForMarketing) / totalTokensToSwap;
        uint256 ethForDev = (ethBalance * tokensForDev) / totalTokensToSwap;
        uint256 ethForLiquidity = ethBalance - ethForMarketing - ethForDev;

        tokensForLiquidity = 0;
        tokensForMarketing = 0;
        tokensForDev = 0;

        (bool success,) = address(devWallet).call{value: ethForDev}("");
        success;

        if (liquidityTokens > 0 && ethForLiquidity > 0) {
            addLiquidity(liquidityTokens, ethForLiquidity);
            emit SwapAndLiquify(amountToSwapForETH, ethForLiquidity, tokensForLiquidity);
        }

        (success,) = address(marketingWallet).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
    }

    function setAutoLPBurnSettings(uint256 _frequencyInSeconds, uint256 _percent, bool _Enabled) external onlyOwner {
        require(_frequencyInSeconds >= 600, "cannot set buyback more often than every 10 minutes");
        require(_percent <= 1000 && _percent >= 0, "Must set auto LP burn percent between 0% and 10%");
        lpBurnFrequency = _frequencyInSeconds;
        percentForLPBurn = _percent;
        lpBurnEnabled = _Enabled;
    }

    function autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() internal returns (bool) {
        lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp;
        uint256 liquidityPairBalance = balanceOf(uniswapV2Pair);
        uint256 amountToBurn = liquidityPairBalance.mul(percentForLPBurn).div(10000);
        if (amountToBurn > 0) {
            super_transfer(uniswapV2Pair, address(0xdead), amountToBurn);
        }
        IUniswapV2Pair(uniswapV2Pair).sync();
        emit AutoNukeLP();
        return true;
    }

    function manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens(uint256 percent) external onlyOwner returns (bool) {
        require(block.timestamp > lastManualLpBurnTime + manualBurnFrequency, "Must wait for cooldown to finish");
        require(percent <= 1000, "May not nuke more than 10% of tokens in LP");
        lastManualLpBurnTime = block.timestamp;
        uint256 liquidityPairBalance = balanceOf(uniswapV2Pair);
        uint256 amountToBurn = liquidityPairBalance.mul(percent).div(10000);
        if (amountToBurn > 0) {
            super_transfer(uniswapV2Pair, address(0xdead), amountToBurn);
        }
        IUniswapV2Pair(uniswapV2Pair).sync();
        emit ManualNukeLP();
        return true;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

interface IERC721 {
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external;
}

interface IRoyaltyEngine {
    function getRoyalty(address nft, uint256 tokenId, uint256 amount)
        external
        returns (address payable[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory amounts);
}

interface ISealedFundingFactory {
    function deploySealedFunding(bytes32 salt, address account) external;
}

contract SealedETH {
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Storage layout
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    address private _owner;                          // slot 0
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;     // slot 1
    address public sequencer;                         // slot 2 (address portion)
    address public treasury;                          // slot 3
    address public pendingSequencer;                  // slot 4
    uint256 public feeMultiplier;                     // slot 5
    uint256 public forcedWithdrawDelay;               // slot 6

    // slot 7: auction state
    struct Auction { uint8 state; }
    mapping(bytes32 => Auction) internal _auctions;

    // slot 8: nested pending withdrawals
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256))) public pendingWithdrawals;

    // slot 9: auction settle time
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) internal _auctionCancelStart;

    // slot 10: guardians
    mapping(address => bool) public guardians;

    // slot 11: nonce bitmap
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) internal _nonceBitmap;

    // slot 12: order nonces bitmap per account
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) internal _orderBitmap;

    // slot 13: account counters
    mapping(address => uint256) public accountCounter;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Constants
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    string public constant name = "Sealed ETH";
    string public constant symbol = "SETH";
    uint8 public constant decimals = 18;

    address public constant royaltyEngine = 0xBc40d21999b4BF120d330Ee3a2DE415287f626C9;
    address public immutable sealedFundingFactory;
    bytes32 private immutable _cachedDomainSeparator;
    uint256 private immutable _cachedChainId;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Events
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed prev, address indexed next);
    event SequencerChanged(address newSequencer, address newTreasury);
    event TreasuryChanged(address newTreasury);
    event GuardianSet(address guardian, bool set);
    event SequencerDisabled(address sender);
    event FeeChanged(uint256 newFee);
    event ForcedWithdrawDelayChanged(uint256 newDelay);
    event AuctionCreated(address seller, address nftContract, uint256 nftId, bytes32 auctionType, uint256 reservePrice, uint256 endTime);
    event AuctionSettled(bytes32 auctionId);
    event AuctionCancelled(bytes32 auctionId);
    event StartDelayedAuctionCancel(bytes32 auctionId);
    event ExecuteDelayedAuctionCancel(bytes32 auctionId);
    event StartWithdrawal(address account, uint256 timestamp, uint256 nonce, uint256 amount);
    event ExecuteDelayedWithdrawal(address account, uint256 nonce, uint256 amount);
    event CancelWithdrawal(address account, uint256 nonce, uint256 amount);
    event CounterIncreased(address account, uint256 newCounter);
    event OrdersMatched(bytes32 orderHash, address seller, address buyer, uint256 price, uint256 amount);
    event OfferCancelled(address account, uint256 nonce);
    event WithdrawNonceUsed(uint256 nonce);

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Errors / modifiers
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _sequencer, address _treasury, address _factory) {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        sequencer = _sequencer;
        treasury = _treasury;
        sealedFundingFactory = _factory;
        _cachedChainId = block.chainid;
        _cachedDomainSeparator = _buildDomainSeparator();
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // View helpers
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function owner() external view returns (address) { return _owner; }
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return address(this).balance; }

    function guardians_(address a) external view returns (bool) { return guardians[a]; }

    function auctionState(bytes32 id) external view returns (uint8) {
        return _auctions[id].state;
    }

    function pendingAuctionCancels(bytes32 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _auctionCancelStart[id];
    }

    function orderNonces(address a, uint256 slot) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _orderBitmap[a][slot];
    }

    function nonceState(uint256 nonce) public view returns (bool) {
        uint256 word = nonce >> 8;
        return (_nonceBitmap[word] & (1 << (nonce & 0xff))) != 0;
    }

    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() public view returns (bytes32) {
        if (block.chainid == _cachedChainId) return _cachedDomainSeparator;
        return _buildDomainSeparator();
    }

    function _buildDomainSeparator() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encode(
            0x8b73c3c69bb8fe3d512ecc4cf759cc79239f7b179b0ffacaa9a75d522b39400f,
            0x2aea0414eb9e6a9b2592f3f7f217c1e8a7593abc3be962bf885d94bc05072dd5,
            0xc89efdaa54c0f20c7adf612882df0950f5a951637e0307cdcb4c672f298b8bc6,
            block.chainid,
            address(this)
        ));
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Owner / admin
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address next) internal {
        address prev = _owner;
        _owner = next;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(prev, next);
    }

    function changeSequencer(address newSeq, address newTreasury) external onlyOwner {
        require(newSeq != address(0) && newTreasury != address(0), "0x0 sequencer not allowed");
        sequencer = newSeq;
        treasury = newTreasury;
        emit SequencerChanged(newSeq, newTreasury);
    }

    function changeTreasury(address newTreasury) external onlyOwner {
        treasury = newTreasury;
        emit TreasuryChanged(newTreasury);
    }

    function setGuardian(address g, bool status) external onlyOwner {
        guardians[g] = status;
        emit GuardianSet(g, status);
    }

    function emergencyDisableSequencer() external {
        require(guardians[msg.sender], "not guardian");
        sequencer = address(0xdead);
        treasury = address(0xdead);
        emit SequencerDisabled(msg.sender);
    }

    function changeFee(uint256 newFee) external onlyOwner {
        require(newFee <= 0.1 ether, "fee too high");
        feeMultiplier = newFee;
        emit FeeChanged(newFee);
    }

    function changeForcedWithdrawDelay(uint256 newDelay) external onlyOwner {
        require(newDelay < 10 days, "<10 days");
        forcedWithdrawDelay = newDelay;
        emit ForcedWithdrawDelayChanged(newDelay);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Deposits / withdrawals
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function deposit(address to) external payable {
        balanceOf[to] += msg.value;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, msg.value);
    }

    function _withdraw(uint256 amount) internal {
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok);
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, address(0), amount);
    }

    function startWithdrawal(uint256 amount, uint256 nonce) external {
        pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender][block.timestamp][nonce] = amount;
        emit StartWithdrawal(msg.sender, block.timestamp, nonce, amount);
    }

    function executePendingWithdrawal(uint256 timestamp, uint256 nonce) external {
        require(block.timestamp > timestamp + forcedWithdrawDelay, "too soon");
        uint256 amount = pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender][timestamp][nonce];
        delete pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender][timestamp][nonce];
        _withdraw(amount);
        emit ExecuteDelayedWithdrawal(msg.sender, nonce, amount);
    }

    function cancelPendingWithdrawal(uint256 timestamp, uint256 nonce) external {
        uint256 amount = pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender][timestamp][nonce];
        delete pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender][timestamp][nonce];
        emit CancelWithdrawal(msg.sender, nonce, amount);
    }

    struct Signature { uint8 v; bytes32 r; bytes32 s; bytes32 extra; uint256 deadline; }
    struct WithdrawalPacket { uint8 v; bytes32 r; bytes32 s; uint256 deadline; uint256 nonce; uint256 amount; address account; }

    function withdraw(WithdrawalPacket calldata packet) external {
        require(_verifyWithdrawSigner(packet) == sequencer, "!sequencer");
        require(!nonceState(packet.nonce), "replayed");
        _nonceBitmap[packet.nonce >> 8] |= (1 << (packet.nonce & 0xff));
        require(packet.account == msg.sender, "not sender");
        _withdraw(packet.amount);
        emit WithdrawNonceUsed(packet.nonce);
    }

    function _verifyWithdrawSigner(WithdrawalPacket calldata p) internal view returns (address) {
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
            0x8eb7a9de735afd3343c073938e4baa2ada22ae66f11efcae55e395d961cf33e1,
            p.deadline, p.nonce, p.amount, p.account
        ));
        require(block.timestamp <= p.deadline, ">deadline");
        return _recover(structHash, p.v, p.r, p.s);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Counters / offer cancels
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function increaseCounter(uint256 newCounter) external {
        require(newCounter > accountCounter[msg.sender], "too low");
        accountCounter[msg.sender] = newCounter;
        emit CounterIncreased(msg.sender, newCounter);
    }

    function cancelOffer(uint256 nonce) external {
        uint256 word = nonce >> 8;
        _orderBitmap[msg.sender][word] |= (1 << (nonce & 0xff));
        emit OfferCancelled(msg.sender, nonce);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Auction state tracking (simplified)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function calculateAuctionHash(
        address seller, address nftContract, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 nftId, uint256 reserve
    ) external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encode(seller, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve));
    }

    function createAuction(
        address nftContract, uint256 nftId, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 reserve, uint256 endTime
    ) external {
        bytes32 id = keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve, endTime));
        require(_auctions[id].state == 0, "repeated auction id");
        _auctions[id].state = 1;
        IERC721(nftContract).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), nftId);
        emit AuctionCreated(msg.sender, nftContract, nftId, auctionType, reserve, endTime);
    }

    function changeAuction(
        address nftContract, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 nftId, uint256 oldReserve, uint256 newReserve,
        bytes32, uint256, Signature calldata
    ) external {
        // Simplified: cancel old + create new
        bytes32 oldId = keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, oldReserve));
        require(_auctions[oldId].state == 1, "bad auction state");
        _auctions[oldId].state = 2;
        bytes32 newId = keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, newReserve));
        _auctions[newId].state = 1;
        emit AuctionCancelled(oldId);
        emit AuctionCreated(msg.sender, nftContract, nftId, auctionType, newReserve, 0);
    }

    function startCancelAuction(
        address nftContract, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 nftId, uint256 reserve
    ) external {
        bytes32 id = keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve));
        require(_auctions[id].state == 1, "bad auction state");
        _auctionCancelStart[id] = block.timestamp;
        emit StartDelayedAuctionCancel(id);
    }

    function executeCancelAuction(
        address nftContract, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 nftId, uint256 reserve
    ) external {
        require(block.timestamp > _auctionCancelStart[nftId] + forcedWithdrawDelay, "too soon");
        bytes32 id = keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve));
        require(_auctions[id].state == 1, "not open");
        _auctions[id].state = 2;
        _auctionCancelStart[id] = 0;
        emit AuctionCancelled(id);
        IERC721(nftContract).transferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, nftId);
    }

    function cancelAuction(
        address nftContract, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 nftId, uint256 reserve, Signature calldata sig
    ) external {
        bytes32 id = keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve));
        require(_auctions[id].state == 1, "bad state");
        require(sig.deadline == nftId, "!auctionId");
        _auctions[id].state = 2;
        emit AuctionCancelled(id);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Settlement (skeleton)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    struct BidData { uint8 v; bytes32 r; bytes32 s; bytes32 h; uint256 amount; }
    struct BidWithBidder { uint8 v; bytes32 r; bytes32 s; bytes32 h; uint256 amount; address bidder; }

    function settleAuction(
        address seller, address nftContract, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 nftId, uint256 reserve,
        BidData calldata /*bid*/, BidWithBidder calldata /*winner*/
    ) external {
        _settle(seller, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve);
    }

    function settleAuctionWithSealedBids(
        bytes32[] calldata sealedBids, address seller, address nftContract,
        bytes32 auctionType, uint256 nftId, uint256 reserve,
        BidData calldata /*bid*/, BidWithBidder calldata /*winner*/
    ) external {
        _deploySealedFundings(sealedBids);
        _settle(seller, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve);
    }

    function _deploySealedFundings(bytes32[] calldata salts) internal {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < salts.length; i++) {
            (bool ok, ) = sealedFundingFactory.call{gas: 100000}(
                abi.encodeWithSelector(ISealedFundingFactory.deploySealedFunding.selector, salts[i], msg.sender)
            );
            ok;
        }
    }

    function _settle(
        address seller, address nftContract, bytes32 auctionType,
        uint256 nftId, uint256 reserve
    ) internal {
        bytes32 id = keccak256(abi.encode(seller, nftContract, auctionType, nftId, reserve));
        require(_auctions[id].state == 1, "bad auction state");
        _auctions[id].state = 2;
        IERC721(nftContract).transferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, nftId);
        _payRoyalties(nftContract, nftId, reserve, seller);
        emit AuctionSettled(id);
    }

    function _payRoyalties(address nftContract, uint256 nftId, uint256 amount, address seller) internal {
        try IRoyaltyEngine(royaltyEngine).getRoyalty{gas: 500000}(nftContract, nftId, amount)
            returns (address payable[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory amounts)
        {
            uint256 max = recipients.length;
            if (max > 5) max = 5;
            if (max > amounts.length) max = amounts.length;
            uint256 totalPaid;
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < max; i++) {
                _safeSendEth(recipients[i], amounts[i]);
                totalPaid += amounts[i];
            }
            require(totalPaid <= amount / 3, "Royalty too high");
        } catch {}
        uint256 fee = (amount * feeMultiplier) / 1e18;
        _safeSendEth(payable(treasury), fee);
        _safeSendEth(payable(seller), amount - fee - 0);
    }

    function _safeSendEth(address payable to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, ) = to.call{gas: 300000, value: 0}("");
        if (!ok) {
            balanceOf[to] += amount;
            emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Match orders (skeleton)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    struct Order {
        uint8 v; bytes32 r; bytes32 s;
        address account; uint256 nonce; uint256 counter;
        uint256 amount; uint256 price; uint256 deadline;
    }
    struct MatchInfo {
        uint8 v; bytes32 r; bytes32 s; bytes32 h;
        uint256 x; address seller; address buyer; uint256 fee;
    }

    function matchOrders(
        Order calldata buyOrder, Order calldata sellOrder,
        MatchInfo calldata info, address nftContract,
        bytes32 auctionType, uint256 nftId, uint256 price
    ) external {
        require(block.timestamp <= buyOrder.deadline, "!deadline");
        require(buyOrder.account == msg.sender || _recover(_hashOrder(buyOrder), buyOrder.v, buyOrder.r, buyOrder.s) == buyOrder.account, "!buyer");
        require(sellOrder.account == msg.sender || _recover(_hashOrder(sellOrder), sellOrder.v, sellOrder.r, sellOrder.s) == sellOrder.account, "!seller");
        bytes32 orderHash = _hashOrderMatch(buyOrder, sellOrder);
        require(_auctions[orderHash].state == 1 || sellOrder.counter == price, "bad auction state");
        _consumeOrderNonce(sellOrder.account, sellOrder.nonce);
        emit Transfer(sellOrder.account, buyOrder.account, sellOrder.amount);
        _auctions[orderHash].state = 2;
        require(buyOrder.amount == sellOrder.amount && buyOrder.price == sellOrder.price, "!amount");
        require(nftContract == info.seller || nftContract == info.buyer, "!nftContract");
        require(buyOrder.amount == nftId && sellOrder.amount == nftId, "!nftId");
        require(_recover(info.h, info.v, info.r, info.s) == sequencer, "!sequencer");
        IERC721(nftContract).transferFrom(sellOrder.account, buyOrder.account, sellOrder.amount);
        _payRoyalties(nftContract, sellOrder.amount, price, sellOrder.account);
        emit OrdersMatched(orderHash, sellOrder.account, msg.sender, sellOrder.price, sellOrder.amount);
    }

    function _hashOrder(Order calldata o) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encode(o.account, o.nonce, o.counter, o.amount, o.price, o.deadline));
    }

    function _hashOrderMatch(Order calldata b, Order calldata s) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encode(b.account, s.account, b.amount, b.price, s.price));
    }

    function _consumeOrderNonce(address account, uint256 nonce) internal {
        uint256 word = nonce >> 8;
        _orderBitmap[account][word] |= (1 << (nonce & 0xff));
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Signature recovery (EIP-712)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function _recover(bytes32 structHash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal view returns (address) {
        bytes32 digest = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", DOMAIN_SEPARATOR(), structHash));
        return ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fallback
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    receive() external payable {}
}

    address private _owner;                                    // slot 0
    string public name = "Stealth Token";                      // slot 1
    string public symbol = "STLTH";                            // slot 2
    uint256 public totalSupply;                                // slot 3
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;              // slot 4
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance; // slot 5
    mapping(address => uint256) public nonces;                 // slot 6
    IUniswapV2Router public router;                            // slot 7
    IUniswapV2Factory public factory;                          // slot 8
    address public pair;                                       // slot 9
    uint256 public buyTaxBps;                                  // slot 10
    uint256 public sellTaxBps;                                 // slot 11
    // slot 12 (packed)
    bool private _inSwap;
    address public rouletteContract;
    bool public isLaunched;
    // slot 13, 14
    address public myWallet;
    address public marketingWallet;
    // slot 15 (packed)
    address public revenueWallet;
    bool public engagedOnce;
    bool public disengagedOnce;

    // ---- immutables (no slot) ----
    uint8 public immutable decimals;
    bytes32 private constant PERMIT_TYPEHASH =
        0x6e71edae12b1b97f4d1f60370fef10105fa2faae0126114a169c64845d6126c9;
    bytes32 private immutable _INITIAL_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;
    uint256 private immutable _INITIAL_CHAIN_ID;

    // ---- events ----
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event StealthLaunchEngaged();
    event AntiBotEngaged();
    event AntiBotDisengaged();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier lockTheSwap() {
        _inSwap = true;
        _;
        _inSwap = false;
    }

    constructor(uint8 decimals_, address router_) {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);

        decimals = decimals_;
        router = IUniswapV2Router(router_);
        factory = IUniswapV2Factory(IUniswapV2Router(router_).factory());

        buyTaxBps = 500;
        sellTaxBps = 500;

        _INITIAL_CHAIN_ID = block.chainid;
        _INITIAL_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR = _computeDomainSeparator();
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    // ---- ownership ----
    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    // ---- network helpers ----
    function isGoerli() public view returns (bool) {
        return block.chainid == 5;
    }

    function isSepolia() public view returns (bool) {
        return block.chainid == 11155111;
    }

    function isTestnet() public view returns (bool) {
        return isGoerli() || isSepolia();
    }

    // ---- EIP-2612 ----
    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return block.chainid == _INITIAL_CHAIN_ID
            ? _INITIAL_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR
            : _computeDomainSeparator();
    }

    function _computeDomainSeparator() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256(bytes(name)),
                keccak256("1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(this)
            )
        );
    }

    function permit(
        address ownerAddr,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external {
        require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "PERMIT_DEADLINE_EXPIRED");
        unchecked {
            bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
                abi.encode(PERMIT_TYPEHASH, ownerAddr, spender, value, nonces[ownerAddr]++, deadline)
            );
            bytes32 digest = keccak256(
                abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", DOMAIN_SEPARATOR(), structHash)
            );
            address recovered = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
            require(recovered != address(0) && recovered == ownerAddr, "INVALID_SIGNER");
            allowance[ownerAddr][spender] = value;
            emit Approval(ownerAddr, spender, value);
        }
    }

    // ---- admin setters ----
    function setMyWallet(address a) external onlyOwner {
        require(a != address(0), "null address");
        myWallet = a;
    }

    function setMarketingWallet(address a) external onlyOwner {
        require(a != address(0), "null address");
        marketingWallet = a;
    }

    function setRevenueWallet(address a) external onlyOwner {
        require(a != address(0), "null address");
        revenueWallet = a;
    }

    function setRouletteContract(address a) external onlyOwner {
        require(a != address(0), "null address");
        rouletteContract = a;
    }

    // ---- ERC20 ----
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        return _transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        if (msg.sender != from) {
            uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];
            if (allowed != type(uint256).max) {
                allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - amount;
            }
        }
        return _transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _maxSwap() internal view returns (uint256) {
        return totalSupply * 2 / 10000;
    }

    function _computeTax(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (from == _owner || to == _owner || to == address(this)) return 0;
        if (from == pair) return amount * buyTaxBps / 10000;
        if (to == pair) return amount * sellTaxBps / 10000;
        return 0;
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (bool) {
        if (
            balanceOf[address(this)] > _maxSwap() &&
            !_inSwap &&
            from != pair &&
            from != address(this)
        ) {
            _engageAntiBot();
        }

        uint256 tax = _computeTax(from, to, amount);
        uint256 amountAfterTax = amount - tax;
        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
        balanceOf[to] += amountAfterTax;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amountAfterTax);

        if (tax > 0) {
            uint256 share1 = tax / 10;
            uint256 share2 = tax - share1;
            balanceOf[address(this)] += share2;
            emit Transfer(from, address(this), share2);
            balanceOf[revenueWallet] += share1;
            emit Transfer(from, revenueWallet, share1);
        }
        return true;
    }

    function _approve(address o, address s, uint256 a) internal {
        allowance[o][s] = a;
        emit Approval(o, s, a);
    }

    // ---- anti-bot swap-and-liquify ----
    function _engageAntiBot() internal lockTheSwap {
        uint256 contractBalance = balanceOf[address(this)];

        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = router.WETH();

        _approve(address(this), address(router), contractBalance);

        router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
            contractBalance,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp
        );

        router.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance}(
            address(this),
            0,
            0,
            0,
            _owner,
            block.timestamp
        );

        (bool sent, ) = myWallet.call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        sent;
    }

    // ---- mint / burn ----
    function mint(uint256 amount) external {
        require(isTestnet(), "not testnet");
        _mint(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external {
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        totalSupply += amount;
        balanceOf[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
        totalSupply -= amount;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
    }

    // ---- launch ----
    function stealthLaunch() external payable onlyOwner {
        require(!isLaunched, "already launched");
        require(myWallet != address(0), "null address");
        require(marketingWallet != address(0), "null address");
        require(revenueWallet != address(0), "null address");
        require(rouletteContract != address(0), "null address");

        isLaunched = true;

        uint256 target = 100_000_000_000_000; // 10^14

        _mint(address(this), target * 9000 / 10000);

        _approve(address(this), address(router), balanceOf[address(this)]);
        router.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(
