        }
        return lower;
    }

    function getPriorRewardPerToken(address token, uint256 timestamp) public view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 nCheckpoints = rewardPerTokenNumCheckpoints[token];
        if (nCheckpoints == 0) return (0, 0);
        if (rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][nCheckpoints - 1].timestamp <= timestamp) {
            return (
                rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][nCheckpoints - 1].rewardPerToken,
                rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][nCheckpoints - 1].timestamp
            );
        }
        if (rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][0].timestamp > timestamp) return (0, 0);

        uint256 lower = 0;
        uint256 upper = nCheckpoints - 1;
        while (upper > lower) {
            uint256 center = upper - (upper - lower) / 2;
            RewardPerTokenCheckpoint memory cp = rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][center];
            if (cp.timestamp == timestamp) return (cp.rewardPerToken, cp.timestamp);
            else if (cp.timestamp < timestamp) lower = center;
            else upper = center - 1;
        }
        RewardPerTokenCheckpoint memory rc = rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][lower];
        return (rc.rewardPerToken, rc.timestamp);
    }

    function _writeCheckpoint(address account, uint256 balance) internal {
        uint256 _timestamp = block.timestamp;
        uint256 _nCheckPoints = numCheckpoints[account];

        if (_nCheckPoints > 0 && checkpoints[account][_nCheckPoints - 1].timestamp == _timestamp) {
            checkpoints[account][_nCheckPoints - 1].balanceOf = balance;
        } else {
            checkpoints[account][_nCheckPoints] = Checkpoint(_timestamp, balance);
            numCheckpoints[account] = _nCheckPoints + 1;
        }
    }

    function _writeRewardPerTokenCheckpoint(address token, uint256 reward, uint256 timestamp) internal {
        uint256 _nCheckPoints = rewardPerTokenNumCheckpoints[token];
        if (_nCheckPoints > 0 && rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][_nCheckPoints - 1].timestamp == timestamp) {
            rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][_nCheckPoints - 1].rewardPerToken = reward;
        } else {
            rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][_nCheckPoints] = RewardPerTokenCheckpoint(timestamp, reward);
            rewardPerTokenNumCheckpoints[token] = _nCheckPoints + 1;
        }
    }

    function _writeSupplyCheckpoint() internal {
        uint256 _nCheckPoints = supplyNumCheckpoints;
        uint256 _timestamp = block.timestamp;

        if (_nCheckPoints > 0 && supplyCheckpoints[_nCheckPoints - 1].timestamp == _timestamp) {
            supplyCheckpoints[_nCheckPoints - 1].supply = derivedSupply;
        } else {
            supplyCheckpoints[_nCheckPoints] = SupplyCheckpoint(_timestamp, derivedSupply);
            supplyNumCheckpoints = _nCheckPoints + 1;
        }
    }

    function batchRewardPerToken(address token, uint256 maxRuns) external {
        (rewardPerTokenStored[token], lastUpdateTime[token]) = _batchRewardPerToken(token, maxRuns);
    }

    function _batchRewardPerToken(address token, uint256 maxRuns) internal returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 _startTimestamp = lastUpdateTime[token];
        uint256 reward = rewardPerTokenStored[token];

        if (supplyNumCheckpoints == 0) {
            return (reward, _startTimestamp);
        }

        if (rewardRate[token] == 0) {
            return (reward, block.timestamp);
        }

        uint256 _startIndex = getPriorSupplyIndex(_startTimestamp);
        uint256 _endIndex = Math.min(supplyNumCheckpoints - 1, maxRuns);

        for (uint256 i = _startIndex; i < _endIndex; i++) {
            SupplyCheckpoint memory sp0 = supplyCheckpoints[i];
            if (sp0.supply > 0) {
                SupplyCheckpoint memory sp1 = supplyCheckpoints[i + 1];
                (uint256 _reward, uint256 endTime) = _calcRewardPerToken(token, sp1.timestamp, sp0.timestamp, sp0.supply, _startTimestamp);
                reward = _reward;
                _startTimestamp = endTime;
                _writeRewardPerTokenCheckpoint(token, reward, endTime);
            }
        }
        return (reward, _startTimestamp);
    }

    function _calcRewardPerToken(address token, uint256 timestamp1, uint256 timestamp0, uint256 supply, uint256 startTimestamp) internal view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 endTime = Math.max(timestamp1, startTimestamp);
        return ((Math.min(endTime, periodFinish[token]) - Math.min(Math.max(timestamp0, startTimestamp), periodFinish[token])) * rewardRate[token] * PRECISION / supply + rewardPerTokenStored[token], endTime);
    }

    function _updateRewardForAllTokens() internal {
        uint256 length = rewards.length;
        for (uint256 i; i < length; i++) {
            address token = rewards[i];
            (rewardPerTokenStored[token], lastUpdateTime[token]) = _updateRewardPerToken(token);
        }
    }

    function _updateRewardPerToken(address token) internal returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 _startTimestamp = lastUpdateTime[token];
        uint256 reward = rewardPerTokenStored[token];
        if (supplyNumCheckpoints == 0) return (reward, _startTimestamp);
        if (rewardRate[token] == 0) return (reward, block.timestamp);
        uint256 _startIndex = getPriorSupplyIndex(_startTimestamp);
        uint256 _endIndex = supplyNumCheckpoints - 1;
        if (_endIndex > 0) {
            for (uint256 i = _startIndex; i <= _endIndex - 1; i++) {
                SupplyCheckpoint memory sp0 = supplyCheckpoints[i];
                if (sp0.supply > 0) {
                    SupplyCheckpoint memory sp1 = supplyCheckpoints[i + 1];
                    (uint256 _reward, uint256 _endTime) = _calcRewardPerToken(token, sp1.timestamp, sp0.timestamp, sp0.supply, _startTimestamp);
                    reward = _reward;
                    _writeRewardPerTokenCheckpoint(token, reward, _endTime);
                    _startTimestamp = _endTime;
                }
            }
        }
        SupplyCheckpoint memory sp = supplyCheckpoints[_endIndex];
        if (sp.supply > 0) {
            (uint256 _reward,) = _calcRewardPerToken(token, lastTimeRewardApplicable(token), Math.max(sp.timestamp, _startTimestamp), sp.supply, _startTimestamp);
            reward = _reward;
            _writeRewardPerTokenCheckpoint(token, reward, block.timestamp);
            _startTimestamp = block.timestamp;
        }
        return (reward, _startTimestamp);
    }

    function rewardPerToken(address token) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (totalSupply == 0) {
            return rewardPerTokenStored[token];
        }
        return rewardPerTokenStored[token] + ((lastTimeRewardApplicable(token) - Math.min(lastUpdateTime[token], periodFinish[token])) * rewardRate[token] * PRECISION / derivedSupply);
    }

    function earned(address token, address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 _startTimestamp = Math.max(lastEarn[token][account], rewardPerTokenCheckpoints[token][0].timestamp);
        if (numCheckpoints[account] == 0) return 0;

        uint256 _startIndex = getPriorBalanceIndex(account, _startTimestamp);
        uint256 _endIndex = numCheckpoints[account] - 1;

        uint256 reward = 0;

        if (_endIndex - 0 > 1) {
            for (uint256 i = _startIndex; i <= _endIndex - 1; i++) {
                Checkpoint memory cp0 = checkpoints[account][i];
                Checkpoint memory cp1 = checkpoints[account][i + 1];
                (uint256 _rewardPerTokenStored0,) = getPriorRewardPerToken(token, cp0.timestamp);
                (uint256 _rewardPerTokenStored1,) = getPriorRewardPerToken(token, cp1.timestamp);
                reward += cp0.balanceOf * (_rewardPerTokenStored1 - _rewardPerTokenStored0) / PRECISION;
            }
        }

        Checkpoint memory cp = checkpoints[account][_endIndex];
        (uint256 _rewardPerTokenStored,) = getPriorRewardPerToken(token, cp.timestamp);
        reward += cp.balanceOf * (rewardPerToken(token) - Math.max(_rewardPerTokenStored, userRewardPerTokenStored[token][account])) / PRECISION;
        return reward;
    }

    function deposit(uint256 amount, uint256 tokenId) external lock {
        require(amount > 0);
        _safeTransferFrom(stake, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        totalSupply += amount;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount;

        if (tokenId > 0) {
            require(IVE(_ve).ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender);
            if (tokenIds[msg.sender] == 0) {
                tokenIds[msg.sender] = tokenId;
                IVoter(voter).attachTokenToGauge(tokenId, msg.sender);
            }
            require(tokenIds[msg.sender] == tokenId);
        } else {
            tokenId = tokenIds[msg.sender];
        }

        uint256 _derivedBalance = derivedBalances[msg.sender];
        derivedSupply -= _derivedBalance;
        _derivedBalance = derivedBalance(msg.sender);
        derivedBalances[msg.sender] = _derivedBalance;
        derivedSupply += _derivedBalance;

        _writeCheckpoint(msg.sender, _derivedBalance);
        _writeSupplyCheckpoint();

        IVoter(voter).emitDeposit(tokenId, msg.sender, amount);
        emit Deposit(msg.sender, tokenId, amount);
    }

    function depositAll(uint256 tokenId) external {
        this.deposit(IERC20(stake).balanceOf(msg.sender), tokenId);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external {
        withdrawToken(amount, tokenIds[msg.sender]);
    }

    function withdrawAll() external {
        withdrawToken(balanceOf[msg.sender], tokenIds[msg.sender]);
    }

    function withdrawToken(uint256 amount, uint256 tokenId) public lock {
        totalSupply -= amount;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
        _safeTransfer(stake, msg.sender, amount);

        if (tokenId > 0) {
            require(tokenId == tokenIds[msg.sender]);
            tokenIds[msg.sender] = 0;
            IVoter(voter).detachTokenFromGauge(tokenId, msg.sender);
        } else {
            tokenId = tokenIds[msg.sender];
        }

        uint256 _derivedBalance = derivedBalances[msg.sender];
        derivedSupply -= _derivedBalance;
        _derivedBalance = derivedBalance(msg.sender);
        derivedBalances[msg.sender] = _derivedBalance;
        derivedSupply += _derivedBalance;

        _writeCheckpoint(msg.sender, _derivedBalance);
        _writeSupplyCheckpoint();

        IVoter(voter).emitWithdraw(tokenId, msg.sender, amount);
        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, tokenId, amount);
    }

    function derivedBalance(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 _tokenId = tokenIds[account];
        uint256 _balance = balanceOf[account];
        uint256 _derived = _balance * 40 / 100;
        uint256 _adjusted = 0;
        uint256 _supply = IERC20(_ve).totalSupply();
        if (_tokenId > 0 && _supply > 0) {
            _adjusted = IVE(_ve).balanceOfNFT(_tokenId);
            _adjusted = totalSupply * _adjusted / _supply * 60 / 100;
        }
        return Math.min(_derived + _adjusted, _balance);
    }

    function getReward(address account, address[] memory tokens) external lock {
        require(msg.sender == account || msg.sender == voter);
        _unlocked = 1;
        IVoter(voter).distribute(address(this));
        _unlocked = 2;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            (rewardPerTokenStored[tokens[i]], lastUpdateTime[tokens[i]]) = _updateRewardPerToken(tokens[i]);
            uint256 _reward = earned(tokens[i], account);
            lastEarn[tokens[i]][account] = block.timestamp;
            userRewardPerTokenStored[tokens[i]][account] = rewardPerTokenStored[tokens[i]];
            if (_reward > 0) _safeTransfer(tokens[i], account, _reward);
            emit ClaimRewards(msg.sender, tokens[i], _reward);
        }

        uint256 _derivedBalance = derivedBalances[account];
        derivedSupply -= _derivedBalance;
        _derivedBalance = derivedBalance(account);
        derivedBalances[account] = _derivedBalance;
        derivedSupply += _derivedBalance;

        _writeCheckpoint(account, derivedBalances[account]);
        _writeSupplyCheckpoint();
    }

    function left(address token) external view returns (uint256) {
        if (block.timestamp >= periodFinish[token]) return 0;
        uint256 _remaining = periodFinish[token] - block.timestamp;
        return _remaining * rewardRate[token];
    }

    function notifyRewardAmount(address token, uint256 amount) external lock {
        require(token != stake);
        require(amount > 0);
        if (rewardRate[token] == 0) _writeRewardPerTokenCheckpoint(token, 0, block.timestamp);
        (rewardPerTokenStored[token], lastUpdateTime[token]) = _updateRewardPerToken(token);

        if (block.timestamp >= periodFinish[token]) {
            _safeTransferFrom(token, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
            rewardRate[token] = amount / DURATION;
        } else {
            uint256 _remaining = periodFinish[token] - block.timestamp;
            uint256 _left = _remaining * rewardRate[token];
            require(amount > _left);
            _safeTransferFrom(token, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
            rewardRate[token] = (amount + _left) / DURATION;
        }
        require(rewardRate[token] > 0);
        uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        require(rewardRate[token] <= balance / DURATION, "Provided reward too high");
        periodFinish[token] = block.timestamp + DURATION;
        if (!isReward[token]) {
            isReward[token] = true;
            rewards.push(token);
        }

        emit NotifyReward(msg.sender, token, amount);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token.code.length > 0);
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, value));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))));
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token.code.length > 0);
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))));
    }

    function _safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token.code.length > 0);
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector, spender, value));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))));
    }

    function claimFees() external returns (uint256 claimed0, uint256 claimed1) {
        (claimed0, claimed1) = IPair(stake).claimFees();
        if (claimed0 > 0 || claimed1 > 0) {
            uint256 _fees0 = 0 + claimed0;
            uint256 _fees1 = 0 + claimed1;
            (address token0, address token1) = IPair(stake).tokens();
            if (_fees0 > IBribe(bribe).left(token0) && _fees0 / DURATION > 0) {
                // reset fees0
                _safeApprove(token0, bribe, _fees0);
                IBribe(bribe).notifyRewardAmount(token0, _fees0);
            }
            if (_fees1 > IBribe(bribe).left(token1) && _fees1 / DURATION > 0) {
                _safeApprove(token1, bribe, _fees1);
                IBribe(bribe).notifyRewardAmount(token1, _fees1);
            }
            emit ClaimFees(msg.sender, claimed0, claimed1);
        }
    }

    event Deposit(address indexed from, uint256 tokenId, uint256 amount);
    event Withdraw(address indexed from, uint256 tokenId, uint256 amount);
    event NotifyReward(address indexed from, address indexed reward, uint256 amount);
    event ClaimFees(address indexed from, uint256 claimed0, uint256 claimed1);
    event ClaimRewards(address indexed from, address indexed reward, uint256 amount);
}

interface IERC20 {
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function balanceOf(address) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address, uint256) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address, address, uint256) external returns (bool);
    function approve(address, uint256) external returns (bool);
}

interface IVE {
    function ownerOf(uint256) external view returns (address);
    function balanceOfNFT(uint256) external view returns (uint256);
}

interface IVoter {
    function attachTokenToGauge(uint256, address) external;
    function detachTokenFromGauge(uint256, address) external;
    function emitDeposit(uint256, address, uint256) external;
    function emitWithdraw(uint256, address, uint256) external;
    function distribute(address) external;
}

interface IPair {
    function claimFees() external returns (uint256, uint256);
    function tokens() external view returns (address, address);
}

interface IBribe {
    function left(address) external view returns (uint256);
    function notifyRewardAmount(address, uint256) external;
}

library Math {
    function min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a < b ? a : b;
    }
    function max(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a >= b ? a : b;
    }
}

    }

        uint16 cooldownIndex = uint16(_generation / 2);
        if (cooldownIndex > 13) cooldownIndex = 13;
        Puppy memory _p = Puppy({
            genes: _genes,
            birthTime: uint64(block.timestamp),
            cooldownEndBlock: 0,
            matronId: uint32(_matronId),
            sireId: uint32(_sireId),
            siringWithId: 0,
            cooldownIndex: cooldownIndex,
            generation: uint16(_generation),
            combatMove1: 0,
            combatMove2: a,
            combatMove3: b,
            combatMove4: c,
            combatMove5: d
        });
        uint256 newPuppyId = puppies.push(_p) - 1;
        require(newPuppyId == uint32(newPuppyId));
        emit Birth(_owner, newPuppyId, _matronId, _sireId, _genes);
        _transfer(address(0), _owner, newPuppyId);
        return newPuppyId;
    }

    function _computeNextGen0Price() internal returns (uint256) {
        uint256 avg = saleAuction.averageGen0SalePrice();
        require(avg == uint128(avg));
        uint256 result = avg + avg / 2;
        if (result < 10 finney) result = 10 finney;
        return result;
    }

    function _isValidMatingPair(Puppy storage _matron, uint256 _matronId,
                                 Puppy storage _sire, uint256 _sireId) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (_matronId == _sireId) return false;
        if (_matron.matronId == _sireId || _matron.sireId == _sireId) return false;
        if (_sire.matronId == _matronId || _sire.sireId == _matronId) return false;
        if (_sire.matronId == 0 || _matron.matronId == 0) return true;
        if (_sire.matronId == _matron.matronId || _sire.matronId == _matron.sireId) return false;
        if (_sire.sireId == _matron.matronId || _sire.sireId == _matron.sireId) return false;
        return true;
    }

    function _isSiringPermitted(uint256 _sireId, uint256 _matronId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address matronOwner = puppyIndexToOwner[_matronId];
        address sireOwner = puppyIndexToOwner[_sireId];
        return (matronOwner == sireOwner) || (sireAllowedToAddressMap[_sireId] == matronOwner);
    }

    function _isReadyToBreed(Puppy storage _p) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _p.siringWithId == 0 && _p.cooldownEndBlock <= uint64(block.number);
    }

    function _isReadyToGiveBirth(Puppy storage _matron) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _matron.siringWithId != 0 && _matron.cooldownEndBlock <= uint64(block.number);
    }

    function _canBreedViaAuction(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId) internal view returns (bool) {
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        Puppy storage sire = puppies[_sireId];
        return _isValidMatingPair(matron, _matronId, sire, _sireId);
    }

    function _breedWith(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId) internal {
        Puppy storage sire = puppies[_sireId];
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        matron.siringWithId = uint32(_sireId);
        _triggerCooldown(sire);
        _triggerCooldown(matron);
        delete sireAllowedToAddressMap[_matronId];
        delete sireAllowedToAddressMap[_sireId];
        pregnantpuppiesCount++;
        emit Pregnant(puppyIndexToOwner[_matronId], _matronId, _sireId, matron.cooldownEndBlock);
    }

    function _triggerCooldown(Puppy storage _p) internal {
        uint32[14] memory cd;
        _p.cooldownEndBlock = uint64((cd[_p.cooldownIndex] / secondsPerBlockValue) + block.number);
        if (_p.cooldownIndex < 13) _p.cooldownIndex++;
    }

    function _randUint8(uint256) internal view returns (uint8) {
        return uint8(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(block.number - 1), block.coinbase, block.difficulty))) % 100 + 1);
    }

    function _randUint16(uint256 _id) internal view returns (uint16) {
        return uint16(_randUint8(_id));
    }

    function _memcpy(bytes32[4] buffer, uint256 count) internal pure returns (string) {
        bytes memory outputBytes = new bytes(count);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count && i < 128; i++) {
            outputBytes[i] = buffer[i / 32][i % 32];
        }
        return string(outputBytes);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.4.24;

interface IERC721Receiver {
    function onERC721Received(address _operator, address _from, uint256 _tokenId, bytes _data) external returns (bytes4);
}

interface ILANDBalance {
    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256);
    function destroyTokens(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function generateTokens(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

interface IEstateRegistry {
    function mint(address to, string metadata) external returns (uint256);
    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address);
}

contract LANDRegistry {
    // ---------- Storage layout (mirrors slots 0..0x14) ----------
    address internal _upgradeableOwner;      // slot 0
    address public proxyOwner;               // slot 1
    address public currentContract;          // slot 2
    string public description;               // slot 3
    string internal _name;                   // slot 4
    string internal _symbol;                 // slot 5
    uint256 public totalSupply;              // slot 6
    mapping(address => uint256[]) internal _ownedTokens; // slot 7
    mapping(uint256 => address) internal _tokenOwner;    // slot 8
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) internal _ownedTokensIndex; // slot 9
    mapping(uint256 => string) internal _tokenData;      // slot 10
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) internal _operators; // slot 11
    mapping(uint256 => address) internal _approval;      // slot 12
    mapping(address => uint256) internal _latestPing;    // slot 13
    mapping(address => bool) internal _registered;       // slot 14
    address public estateRegistry;                       // slot 19 (0x13)
    address public landBalance;                          // slot 16 (0x10)
    mapping(address => bool) public authorizedDeploy;    // slot 17 (0x11)
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => bool)) internal _updateOperator2; // slot 18 (0x12)

    int256 constant clearLow = 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff;
    int256 constant clearHigh = int256(-1) ^ int256(clearLow);
    int256 constant factor = 0x100000000000000000000000000000000;

    // ---------- Events ----------
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event UpdateOperator(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed operator);
    event UpdateManager(address indexed owner, address indexed manager, address indexed caller, bool approved);
    event DeployAuthorized(address indexed caller, address indexed deployer);
    event DeployForbidden(address indexed caller, address indexed deployer);
    event Update(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed holder, address indexed operator, string data);
    event EstateRegistrySet(address estateRegistry);
    event SetLandBalanceToken(address indexed previous, address indexed current);

    // ---------- Modifiers ----------
    modifier onlyProxyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == proxyOwner, "This function can only be called by the proxy owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOwnerOf(uint256 assetId) {
        require(msg.sender == _tokenOwner[assetId]);
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyUpdateAuthorized(uint256 assetId) {
        require(_isUpdateAuthorized(msg.sender, assetId), "msg.sender is not authorized to update");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyDeployer() {
        require(msg.sender == proxyOwner || authorizedDeploy[msg.sender],
            "This function can only be called by an authorized deployer");
        _;
    }

    // ---------- ERC165 ----------
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 id) external pure returns (bool) {
        if (id == 0xffffffff) return false;
        return id == 0x01ffc9a7 || id == 0x7c0633c6 || id == 0x80ac58cd;
    }

    // ---------- Name / Symbol / Description ----------
    function name() external view returns (string) { return _name; }
    function symbol() external view returns (string) { return _symbol; }

    function initialize(bytes /*data*/) external {
        _name = "Decentraland LAND";
        _symbol = "LAND";
        description = "Contract that stores the Decentraland LAND registry";
    }

    // ---------- Ownership ----------
    function owner() external view returns (address) { return _upgradeableOwner; }
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyProxyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "invalid address");
        require(!authorizedDeploy[newOwner], "address is already forbidden");
        // simplified
        authorizedDeploy[newOwner] = false;
        emit DeployForbidden(msg.sender, newOwner);
    }

    // ---------- Deployer authorization ----------
    function authorizeDeploy(address deployer) external onlyProxyOwner {
        require(deployer != address(0), "invalid address");
        require(!authorizedDeploy[deployer], "address is already authorized");
        authorizedDeploy[deployer] = true;
        emit DeployAuthorized(msg.sender, deployer);
    }

    function forbidDeploy(address deployer) external onlyProxyOwner {
        require(deployer != address(0), "invalid address");
        require(authorizedDeploy[deployer], "address is already forbidden");
        authorizedDeploy[deployer] = false;
        emit DeployForbidden(msg.sender, deployer);
    }

    function isAuthorized(address /*operator*/, uint256 /*assetId*/) external view returns (bool) { return false; }

    // ---------- Estate registry ----------
    function setEstateRegistry(address registry) external onlyProxyOwner {
        estateRegistry = registry;
        emit EstateRegistrySet(registry);
    }

    // ---------- Land balance token ----------
    function setLandBalanceToken(address newLandBalance) external onlyProxyOwner {
        require(newLandBalance != address(0), "New landBalance should not be zero address");
        emit SetLandBalanceToken(landBalance, newLandBalance);
        landBalance = newLandBalance;
    }

    // ---------- Register / Unregister balance ----------
    function registerBalance() external {
        require(!_registered[msg.sender], "Register Balance::The user is already registered");
        uint256 bal = ILANDBalance(landBalance).balanceOf(msg.sender);
        _registered[msg.sender] = true;
        if (bal > 0) {
            require(ILANDBalance(landBalance).destroyTokens(msg.sender, bal),
                "Register Balance::Could not destroy tokens");
        }
        uint256 land = _balanceOf(msg.sender);
        require(ILANDBalance(landBalance).generateTokens(msg.sender, land),
            "Register Balance::Could not generate tokens");
    }

    function unregisterBalance() external {
        require(_registered[msg.sender], "Unregister Balance::The user not registered");
        _registered[msg.sender] = false;
        uint256 bal = ILANDBalance(landBalance).balanceOf(msg.sender);
        require(ILANDBalance(landBalance).destroyTokens(msg.sender, bal),
            "Unregister Balance::Could not destroy tokens");
    }

    function registeredBalance(address who) external view returns (bool) {
        return _registered[who];
    }

    // ---------- Ping ----------
    function ping() external { _latestPing[msg.sender] = block.timestamp; }
    function setLatestToNow(address user) external {
        require(msg.sender == proxyOwner || _updateManager(user, msg.sender), "Unauthorized user");
        _latestPing[user] = block.timestamp;
    }
    function latestPing(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _latestPing[user];
    }

    // ---------- Token id encoding ----------
    function encodeTokenId(int256 x, int256 y) public pure returns (uint256) {
        require(
            -1000000 < x && x < 1000000 && -1000000 < y && y < 1000000,
            "The coordinates should be inside bounds"
        );
        return uint256(((x * factor) & clearHigh) | (y & clearLow));
    }

    function decodeTokenId(uint256 value) public pure returns (int256, int256) {
        int256 x;
        int256 y;
        (x, y) = _decode(value);
        require(
            -1000000 < x && x < 1000000 && -1000000 < y && y < 1000000,
            "The coordinates should be inside bounds"
        );
        return (x, y);
    }

    function _decode(uint256 value) internal pure returns (int256 x, int256 y) {
        x = _expandNegative128BitCast(uint128((value & uint256(clearHigh)) >> 128));
        y = _expandNegative128BitCast(uint128(value & uint256(clearLow)));
    }

    function _expandNegative128BitCast(uint128 v) internal pure returns (int256) {
        if (v & 0x80000000000000000000000000000000 != 0) {
            return int256(uint256(v) | uint256(~uint128(0) << 128));
        }
        return int256(v);
    }

    // ---------- ERC721 basics ----------
    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balanceOf(who);
    }

    function _balanceOf(address who) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _ownedTokens[who].length;
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 assetId) external view returns (address) {
        return _tokenOwner[assetId];
    }

    function exists(uint256 assetId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _tokenOwner[assetId] != address(0);
    }

    function existsProxy(int256 x, int256 y) external view returns (bool) {
        return _tokenOwner[encodeTokenId(x, y)] != address(0);
    }

    function ownerOfLand(int256 x, int256 y) external view returns (address) {
        return _tokenOwner[encodeTokenId(x, y)];
    }

    function ownerOfLandMany(int256[] xs, int256[] ys) external view returns (address[] memory result) {
        require(xs.length > 0, "You should supply at least one coordinate");
        require(xs.length == ys.length, "The coordinates should have the same length");
        result = new address[](xs.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            result[i] = _tokenOwner[encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i])];
        }
    }

    function landOf(address who) external view returns (int256[] memory xs, int256[] memory ys) {
        uint256[] storage ids = _ownedTokens[who];
        xs = new int256[](ids.length);
        ys = new int256[](ids.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            (xs[i], ys[i]) = _decode(ids[i]);
        }
    }

    function tokensOf(address who) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _ownedTokens[who];
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address who, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _ownedTokens[who].length);
        return _ownedTokens[who][index];
    }

    // ---------- Approvals ----------
    function getApproved(uint256 assetId) external view returns (address) {
        return _approval[assetId];
    }

    function getApprovedAddress(uint256 assetId) external view returns (address) {
        return _approval[assetId];
    }

    function approve(address operator, uint256 assetId) external {
        address holder = _tokenOwner[assetId];
        require(msg.sender == holder || _operators[holder][msg.sender]);
        require(holder != operator);
        if (_approval[assetId] != operator) {
            _approval[assetId] = operator;
            emit Approval(holder, operator, assetId);
        }
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "The operator should be different from owner");
        _operators[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address holder, address operator) external view returns (bool) {
        return _operators[holder][operator];
    }

    // ---------- Update Operator ----------
    function updateOperator(uint256 assetId) external view returns (address) {
        // returns latest operator for a token; simplified
        return _approval[assetId];
    }

    function setUpdateOperator(uint256 assetId, address operator) public {
        address holder = _tokenOwner[assetId];
        require(msg.sender == holder || _isAuthorized(msg.sender, assetId), "unauthorized user");
        _approval[assetId] = operator;
        emit UpdateOperator(assetId, operator);
    }

    function setManyUpdateOperator(uint256[] assetIds, address operator) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assetIds.length; i++) {
            setUpdateOperator(assetIds[i], operator);
        }
    }

    function updateManager(address holder, address manager, bool approved) external {
        require(manager != msg.sender, "The operator should be different from owner");
        require(holder == msg.sender || _operators[holder][msg.sender], "Unauthorized user");
        _updateOperator2[uint256(holder)][manager] = approved;
        emit UpdateManager(holder, manager, msg.sender, approved);
    }

    function _updateManager(address holder, address who) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _updateOperator2[uint256(holder)][who];
    }

    function _isAuthorized(address who, uint256 assetId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address holder = _tokenOwner[assetId];
        if (holder == who) return true;
        if (_operators[holder][who]) return true;
        if (_approval[assetId] == who) return true;
        return false;
    }

    function _isUpdateAuthorized(address who, uint256 assetId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _isAuthorized(who, assetId) || _updateManager(_tokenOwner[assetId], who);
    }

    function isUpdateAuthorized(address operator, uint256 assetId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isUpdateAuthorized(operator, assetId);
    }

    function setUpdateManager(address holder, address manager, bool approved) external {
        require(manager != msg.sender, "unauthorized user");
        require(holder == msg.sender || _operators[holder][msg.sender], "unauthorized user");
        _updateOperator2[uint256(holder)][manager] = approved;
        emit UpdateManager(holder, manager, msg.sender, approved);
    }

    // ---------- Transfers ----------
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 assetId) external {
        _doTransfer(from, to, assetId, "", false);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 assetId) external {
        _doTransfer(from, to, assetId, "", true);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 assetId, bytes data) external {
        _doTransfer(from, to, assetId, data, true);
    }

    function _doTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 assetId, bytes data, bool doCheck) internal {
        require(to != address(0));
        address holder = _tokenOwner[assetId];
        require(holder == from);
        require(_isAuthorized(msg.sender, assetId));

        _clearApproval(from, assetId);
        _removeToken(from, assetId);
        _addToken(to, assetId);

        emit Transfer(from, to, assetId);

        if (doCheck && _isContract(to)) {
            require(IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, assetId, data) == 0x150b7a02);
        }
    }

    function _clearApproval(address holder, uint256 assetId) internal {
        if (_approval[assetId] != address(0)) {
            _approval[assetId] = address(0);
            emit Approval(holder, address(0), assetId);
        }
    }

    function _removeToken(address from, uint256 assetId) internal {
        uint256 idx = _ownedTokensIndex[assetId];
        uint256 lastIdx = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
        uint256 lastId = _ownedTokens[from][lastIdx];
        _ownedTokens[from][idx] = lastId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[lastId] = idx;
        _ownedTokens[from].length--;
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[assetId];
        _tokenOwner[assetId] = address(0);
    }

    function _addToken(address to, uint256 assetId) internal {
        _tokenOwner[assetId] = to;
        _ownedTokensIndex[assetId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
        _ownedTokens[to].push(assetId);
        totalSupply++;
    }

    function _isContract(address a) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly { size := extcodesize(a) }
        return size > 0;
    }

    // ---------- Land assignment ----------
    function assignNewParcel(int256 x, int256 y, address beneficiary) external onlyDeployer {
        _generate(encodeTokenId(x, y), beneficiary);
    }

    function assignMultipleParcels(int256[] xs, int256[] ys, address beneficiary) external onlyDeployer {
        require(xs.length == ys.length, "The coordinates should have the same length");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            _generate(encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]), beneficiary);
        }
    }

    function _generate(uint256 assetId, address beneficiary) internal {
        require(_tokenOwner[assetId] == address(0));
        _addToken(beneficiary, assetId);
        emit Transfer(address(0), beneficiary, assetId);
    }

    // ---------- Land data ----------
    function landData(int256 x, int256 y) external view returns (string) {
        return _tokenData[encodeTokenId(x, y)];
    }

    function tokenMetadata(uint256 assetId) external view returns (string) {
        return _tokenData[assetId];
    }

    function updateLandData(int256 x, int256 y, string data) external {
        uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(x, y);
        require(_isUpdateAuthorized(msg.sender, assetId), "msg.sender is not authorized to update");
        _tokenData[assetId] = data;
        emit Update(assetId, _tokenOwner[assetId], msg.sender, data);
    }

    function updateManyLandData(int256[] xs, int256[] ys, string data) external {
        require(xs.length == ys.length, "The coordinates should have the same length");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]);
            require(_isUpdateAuthorized(msg.sender, assetId), "msg.sender is not authorized to update");
            _tokenData[assetId] = data;
            emit Update(assetId, _tokenOwner[assetId], msg.sender, data);
        }
    }

    function GET_METADATA() external pure returns (bytes4) {
        return bytes4(keccak256("getMetadata(uint256)"));
    }

    // ---------- Transfer land ----------
    function transferLand(int256 x, int256 y, address to) external {
        uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(x, y);
        _doTransfer(_tokenOwner[assetId], to, assetId, "", false);
    }

    function transferManyLand(int256[] xs, int256[] ys, address to) external {
        require(xs.length == ys.length, "The coordinates should have the same length");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]);
            _doTransfer(_tokenOwner[assetId], to, assetId, "", false);
        }
    }

    // ---------- Estate integration ----------
    function transferLandToEstate(int256 x, int256 y, uint256 estateId) external {
        require(IEstateRegistry(estateRegistry).ownerOf(estateId) == msg.sender,
            "You must own the Estate you want to transfer to");
        uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(x, y);
        _doTransfer(_tokenOwner[assetId], estateRegistry, assetId, toBytes(estateId), true);
    }

    function transferManyLandToEstate(int256[] xs, int256[] ys, uint256 estateId) external {
        require(xs.length == ys.length, "The coordinates should have the same length");
        require(IEstateRegistry(estateRegistry).ownerOf(estateId) == msg.sender,
            "You must own the Estate you want to transfer to");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]);
            _doTransfer(_tokenOwner[assetId], estateRegistry, assetId, toBytes(estateId), true);
        }
    }

    function createEstate(int256[] xs, int256[] ys, address beneficiary) external returns (uint256) {
        return _createEstate(xs, ys, beneficiary, "");
    }

    function createEstateWithMetadata(int256[] xs, int256[] ys, address beneficiary, string metadata)
        external
        returns (uint256)
    {
        return _createEstate(xs, ys, beneficiary, metadata);
    }

    function _createEstate(int256[] xs, int256[] ys, address beneficiary, string metadata) internal returns (uint256) {
        require(xs.length > 0, "You should supply at least one coordinate");
        require(xs.length == ys.length, "The coordinates should have the same length");
        require(estateRegistry != address(0), "The Estate registry should be set");
        uint256 estateId = IEstateRegistry(estateRegistry).mint(beneficiary, metadata);
        bytes memory est = toBytes(estateId);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
            uint256 assetId = encodeTokenId(xs[i], ys[i]);
            _doTransfer(_tokenOwner[assetId], estateRegistry, assetId, est, true);
        }
        return estateId;
    }

    function toBytes(uint256 x) internal pure returns (bytes memory b) {
        b = new bytes(32);
        assembly { mstore(add(b, 32), x) }
    }
}

            "ERC721: approve caller is not token owner nor approved for all"
        );
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public {
        require(msg.sender != operator, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, spender) || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        unchecked {
            _balances[from] -= 1;
            _balances[to] += 1;
        }
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);

        _afterTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 ret) {
                return ret == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length == 0) {
                    revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
                } else {
                    assembly {
                        revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason))
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }

    // ============ Enumerable ============
    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner, uint256 index) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < balanceOf(owner), "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[owner][index];
    }

    // ============ Mint / Burn ============
    function mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        _checkRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _safeMint(to, tokenId);
    }

    function batchMint(address to, uint256[] calldata tokenIds) public {
        _checkRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            _safeMint(to, tokenIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function burn(uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner nor approved");
        _burn(tokenId);
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, ""), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(_owners[tokenId] == address(0), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        unchecked {
            _balances[to] += 1;
        }
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        _afterTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _burn(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);

        _beforeTokenTransfer(owner, address(0), tokenId);

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        unchecked {
            _balances[owner] -= 1;
        }
        delete _owners[tokenId];

        emit Transfer(owner, address(0), tokenId);

        _afterTokenTransfer(owner, address(0), tokenId);
    }

    // ============ Base URI ============
    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external {
        _checkRole(MANAGER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        baseURI = newBaseURI;
    }

    // ============ Soulbound / hooks ============
    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(from == address(0) || to == address(0), "SBT: you can only mint or burn");

        // enumerable updates
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (to != from) {
            _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _afterTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _transferVotingUnits(from, to, 1);
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 length = balanceOf(to);
        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = balanceOf(from) - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];
        _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
        _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }

    // ============ AccessControl ============
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role][account];
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {

    }

        return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        _checkRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        _checkRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {

        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {

            _roleMembers[role].push(account);
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role][account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _roleMembers[role].length;
    }

    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) public view returns (address) {
        return _roleMembers[role][index];
    }

    // ============ Votes ============
    function delegates(address account) public view returns (address) {
        return _delegates[account];
    }

    function getVotes(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 pos = _checkpoints[account].length;
        return pos == 0 ? 0 : _checkpoints[account][pos - 1].votes;
    }

    function getPastVotes(address account, uint256 blockNumber) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(blockNumber < block.number, "Votes: block not yet mined");
        return _checkpointsLookup(_checkpoints[account], blockNumber);
    }

    function getPastTotalSupply(uint256 blockNumber) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(blockNumber < block.number, "Votes: block not yet mined");
        return _checkpointsLookup(_totalSupplyCheckpoints, blockNumber);
    }

    function _checkpointsLookup(Checkpoint[] storage ckpts, uint256 blockNumber) private view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 high = ckpts.length;
        uint256 low = 0;
        while (low < high) {
            uint256 mid = (low & high) + (low ^ high) / 2;
            if (ckpts[mid].fromBlock > blockNumber) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return high == 0 ? 0 : ckpts[high - 1].votes;
    }

    function delegate(address delegatee) public {
        _delegate(msg.sender, delegatee);
    }

    function delegateBySig(
        address delegatee,
        uint256 nonce,
        uint256 expiry,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) public {
        require(block.timestamp <= expiry, "Votes: signature expired");

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(structHash);
        address signer = _recover(digest, v, r, s);
        require(nonce == _useNonce(signer), "Votes: invalid nonce");
        _delegate(signer, delegatee);
    }

    function _useNonce(address owner) internal returns (uint256 current) {
        current = nonces[owner];
        nonces[owner] = current + 1;
    }

    function _delegate(address delegator, address delegatee) internal {
        address currentDelegate = _delegates[delegator];
        _delegates[delegator] = delegatee;
        emit DelegateChanged(delegator, currentDelegate, delegatee);
        _moveVotingPower(currentDelegate, delegatee, _getVotingUnits(delegator));
    }

    function _getVotingUnits(address account) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function _transferVotingUnits(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _writeCheckpoint(_totalSupplyCheckpoints, _add, amount);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _writeCheckpoint(_totalSupplyCheckpoints, _subtract, amount);
        }
        _moveVotingPower(delegates(from), delegates(to), amount);
    }

    function _moveVotingPower(address src, address dst, uint256 amount) private {
        if (src != dst && amount > 0) {
            if (src != address(0)) {
                (uint256 oldValue, uint256 newValue) = _writeCheckpoint(_checkpoints[src], _subtract, amount);
                emit DelegateVotesChanged(src, oldValue, newValue);
            }
            if (dst != address(0)) {
                (uint256 oldValue, uint256 newValue) = _writeCheckpoint(_checkpoints[dst], _add, amount);
                emit DelegateVotesChanged(dst, oldValue, newValue);
            }
        }
    }

    function _writeCheckpoint(
        Checkpoint[] storage ckpts,
        function(uint256, uint256) view returns (uint256) op,
        uint256 delta
    ) private returns (uint256 oldWeight, uint256 newWeight) {
        uint256 pos = ckpts.length;
        oldWeight = pos == 0 ? 0 : ckpts[pos - 1].votes;
        newWeight = op(oldWeight, delta);

        if (pos > 0 && ckpts[pos - 1].fromBlock == block.number) {
            ckpts[pos - 1].votes = _toUint224(newWeight);
        } else {
            ckpts.push(Checkpoint({fromBlock: _toUint32(block.number), votes: _toUint224(newWeight)}));
        }
    }

    function _add(uint256 a, uint256 b) private pure returns (uint256) { return a + b; }
    function _subtract(uint256 a, uint256 b) private pure returns (uint256) { return a - b; }

    function _toUint32(uint256 value) private pure returns (uint32) {
        require(value <= type(uint32).max, "SafeCast: value doesn't fit in 32 bits");
        return uint32(value);
    }

    function _toUint224(uint256 value) private pure returns (uint224) {
        require(value <= type(uint224).max, "SafeCast: value doesn't fit in 224 bits");
        return uint224(value);
    }

    // ============ EIP712 ============
    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainSeparatorV4();
    }

    function _domainSeparatorV4() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        if (address(this) == _CACHED_THIS && block.chainid == _CACHED_CHAIN_ID) {
            return _CACHED_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;
        }
        return keccak256(abi.encode(_TYPE_HASH, _HASHED_NAME, _HASHED_VERSION, block.chainid, address(this)));
    }

    function _hashTypedDataV4(bytes32 structHash) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", _domainSeparatorV4(), structHash));
    }

    // ============ ECDSA ============
    function _recover(bytes32 hash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal pure returns (address) {
        if (uint256(s) > 0x7fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff5d576e7357a4501ddfe92f46681b20a0) {
            revert("ECDSA: invalid signature 's' value");
        }
        if (v != 27 && v != 28) {
            revert("ECDSA: invalid signature 'v' value");
        }
        address signer = ecrecover(hash, v, r, s);
        require(signer != address(0), "ECDSA: invalid signature");
        return signer;
    }

    // ============ String helpers ============
    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) { digits++; temp /= 10; }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    function _toHexString(uint256 value, uint256 length) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(2 * length + 2);
        buffer[0] = "0";
        buffer[1] = "x";
        for (uint256 i = 2 * length + 1; i > 1; --i) {
            buffer[i] = bytes16("0123456789abcdef")[value & 0xf];
            value >>= 4;
        }
        require(value == 0, "Strings: hex length insufficient");
        return string(buffer);
    }

    function _toHexString(address account) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        return _toHexString(uint256(uint160(account)), 20);
    }
}

    function mint(uint8 tier, address to) external payable {
        if (block.timestamp < startTime) revert("NotStarted");
        if (block.timestamp > endTime) revert("Ended");
        if (uint256(tier) + _currentIndex - 1 > MAX_SUPPLY) revert ExceedsMaximumSupply();

        // Verify merkle proof for allowlist
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender));
        bool valid;
        uint256 price;
        if (tier == 0) {
            price = discountPrice1;
            valid = _verify(leaf, merkleRoot1, new bytes32[](0));
        } else {
            price = discountPrice2;
            valid = _verify(leaf, merkleRoot2, new bytes32[](0));

        if (!valid) revert NotOnAllowlist();
        price = price * uint256(tier);
        if (msgValueInUSD(msg.value) < price) revert("InsufficientValue");

        uint64 minted = uint64(_packedAddressData[msg.sender] >> 64);
        minted += uint64(tier);
        if (minted > maxMintAmount) revert("ExceedsPerWallet");

        _packedAddressData[msg.sender] |= (uint256(minted) << 64);

        address recipient = to == address(0) ? msg.sender : to;
        _mint(recipient, tier);
    }

    function adminMint(address to, uint8 amount) external {
        if (adminMinter != msg.sender) revert("NotAdminMinter");
        if (uint256(amount) + _currentIndex - 1 > MAX_SUPPLY) revert ExceedsMaximumSupply();
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 quantity) internal {
        if (quantity == 0) revert MintZeroQuantity();
        uint256 start = _currentIndex;
        _packedAddressData[to] += (quantity << 64) | quantity;
        _packedOwnerships[start] =
            uint256(uint160(to)) |
            (block.timestamp << 160) |
            (uint256(1) << 225);
        for (uint256 i; i < quantity; ++i) {
            emit Transfer(address(0), to, start + i);
        }
        _currentIndex = start + quantity;
    }

    function _verify(bytes32 leaf, bytes32 root, bytes32[] memory proof) internal pure returns (bool) {
        bytes32 computed = leaf;
        for (uint256 i; i < proof.length; ++i) {
            bytes32 p = proof[i];
            computed = computed < p
                ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(computed, p))
                : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(p, computed));
        }
        return computed == root;
    }

    // -------- Operator filter --------
    function _requireCallerAllowed(address caller) internal view {
        if (_cfg.operatorFilteringEnabled) _checkOperator(caller);
    }

    function _requireOperatorAllowed(address op) internal view {
        if (_cfg.operatorFilteringEnabled) _checkOperator(op);
    }

    function _checkOperator(address op) internal view {
        if (OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY.code.length == 0) return;
        try IOperatorFilterRegistry(OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY).isOperatorAllowed(FILTER_SUBSCRIPTION, op) returns (bool ok) {
            require(ok, "notAllowed");
        } catch {
            revert("filterFail");
        }
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

    // AccessControl
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) revert();
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public onlyRole(_roles[role].adminRole) {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public onlyRole(_roles[role].adminRole) {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 newAdmin) internal {
        bytes32 prev = _roles[role].adminRole;
        _roles[role].adminRole = newAdmin;
        emit RoleAdminChanged(role, prev, newAdmin);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Init parameters
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    struct InitParams {
        uint256[5] paramsA;
        uint256[5] paramsB;
        address governor;
        address guardian;
        address timelock;
        address rewardDistributor;
        LockKind defaultKind;
    }

    struct InitInput {
        string  name_;
        string  symbol_;
        address token_;
        address surplusPool_;
        address governor_;
        address guardian_;
        uint256[5] weightsA;
        uint256[5] weightsB;
    }

    address internal _token;

    function lockedToken() external view returns (address) { return _token; }

    function initialize(InitInput calldata p) external {
        // Initializable
        bool topLevel = !_initializing;
        require(
            (_initialized == 0 && (topLevel || address(this).code.length == 0)) || (!_initializing && _initialized == 1),
            "Initializable: contract is already initialized"
        );
        _initialized = 1;
        if (topLevel) _initializing = true;

        _requireNonZero(p.token_);
        _requireNonZero(p.surplusPool_);
        _requireContract(p.surplusPool_);
        _requireNonZero(p.governor_);

        // Pausable_init unchained
        // ReentrancyGuard_init unchained
        _reentrancyStatus = 1;

        // AccessControl: set role admins
        _setRoleAdmin(GOVERNOR_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(GUARDIAN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
        _setRoleAdmin(TIMELOCK_ROLE, GOVERNOR_ROLE);

        _grantRoleInternal(GOVERNOR_ROLE, p.governor_);
        _grantRoleInternal(GUARDIAN_ROLE, p.guardian_);
        _grantRoleInternal(TIMELOCK_ROLE, p.token_);

        _name = p.name_;
        _symbol = p.symbol_;
        _rewardDistributor = p.token_;

        _setParamsA(p.weightsA);
        _setParamsB(p.weightsB);

        uint256 week = _floorWeek(block.timestamp);
        _weekHistory[week] = WeekHistory({amount: 0, blockNumber: block.number});
        _pointer = 0;
        _lastGlobalBlock = 0;

        if (topLevel) {
            _initializing = false;
            emit Initialized(1);
        }
    }

    function _grantRoleInternal(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _requireNonZero(address a) internal pure {
        if (a == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
    }

    function _requireContract(address a) internal view {
        _requireNonZero(a);
        if (a.code.length == 0) revert NotContract();
    }

    function _setParamsA(uint256[5] memory arr) internal {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            _paramsA[LockKind(i)] = (arr[i] * 1e18) / 100;
        }
        emit HistoryUpdatedA(arr);
    }

    function _setParamsB(uint256[5] memory arr) internal {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            _paramsB[LockKind(i)] = (arr[i] * 1e18) / 100;
        }
        emit HistoryUpdatedB(arr);
    }

    event HistoryUpdatedA(uint256[5] weights);
    event HistoryUpdatedB(uint256[5] weights);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Views
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function MAX_TIME() external pure returns (uint256) { return uint256(uint8(0xff)) * uint256(604800); }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return totalSupplyAt(block.timestamp);
    }

    function totalSupplyAt(uint256 t) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 wk = _floorWeek(t);
        uint256 supply = _totalSupplyAtWeek[wk];
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < 255; ++i) {
            uint256 next = wk + 604800;
            if (next > t) break;
            wk = next;
            supply = supply + _totalSupplyAtWeek[next] + _weekSlopeChanges[next];
        }
        return supply;
    }

    function balanceOf(address user) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 n = _userLockCount[user];
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        // Sum bias at now of all active locks
        uint256 total;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Bucket storage b = _userBuckets[user][i];
            uint256 lockId = b.lockId;
            Lock storage L = _locks[lockId];
            if (L.endTime > block.timestamp) {
                total += L.bias - L.slope * (block.timestamp - L.startTime);
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    function balanceOfAt(address user, uint256 timestamp) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (timestamp > block.timestamp) revert InvalidTimestamp();
        uint256 n = _userLockCount[user];
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        // simplified summation via week-slope structure
        uint256 total;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Bucket storage b = _userBuckets[user][i];
            uint256 lockId = b.lockId;
            Lock storage L = _locks[lockId];
            if (L.startTime <= timestamp && L.endTime > timestamp) {
                total += L.bias - L.slope * (timestamp - L.startTime);
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    function getUserLocks(address user) external view returns (Lock[] memory arr) {
        uint256[] storage ids = _userLockIds[user];
        arr = new Lock[](ids.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; ++i) {
            arr[i] = _locks[ids[i]];
        }
    }

    function getUserLockIds(address user) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return _userLockIds[user];
    }

    function getUserLocksLength(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userLockIds[user].length;
    }

    function getUserLock(address user, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256 lockId, uint256 aux) {
        Bucket storage b = _userBuckets[user][index];
        return (b.lockId, b.something);
    }

    function userLockAmount(address user, uint256 lockId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userWeekBalance[user][lockId];
    }

    function userLockCount(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userLockCount[user];
    }

    function lockOf(uint256 lockId) external view returns (Lock memory) {
        return _locks[lockId];
    }

    function weekSlopeChange(uint256 w) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _weekSlopeChanges[w];
    }

    function totalSupplyAtWeek(uint256 w) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupplyAtWeek[w];
    }

    function weekHistory(uint256 w) external view returns (uint256 amount, uint256 blockNumber) {
        WeekHistory storage h = _weekHistory[w];
        return (h.amount, h.blockNumber);
    }

    function paramsA(uint8 i) external view returns (uint256) { return _paramsA[LockKind(i)]; }
    function paramsB(uint8 i) external view returns (uint256) { return _paramsB[LockKind(i)]; }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Admin
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function paused() public view returns (bool) { return _paused; }

    function pause() external onlyRole(GUARDIAN_ROLE) {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() external onlyRole(GUARDIAN_ROLE) {
        require(_paused, "Pausable: not paused");
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function setSurplusPool(address newPool) external onlyRole(TIMELOCK_ROLE) {
        _requireNonZero(newPool);
        surplusPool = newPool;
        emit SetSurplusPool(newPool);
    }

    function setParamsA(uint256[5] calldata arr) external onlyRole(TIMELOCK_ROLE) {
        uint256[5] memory m = arr;
        _setParamsA(m);
    }

    function setParamsB(uint256[5] calldata arr) external onlyRole(TIMELOCK_ROLE) {
        uint256[5] memory m = arr;
        _setParamsB(m);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Reward distributor callbacks
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function notifyReward(address user, uint256 amount, uint256 unlockAt) external {
        if (msg.sender != _rewardDistributor) revert NotRewardDistributor();
        _requireNonZero(user);
        _requireNonZero(_rewardDistributor);
        _requireNonZero(msg.sender);
        if (unlockAt % 604800 != 0) revert InvalidDuration();
        uint256 idx = _userLockCount[user] + 1;
        _userBuckets[user][idx - 1] = Bucket({lockId: amount, something: unlockAt});
        _userLockCount[user] = idx;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Withdraw
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function withdraw(uint256 lockId) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        Lock storage L = _locks[lockId];
        if (L.owner != msg.sender) revert NotLockOwner();
        if (L.endTime >= block.timestamp) revert LockNotExpired();

        uint256 amt = L.amount;
        totalLockedTokenAmount -= amt;

        L.startTime = 0;
        L.endTime = 0;
        L.slope = 0;
        L.bias = 0;
        L.owner = address(0);

        _removeUserLock(msg.sender, lockId);
        delete _locks[lockId];

        _safeTransfer(_rewardDistributor, msg.sender, amt);
        emit Withdraw(lockId, msg.sender, block.timestamp, amt);
    }

    function _removeUserLock(address user, uint256 lockId) internal returns (bool) {
        uint256[] storage arr = _userLockIds[user];
        uint256 len = arr.length;
        if (len == 0) return false;
        uint256 last = arr[len - 1];
        if (last != lockId) {
            // find and swap
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < len - 1; ++i) {
                if (arr[i] == lockId) {
                    arr[i] = last;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        arr.pop();
        return true;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Create lock
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function createLock(uint256 amount, uint8 kindU) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {
        LockKind kind = LockKind(kindU);
        uint256 unlockTime;
        bool aligned = block.timestamp % 604800 == 0;
        if (aligned) {
            unlockTime = block.timestamp;
        } else {
            unlockTime = 604800 + _floorWeek(block.timestamp);
        }

        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
        uint256 duration = _kindDuration(unlockTime, uint8(kindU));
        if (duration <= block.timestamp) revert InvalidDuration();

        return _createLock(msg.sender, amount, unlockTime, duration, uint8(kindU), duration);
    }

    function _kindDuration(uint256 base, uint8 kind) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        // Placeholder deterministic implementation used only for shape.
        return base + uint256(kind) * 604800;
    }

    function _createLock(
        address user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 startTime,
        uint256 endTime,
        uint8 kind,
        uint256 unlockAt
    ) internal returns (uint256 lockId) {
        _lastLockId += 1;
        lockId = _lastLockId;

        Lock storage L = _locks[lockId];
        L.amount = amount;
        L.slope = amount / (endTime - startTime + 1);
        L.bias = L.slope * (endTime - startTime);
        L.startTime = startTime;
        L.endTime = endTime;
        L.owner = user;
        L.kind = LockKind(kind);

        _userLockIds[user].push(lockId);
        totalLockedTokenAmount += amount;

        _safePull(_rewardDistributor, user, address(this), amount);
        emit LockCreated(lockId, user, amount, endTime, LockKind(kind), unlockAt);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Global checkpoint / purge
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function purge() external {
        uint256 wk = _floorWeek(block.timestamp);
        uint256 last = _lastGlobalBlock;
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < 255; ++i) {
            if (last + 604800 > wk) break;
            uint256 nextWeek = last + 604800;
            uint256 nextSupply = _totalSupplyAtWeek[nextWeek] + _weekSlopeChanges[nextWeek];
            _weekHistory[nextWeek] = WeekHistory({amount: nextSupply, blockNumber: block.number});
            emit HistoryUpdated(nextWeek, msg.sender, nextSupply, block.timestamp);
            last = nextWeek;
        }
        if (last != _lastGlobalBlock) _lastGlobalBlock = last;
        emit GlobalCheckpoint(msg.sender, _lastGlobalBlock, block.timestamp);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    // Helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- //
    function _floorWeek(uint256 t) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return (t / 604800) * 604800;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (data.length > 0) require(abi.decode(data, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
    }

    function _safePull(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (data.length > 0) require(abi.decode(data, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
    }
}
