        _checkRole(OWNER_ROLE);
        _burn(from, amount);
    }

    // ============ AccessControl ============
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].hasRole[account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role) internal view {
        if (!_roles[role].hasRole[msg.sender]) {
            revert AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(msg.sender, role);
        }
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32, address) external pure {
        revert("DERA: Use DeraRoles for role management");
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32, address) external pure {
        revert("DERA: Use DeraRoles for role management");
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        if (account != msg.sender) revert AccessControlBadConfirmation();
        if (role == DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) revert AccessControlEnforcedDefaultAdminRules();
        if (_roles[role].hasRole[account]) {
            _roles[role].hasRole[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal returns (bool) {
        if (!_roles[role].hasRole[account]) {
            _roles[role].hasRole[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal returns (bool) {
        if (_roles[role].hasRole[account]) {
            _roles[role].hasRole[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) external onlyDefaultAdmin {
        if (role == DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) revert AccessControlEnforcedDefaultAdminRules();
        bytes32 old = _roles[role].adminRole;
        _roles[role].adminRole = adminRole;
        emit RoleAdminChanged(role, old, adminRole);
    }

    function transferRole(bytes32 role, address from, address to) external {
        _checkRole(role);
        if (msg.sender == from) {
            _revokeRole(role, from);
            _grantRole(role, to);
        } else {
            revert AccessControlBadConfirmation();
        }
    }

    function transferOwnerRole(address newOwner) external {
        _checkRole(OWNER_ROLE);
        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        _revokeRole(OWNER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(OWNER_ROLE, newOwner);
    }

    // ============ Default Admin ============
    function defaultAdmin() external view returns (address) {
        return _currentDefaultAdmin;
    }
    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _currentDefaultAdmin;
    }

    function pendingDefaultAdmin() external view returns (address, uint48) {
        return (_pendingDefaultAdmin, _pendingDefaultAdminSchedule);
    }

    function defaultAdminDelay() external view returns (uint48) {
        if (block.timestamp >= _pendingDelaySchedule && _pendingDelaySchedule != 0) {
            return _pendingDelay;
        }
        return _currentDelay;
    }

    function pendingDefaultAdminDelay() external view returns (uint48, uint48) {
        if (_pendingDelaySchedule != 0 && block.timestamp < _pendingDelaySchedule) {
            return (_pendingDelay, _pendingDelaySchedule);
        }
        return (0, 0);
    }

    function defaultAdminDelayIncreaseWait() external pure returns (uint48) {
        return 432000;
    }

    function getDefaultAdminRole() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
    }

    function beginDefaultAdminTransfer(address newAdmin) external onlyDefaultAdmin {
        uint48 sched = uint48(block.timestamp) + _currentDelay;
        _pendingDefaultAdmin = newAdmin;
        _pendingDefaultAdminSchedule = sched;
        emit DefaultAdminTransferScheduled(newAdmin, sched);
    }

    function cancelDefaultAdminTransfer() external onlyDefaultAdmin {
        _pendingDefaultAdmin = address(0);
        _pendingDefaultAdminSchedule = 0;
        emit DefaultAdminTransferCanceled();
    }

    function acceptDefaultAdminTransfer() external {
        if (msg.sender != _pendingDefaultAdmin) revert AccessControlInvalidDefaultAdmin(msg.sender);
        uint48 sched = _pendingDefaultAdminSchedule;
        if (sched == 0 || block.timestamp < sched) revert AccessControlEnforcedDefaultAdminDelay(sched);
        _currentDefaultAdmin = _pendingDefaultAdmin;
        _pendingDefaultAdmin = address(0);
        _pendingDefaultAdminSchedule = 0;
    }

    function changeDefaultAdminDelay(uint48 newDelay) external onlyDefaultAdmin {
        uint48 sched = uint48(block.timestamp) + _currentDelay;
        _pendingDelay = newDelay;
        _pendingDelaySchedule = sched;
        emit DefaultAdminDelayChangeScheduled(newDelay, sched);
    }

    function rollbackDefaultAdminDelay() external onlyDefaultAdmin {
        _pendingDelay = 0;
        _pendingDelaySchedule = 0;
        emit DefaultAdminDelayChangeCanceled();
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyDefaultAdmin {
        _currentDefaultAdmin = address(0);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyDefaultAdmin {
        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        _currentDefaultAdmin = newOwner;
    }

    // ============ OApp Core ============
    function oAppVersion() external pure returns (uint64, uint64) {
        return (1, 2);
    }

    function oftVersion() external pure returns (bytes4, uint64) {
        return (bytes4(0x02e19bfd), 1);
    }

    function approvalRequired() external pure returns (bool) {
        return false;
    }

    function isPeer(uint32 eid, bytes32 peer) external view returns (bool) {
        return peers[eid] == peer;
    }

    function setPeer(uint32 eid, bytes32 peer) external {
        _checkRole(OWNER_ROLE);
        peers[eid] = peer;
        emit PeerSet(eid, peer);
    }

    function _getPeerOrRevert(uint32 eid) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 peer = peers[eid];
        if (peer == bytes32(0)) revert NoPeer(eid);
        return peer;
    }

    function setDelegate(address _delegate) external {
        _checkRole(OWNER_ROLE);
        ILayerZeroEndpointV2(endpoint).setDelegate(_delegate);
    }

    function setMsgInspector(address _msgInspector) external {
        _checkRole(OWNER_ROLE);
        msgInspector = _msgInspector;
        emit MsgInspectorSet(_msgInspector);
    }

    function setPreCrime(address _preCrime) external {
        _checkRole(OWNER_ROLE);
        preCrime = _preCrime;
        emit PreCrimeSet(_preCrime);
    }

    function setEnforcedOptions(EnforcedOptionParam[] calldata params) external {
        _checkRole(OWNER_ROLE);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < params.length; i++) {
            _assertOptionsType3(params[i].options);
            enforcedOptions[params[i].eid][params[i].msgType] = params[i].options;
        }
        emit EnforcedOptionSet(params);
    }

    function _assertOptionsType3(bytes memory options) internal pure {
        require(options.length >= 2, "invalid options");
        uint16 optionType;
        assembly {
            optionType := shr(240, mload(add(options, 32)))
        }
        if (optionType != 3) revert InvalidOptions(options);
    }

    function combineOptions(uint32 eid, uint16 msgType, bytes calldata extraOptions) public view returns (bytes memory) {
        bytes memory enforced = enforcedOptions[eid][msgType];
        if (enforced.length == 0) return extraOptions;
        if (extraOptions.length == 0) return enforced;
        if (extraOptions.length >= 2) {
            _assertOptionsType3(extraOptions);
            return bytes.concat(enforced, extraOptions[2:]);
        }
        revert InvalidOptions(extraOptions);
    }

    function isComposeMsgSender(Origin calldata, bytes calldata, address _sender) external view returns (bool) {
        return _sender == address(this);
    }

    function allowInitializePath(Origin calldata origin) external view returns (bool) {
        return peers[origin.srcEid] == origin.sender;
    }

    function nextNonce(uint32, bytes32) external pure returns (uint64) {
        return 0;
    }

    // ============ OFT Send/Receive ============
    function quoteOFT(SendParam calldata sendParam)
        external
        view
        returns (OFTLimit memory, OFTFeeDetail[] memory, OFTReceipt memory)
    {
        uint256 minAmount = 0;
        uint256 maxAmount = IERC20Like(token).totalSupply();
        OFTLimit memory limit = OFTLimit(minAmount, maxAmount);
        OFTFeeDetail[] memory feeDetails = new OFTFeeDetail[](0);
        uint256 amountSent = _removeDust(sendParam.amountLD);
        OFTReceipt memory receipt = OFTReceipt(amountSent, amountSent);
        return (limit, feeDetails, receipt);
    }

    function quoteSend(SendParam calldata sendParam, bool payInLzToken) external view returns (MessagingFee memory) {
        (uint256 amountSentLD, uint256 amountReceivedLD) = _debitView(sendParam.amountLD, sendParam.minAmountLD, sendParam.dstEid);
        amountSentLD;
        bytes memory message = _buildMsg(sendParam, amountReceivedLD);
        bytes memory options = combineOptions(sendParam.dstEid, uint16(sendParam.composeMsg.length > 0 ? 2 : 1), sendParam.extraOptions);
        message;
        options;
        payInLzToken;
        return MessagingFee(0, 0);
    }

    function send(SendParam calldata sendParam, MessagingFee calldata fee, address refundAddress)
        external
        payable
        returns (MessagingReceipt memory, OFTReceipt memory)
    {
        (uint256 amountSentLD, uint256 amountReceivedLD) = _debit(msg.sender, sendParam.amountLD, sendParam.minAmountLD, sendParam.dstEid);
        bytes memory message = _buildMsg(sendParam, amountReceivedLD);
        message;
        emit OFTSent(bytes32(0), sendParam.dstEid, msg.sender, amountSentLD, amountReceivedLD);
        return (MessagingReceipt(bytes32(0), 0, fee), OFTReceipt(amountSentLD, amountReceivedLD));
    }

    function lzReceive(Origin calldata origin, bytes32 guid, bytes calldata message, address executor, bytes calldata extraData) external payable onlyEndpoint {
        if (peers[origin.srcEid] != origin.sender) revert OnlyPeer(origin.srcEid, origin.sender);
        _lzReceive(origin, guid, message, executor, extraData);
    }

    function lzReceiveSimulate(Origin calldata origin, bytes32 guid, bytes calldata message, address executor, bytes calldata extraData) external payable onlyEndpoint {
        _lzReceive(origin, guid, message, executor, extraData);
        revert("Simulation");
    }

    function lzReceiveAndRevert(bytes[] calldata) external payable onlyEndpoint {
        revert("SimulationResult");
    }

    function _lzReceive(Origin calldata origin, bytes32 guid, bytes calldata message, address, bytes calldata) internal {
        address toAddress = address(uint160(uint256(bytes32(message[0:32]))));
        uint256 amountSD;
        assembly {
            amountSD := shr(192, calldataload(add(message.offset, 32)))
        }
        uint256 amountLD = amountSD * decimalConversionRate;
        _credit(toAddress, amountLD, origin.srcEid);
        emit OFTReceived(guid, origin.srcEid, toAddress, amountLD);
    }

    function _debit(address from, uint256 amountLD, uint256 minAmountLD, uint32 dstEid) internal returns (uint256, uint256) {
        (uint256 amountSentLD, uint256 amountReceivedLD) = _debitView(amountLD, minAmountLD, dstEid);
        _burn(from, amountSentLD);
        return (amountSentLD, amountReceivedLD);
    }

    function _debitView(uint256 amountLD, uint256 minAmountLD, uint32) internal pure returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 amountSentLD = _removeDust(amountLD);
        uint256 amountReceivedLD = amountSentLD;
        if (amountReceivedLD < minAmountLD) revert SlippageExceeded(amountReceivedLD, minAmountLD);
        return (amountSentLD, amountReceivedLD);
    }

    function _credit(address to, uint256 amountLD, uint32) internal returns (uint256) {
        if (to == address(0)) to = address(0xdead);
        _mint(to, amountLD);
        return amountLD;
    }

    function _removeDust(uint256 amountLD) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return (amountLD / decimalConversionRate) * decimalConversionRate;
    }

    function _buildMsg(SendParam calldata sendParam, uint256 amountReceivedLD) internal pure returns (bytes memory) {
        uint64 amountSD = uint64(amountReceivedLD / decimalConversionRate);
        return abi.encodePacked(sendParam.to, amountSD, sendParam.composeMsg);
    }

    function getInitialSupply() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 0;
    }

    // ============ ERC165 ============
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 ||
            interfaceId == 0x7965db0b ||
            interfaceId == 0x31498786;
    }

    fallback() external payable {}
    receive() external payable {}
}

    string private _symbol;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;

    uint256[] private _allTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex;
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _ownedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;

    struct SaleState {
        bool saleStarted;
        bool presaleStarted;
    }
    SaleState private _saleState;

    address private _royalty;
    mapping(address => bool) private _whitelist;
    address private _reserved;

    Counters.Counter private _tokenIds;

    uint256 public constant MAX_WORMS = 10000;
    uint256 public constant MAYOR_ID = 0;
    uint256 public wormPrice = 0.05 ether;
    uint256 public constant RESERVED_WORMS = 100;
    uint256 public maxWormsForPurchase = 30;
    uint256 public maxWormsForWhitelistedAccount = 10;
    uint256 public maxWormsForWhitelistedPurchase = 10;

    uint256 private _reservedMinted;
    uint256 private _mintedAmount;

    string private _baseTokenURI;

    event Minted(address to, uint256 amount);
    event MintedOnPresale(address to, uint256 amount);
    event MintedReserved(address to, uint256 amount);
    event MayorMinted(address to);
    event SaleStarted(address by);
    event SaleStopped(address by);
    event PresaleStarted(address by);
    event PresaleStopped(address by);

    constructor() {
        _name = "Worms";
        _symbol = "WORM";
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override(ERC165, IERC165) returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == type(IERC721Enumerable).interfaceId ||
            interfaceId == type(IERC721).interfaceId ||
            interfaceId == type(IERC721Metadata).interfaceId ||
            super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);
    }

    function name() public view override returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public view override returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function balanceOf(address ownerAddr) public view override returns (uint256) {
        require(ownerAddr != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[ownerAddr];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (address) {
        address o = _owners[tokenId];
        require(o != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        return o;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721Metadata: URI query for nonexistent token");
        string memory base = _baseURI();
        if (bytes(base).length == 0) return "";
        return string(abi.encodePacked(base, tokenId.toString()));
    }

    function _baseURI() internal view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseTokenURI;
    }

    function getBaseURI() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseTokenURI;
    }

    function setBaseURI(string memory baseURI_) external onlyOwner {
        _baseTokenURI = baseURI_;
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != o, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(
            _msgSender() == o || isApprovedForAll(o, _msgSender()),
            "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all"
        );
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (address) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: approved query for nonexistent token");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public override {
        require(operator != _msgSender(), "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[_msgSender()][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(_msgSender(), operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address o, address operator) public view override returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[o][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory _data) public override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, _data);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory _data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, _data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: operator query for nonexistent token");
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == o || getApproved(tokenId) == spender || isApprovedForAll(o, spender));
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _safeMint(to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory _data) internal {
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, _data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer of token that is not own");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory _data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.isContract()) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(_msgSender(), from, tokenId, _data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length == 0) {
                    revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
                } else {
                    assembly { revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason)) }
                }
            }
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }

    // Enumerable
    function totalSupply() public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) public view override returns (uint256) {
        require(index < totalSupply(), "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address o, uint256 index) public view override returns (uint256) {
        require(index < balanceOf(o), "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[o][index];
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (to != from) {
            _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 length = balanceOf(to);
        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = balanceOf(from) - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];
        _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
        _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }

    // --- Sale management ---

    function saleStarted() public view returns (bool) {
        return _saleState.saleStarted;
    }

    function presaleStarted() public view returns (bool) {
        return _saleState.presaleStarted;
    }

    function startSale() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_saleState.saleStarted, "Sale is started");
        _saleState.saleStarted = true;
        emit SaleStarted(_msgSender());
    }

    function stopSale() external onlyOwner {
        require(_saleState.saleStarted, "Sale is not started");
        _saleState.saleStarted = false;
        emit SaleStopped(_msgSender());
    }

    function startPresale() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_saleState.presaleStarted, "Presale is started");
        _saleState.presaleStarted = true;
        emit PresaleStarted(_msgSender());
    }

    function stopPresale() external onlyOwner {
        require(_saleState.presaleStarted, "Presale is not started");
        _saleState.presaleStarted = false;
        emit PresaleStopped(_msgSender());
    }

    function fromPresaleToSale() external onlyOwner {
        // stop presale, start sale
        _saleState.presaleStarted = false;
        emit PresaleStopped(_msgSender());
        _saleState.saleStarted = true;
        emit SaleStarted(_msgSender());
    }

    function getMintedAmount() public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 amount = totalSupply();
        if (mayorMinted()) {
            amount = amount - 1;
        }
        return amount;
    }

    function mayorMinted() public view returns (bool) {
        return _exists(MAYOR_ID);
    }

    function mintMayor(address to) external onlyOwner {
        require(!mayorMinted(), "Mayor is not minted");
        _safeMint(to, MAYOR_ID);
        emit MayorMinted(to);
    }

    // --- Reserved ---

    function getReservedAmount() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _reservedMinted;
    }

    function getMintedReservedAmount() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _reservedMinted;
    }

    function RESERVED_MINTED() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _reservedMinted;
    }

    function mayorOwner() public view returns (address) {
        return ownerOf(MAYOR_ID);
    }

    function mintReserved(uint256 amount, address to) external onlyOwner {
        require(_reservedMinted + amount <= RESERVED_WORMS, "Minting would exceed max supply of reserved worms");
        _reservedMinted = _reservedMinted + amount;
        _mintMultiple(to, amount);
        emit MintedReserved(to, amount);
    }

    function _mintMultiple(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 supply = totalSupply();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
            _tokenIds.increment();
            _safeMint(to, _tokenIds.current());
            supply++;
        }
    }

    // --- Whitelist ---

    function whitelisted(address a) public view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelist[a];
    }

    function whitelist(address a) external onlyOwner {
        require(!_whitelist[a], "Address already whitelisted");
        _whitelist[a] = true;
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(address a) external onlyOwner {
        require(_whitelist[a], "Address is not whitelisted");
        _whitelist[a] = false;
    }

    // --- Mint ---

    function _validatePrice(uint256 amount) internal {
        require(msg.value >= wormPrice * amount, "Ether value sent is not correct");
    }

    function mint(uint256 amount) external payable {
        require(saleStarted(), "Sale is not started");
        require(amount <= maxWormsForPurchase, "Can mint only 30 worms at a time");
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= MAX_WORMS, "Purchase would exceed max supply of Worms");
        _validatePrice(amount);
        _mintMultiple(_msgSender(), amount);
        emit Minted(_msgSender(), amount);
    }

    function presale(uint256 amount) external payable {
        require(presaleStarted(), "Presale is not started");
        require(_whitelist[_msgSender()], "Address is not whitelisted for presale");
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= MAX_WORMS, "Purchase would exceed max supply of Worms");
        require(amount <= maxWormsForWhitelistedPurchase, "Only 10 tokens could be minted at a time");
        require(balanceOf(_msgSender()) + amount <= maxWormsForWhitelistedAccount, "Only 10 tokens could be minted for whitelisted account");
        _validatePrice(amount);
        _mintMultiple(_msgSender(), amount);
        emit MintedOnPresale(_msgSender(), amount);
    }

    function reserve(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount <= maxWormsForPurchase, "Cannot reserve more than total supply");
        maxWormsForPurchase = amount;
    }

    function safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) external onlyOwner {
        _safeMint(to, tokenId);
    }

    // --- Withdraw ---

    function withdrawAll() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;
        payable(owner()).transfer(balance);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        payable(owner()).transfer(amount);
    }
}

    }

        require(value <= type(uint48).max, "SafeCast: value doesn't fit in 48 bits");

    }

contract SwapRouter02 {

    address public immutable factoryV2;

    address private constant MSG_SENDER = address(1);

    function unwrapWETH9WithFee(uint256 amountMinimum, uint256 feeBips, address feeRecipient) external payable {

    function sweepToken(address token, uint256 amountMinimum, address recipient) public payable {

    // ==================== Approvals ====================

        require(_tryApprove(token, 0));

    }

    function _tryApprove(address token, uint256 amount) private returns (bool) {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector, positionManager, amount));
        return success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool)));
    }

    function getApprovalType(address token, uint256 amount) external returns (uint8) {
        if (IERC20(token).allowance(address(this), positionManager) >= amount) return 0;
        if (_tryApprove(token, type(uint256).max)) return 1;
        if (_tryApprove(token, type(uint256).max - 1)) return 2;
        require(_tryApprove(token, 0));
        if (_tryApprove(token, type(uint256).max)) return 3;
        require(_tryApprove(token, type(uint256).max - 1));
        return 4;
    }

    // ==================== Permit ====================

    function selfPermit(address token, uint256 value, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) public payable {
        IERC20Permit(token).permit(msg.sender, address(this), value, deadline, v, r, s);
    }

    function selfPermitIfNecessary(address token, uint256 value, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external payable {

    function selfPermitAllowed(address token, uint256 nonce, uint256 expiry, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) public payable {
        IERC20Permit(token).permitAllowed(msg.sender, address(this), nonce, expiry, true, v, r, s);

    function selfPermitAllowedIfNecessary(address token, uint256 nonce, uint256 expiry, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external payable {

            selfPermitAllowed(token, nonce, expiry, v, r, s);
    }

    // ==================== Multicall ====================

    function multicall(bytes[] calldata data) public payable returns (bytes[] memory results) {
        results = new bytes[](data.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
            (bool success, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(data[i]);
            if (!success) {
                if (result.length < 68) revert();
                assembly {
                    result := add(result, 0x04)
                }
                revert(abi.decode(result, (string)));
            }
            results[i] = result;
        }
    }

    function multicall(uint256 deadline, bytes[] calldata data) external payable returns (bytes[] memory) {
        require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "Transaction too old");
        return multicall(data);
    }

    function multicall(bytes32 previousBlockhash, bytes[] calldata data) external payable returns (bytes[] memory) {
        require(blockhash(block.number - 1) == previousBlockhash, "Blockhash");
        return multicall(data);
    }

    // ==================== Position Manager passthrough ====================

    function callPositionManager(bytes calldata data) external payable returns (bytes memory result) {
        (bool success, bytes memory ret) = positionManager.call(data);
        if (!success) {
            if (ret.length < 68) revert();
            assembly { ret := add(ret, 0x04) }
            revert(abi.decode(ret, (string)));
        }
        return ret;
    }

    // ==================== V3 exact input/output ====================

    function exactInputSingle(ExactInputSingleParams calldata params) external payable returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        amountOut = _exactInputInternal(
            params.amountIn,
            params.recipient,
            params.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            SwapCallbackData({path: abi.encodePacked(params.tokenIn, params.fee, params.tokenOut), payer: msg.sender})
        );
        require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum, "Too little received");
    }

    function exactInput(ExactInputParams memory params) external payable returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        address payer = msg.sender;
        while (true) {
            bool hasMultiplePools = params.path.length >= 66;
            params.amountIn = _exactInputInternal(
                params.amountIn,
                hasMultiplePools ? address(this) : params.recipient,
                0,
                SwapCallbackData({path: _getFirstPool(params.path), payer: payer})
            );
            if (hasMultiplePools) {
                payer = address(this);
                params.path = _skipToken(params.path);
            } else {
                amountOut = params.amountIn;
                break;
            }
        }
        require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum, "Too little received");
    }

    function exactOutputSingle(ExactOutputSingleParams calldata params) external payable returns (uint256 amountIn) {
        amountIn = _exactOutputInternal(
            params.amountOut,
            params.recipient,
            params.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            SwapCallbackData({path: abi.encodePacked(params.tokenOut, params.fee, params.tokenIn), payer: msg.sender})
        );
        require(amountIn <= params.amountInMaximum, "Too much requested");
        amountInCached = DEFAULT_AMOUNT_IN_CACHED;
    }

    function exactOutput(ExactOutputParams calldata params) external payable returns (uint256 amountIn) {
        _exactOutputInternal(
            params.amountOut,
            params.recipient,
            0,
            SwapCallbackData({path: params.path, payer: msg.sender})
        );
        amountIn = amountInCached;
        require(amountIn <= params.amountInMaximum, "Too much requested");
        amountInCached = DEFAULT_AMOUNT_IN_CACHED;
    }

    struct SwapCallbackData {
        bytes path;
        address payer;
    }

    function _exactInputInternal(uint256 amountIn, address recipient, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96, SwapCallbackData memory data) private returns (uint256) {
        if (recipient == MSG_SENDER) recipient = msg.sender;
        else if (recipient == ADDRESS_THIS) recipient = address(this);

        (address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee) = _decodeFirstPool(data.path);
        bool zeroForOne = tokenIn < tokenOut;

        (int256 amount0, int256 amount1) = IUniswapV3Pool(_poolFor(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee)).swap(
            recipient,
            zeroForOne,
            int256(amountIn),
            sqrtPriceLimitX96 == 0 ? (zeroForOne ? MIN_SQRT_RATIO : MAX_SQRT_RATIO) : sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            abi.encode(data)
        );
        return uint256(-(zeroForOne ? amount1 : amount0));
    }

    function _exactOutputInternal(uint256 amountOut, address recipient, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96, SwapCallbackData memory data) private returns (uint256) {
        if (recipient == MSG_SENDER) recipient = msg.sender;
        else if (recipient == ADDRESS_THIS) recipient = address(this);

        (address tokenOut, address tokenIn, uint24 fee) = _decodeFirstPool(data.path);
        bool zeroForOne = tokenIn < tokenOut;

        (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = IUniswapV3Pool(_poolFor(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee)).swap(
            recipient,
            zeroForOne,
            -int256(amountOut),
            sqrtPriceLimitX96 == 0 ? (zeroForOne ? MIN_SQRT_RATIO : MAX_SQRT_RATIO) : sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            abi.encode(data)
        );
        uint256 amountOutReceived;
        (uint256 amountIn, uint256 out) = zeroForOne
            ? (uint256(amount0Delta), uint256(-amount1Delta))
            : (uint256(amount1Delta), uint256(-amount0Delta));
        amountOutReceived = out;
        if (sqrtPriceLimitX96 == 0) require(amountOutReceived == amountOut);
        return amountIn;
    }

    function uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta, bytes calldata _data) external payable {
        require(amount0Delta > 0 || amount1Delta > 0);
        SwapCallbackData memory data = abi.decode(_data, (SwapCallbackData));
        (address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee) = _decodeFirstPool(data.path);
        _verifyCallback(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee);

        (bool isExactInput, uint256 amountToPay) = amount0Delta > 0
            ? (tokenIn < tokenOut, uint256(amount0Delta))
            : (tokenOut < tokenIn, uint256(amount1Delta));

        if (isExactInput) {
            _pay(tokenIn, data.payer, msg.sender, amountToPay);
        } else {
            if (data.path.length >= 66) {
                data.path = _skipToken(data.path);
                _exactOutputInternal(amountToPay, msg.sender, 0, data);
            } else {
                amountInCached = amountToPay;
                _pay(tokenOut, data.payer, msg.sender, amountToPay);
            }
        }
    }

    // ==================== V2 ====================

    function swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] calldata path, address to) external payable returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        address payer = msg.sender;
        if (to == MSG_SENDER) to = msg.sender;
        else if (to == ADDRESS_THIS) to = address(this);

        _payV2(path[0], payer, _pairFor(path[0], path[1]), amountIn);
        _swapV2(amountIn, path, to);

        amountOut = IERC20(path[path.length - 1]).balanceOf(to);
        require(amountOut >= amountOutMin, "Too little received");
    }

    function swapTokensForExactTokens(uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMax, address[] calldata path, address to) external payable returns (uint256 amountIn) {
        if (to == MSG_SENDER) to = msg.sender;
        else if (to == ADDRESS_THIS) to = address(this);

        uint256[] memory amounts = _getAmountsIn(amountOut, path);
        amountIn = amounts[0];
        require(amountIn <= amountInMax, "Too much requested");

        _payV2(path[0], msg.sender, _pairFor(path[0], path[1]), amountIn);
        _swapV2Out(amounts, path, to);
    }

    function _swapV2(uint256 amountIn, address[] memory path, address to) private {
        for (uint256 i; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
            (address input, address output) = (path[i], path[i + 1]);
            (address token0,) = _sortTokens(input, output);
            IUniswapV2Pair pair = IUniswapV2Pair(_pairFor(input, output));
            uint256 amountInput;
            uint256 amountOutput;
            {
                (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1,) = pair.getReserves();
                (uint256 reserveInput, uint256 reserveOutput) = input == token0 ? (uint256(reserve0), uint256(reserve1)) : (uint256(reserve1), uint256(reserve0));
                amountInput = IERC20(input).balanceOf(address(pair)) - reserveInput;
                amountOutput = _getAmountOut(amountInput, reserveInput, reserveOutput);
            }
            (uint256 amount0Out, uint256 amount1Out) = input == token0 ? (uint256(0), amountOutput) : (amountOutput, uint256(0));
            address recipient = i < path.length - 2 ? _pairFor(output, path[i + 2]) : to;
            pair.swap(amount0Out, amount1Out, recipient, new bytes(0));
        }
    }

    function _swapV2Out(uint256[] memory amounts, address[] memory path, address to) private {
        for (uint256 i; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
            (address input, address output) = (path[i], path[i + 1]);
            (address token0,) = _sortTokens(input, output);
            uint256 amountOut = amounts[i + 1];
            (uint256 amount0Out, uint256 amount1Out) = input == token0 ? (uint256(0), amountOut) : (amountOut, uint256(0));
            address recipient = i < path.length - 2 ? _pairFor(output, path[i + 2]) : to;
            IUniswapV2Pair(_pairFor(input, output)).swap(amount0Out, amount1Out, recipient, new bytes(0));
        }
    }

    function _getAmountsIn(uint256 amountOut, address[] memory path) private view returns (uint256[] memory amounts) {
        amounts = new uint256[](path.length);
        amounts[amounts.length - 1] = amountOut;
        for (uint256 i = path.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            (address token0,) = _sortTokens(path[i - 1], path[i]);
            IUniswapV2Pair pair = IUniswapV2Pair(_pairFor(path[i - 1], path[i]));
            (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1,) = pair.getReserves();
            (uint256 reserveIn, uint256 reserveOut) = path[i - 1] == token0 ? (uint256(reserve0), uint256(reserve1)) : (uint256(reserve1), uint256(reserve0));
            amounts[i - 1] = _getAmountIn(amounts[i], reserveIn, reserveOut);
        }
    }

    function _getAmountOut(uint256 amountIn, uint256 reserveIn, uint256 reserveOut) private pure returns (uint256) {
        require(amountIn > 0, "INSUFFICIENT_INPUT_AMOUNT");
        require(reserveIn > 0 && reserveOut > 0);
        uint256 amountInWithFee = amountIn * 997;
        uint256 numerator = amountInWithFee * reserveOut;
        uint256 denominator = reserveIn * 1000 + amountInWithFee;
        return numerator / denominator;
    }

    function _getAmountIn(uint256 amountOut, uint256 reserveIn, uint256 reserveOut) private pure returns (uint256) {
        require(amountOut > 0, "INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT_AMOUNT");
        require(reserveIn > 0 && reserveOut > 0);
        uint256 numerator = reserveIn * amountOut * 1000;
        uint256 denominator = (reserveOut - amountOut) * 997;
        return numerator / denominator + 1;
    }

    // ==================== Oracle slippage ====================

    function checkOracleSlippage(bytes memory path, uint24 maximumTickDivergence, uint32 secondsAgo) public view {
        (int256 syntheticTick, int256 avgTick) = _getBlockAndHistoricalTicks(path, secondsAgo);
        require(syntheticTick - avgTick < int256(int24(maximumTickDivergence)) && avgTick - syntheticTick < int256(int24(maximumTickDivergence)), "TD");
    }

    function checkOracleSlippage(bytes[] memory paths, uint128[] memory amounts, uint24 maximumTickDivergence, uint32 secondsAgo) external view {
        require(paths.length == amounts.length);
        int256[] memory syntheticTicks = new int256[](paths.length);
        int256[] memory averageTicks = new int256[](paths.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
            (int256 s, int256 a) = _getBlockAndHistoricalTicks(paths[i], secondsAgo);
            syntheticTicks[i] = s;
            averageTicks[i] = a;
        }
        int256 syntheticWA = _weightedAverage(syntheticTicks, amounts);
        int256 avgWA = _weightedAverage(averageTicks, amounts);
        require(syntheticWA - avgWA < int256(int24(maximumTickDivergence)) && avgWA - syntheticWA < int256(int24(maximumTickDivergence)), "TD");
    }

    function _getBlockAndHistoricalTicks(bytes memory, uint32) private view returns (int256, int256) {
        return (0, 0);
    }

    function _weightedAverage(int256[] memory ticks, uint128[] memory amounts) private pure returns (int256) {
        int256 num;
        uint256 den;
        for (uint256 i; i < ticks.length; i++) {
            num += ticks[i] * int256(uint256(amounts[i]));
            den += amounts[i];
        }
        return num / int256(den);
    }

    // ==================== Liquidity ====================

    function mint(MintParams calldata p) external payable returns (bytes memory) {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = positionManager.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x88316456), p)
        );
        require(success);
        return data;
    }

    function increaseLiquidity(IncreaseLiquidityParams calldata p) external payable returns (bytes memory) {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = positionManager.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x219f5d17), p)
        );
        require(success);
        return data;
    }

    // ==================== Internal helpers ====================

    function _pay(address token, address payer, address recipient, uint256 value) private {
        if (token == WETH9 && address(this).balance >= value) {
            IWETH9(WETH9).deposit{value: value}();
            IWETH9(WETH9).transfer(recipient, value);
        } else if (payer == address(this)) {
            _safeTransfer(token, recipient, value);
        } else {
            _safeTransferFrom(token, payer, recipient, value);
        }
    }

    function _payV2(address token, address payer, address recipient, uint256 value) private {
        if (payer == address(this)) {
            _safeTransfer(token, recipient, value);
        } else {
            _safeTransferFrom(token, payer, recipient, value);
        }
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) private {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, value));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "STF");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) private {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "STF");
    }

    function _safeTransferETH(address to, uint256 value) private {
        (bool success,) = to.call{value: value}(new bytes(0));
        require(success, "STE");
    }

    function _sortTokens(address a, address b) private pure returns (address, address) {
        require(a != b);
        (address t0, address t1) = a < b ? (a, b) : (b, a);
        require(t0 != address(0));
        return (t0, t1);
    }

    function _pairFor(address a, address b) private view returns (address pair) {
        (address t0, address t1) = _sortTokens(a, b);
        pair = address(uint160(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(
            hex"ff",
            factoryV2,
            keccak256(abi.encodePacked(t0, t1)),
            hex"96e8ac4277198ff8b6f785478aa9a39f403cb768dd02cbee326c3e7da348845f"
        )))));
    }

    function _poolFor(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint24 fee) private view returns (address pool) {
        (address t0, address t1) = tokenA < tokenB ? (tokenA, tokenB) : (tokenB, tokenA);
        pool = address(uint160(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(
            hex"ff",
            factory,
            keccak256(abi.encode(t0, t1, fee)),
            bytes32(0xe34f199b19b2b4f47f68442619d555527d244f78a3297ea89325f843f87b8b54)
        )))));
    }

    function _decodeFirstPool(bytes memory path) private pure returns (address tokenA, address tokenB, uint24 fee) {
        require(path.length >= 43);
        assembly {
            tokenA := shr(96, mload(add(path, 32)))
            fee := shr(232, mload(add(path, 52)))
            tokenB := shr(96, mload(add(path, 55)))
        }
    }

    function _getFirstPool(bytes memory path) private pure returns (bytes memory) {
        bytes memory result = new bytes(43);
        for (uint256 i; i < 43; i++) result[i] = path[i];
        return result;
    }

    function _skipToken(bytes memory path) private pure returns (bytes memory) {
        require(path.length > 23);
        bytes memory result = new bytes(path.length - 23);
        for (uint256 i; i < result.length; i++) result[i] = path[i + 23];

        PoolId id = _toId(key);

    function _accountDelta(address currency, int128 delta, address target) internal {
        if (delta == 0) return;
        bytes32 slot = keccak256(abi.encode(target, currency));
        int256 prev;
        assembly { prev := tload(slot) }
        int256 next = prev + int256(delta);
        assembly { tstore(slot, next) }
        if (prev == 0) {
            uint256 c;
            assembly { c := tload(NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT) }
            assembly { tstore(NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT, add(c, 1)) }
        } else if (next == 0) {
            uint256 c;
            assembly { c := tload(NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT) }
            assembly { tstore(NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT, sub(c, 1)) }

        int256 raw = BalanceDelta.unwrap(delta);
        int128 amount0 = int128(raw >> 128);
        int128 amount1 = int128(raw);

        _accountDelta(Currency.unwrap(key.currency1), amount1, target);

        pancakeRouter = _pancakeRouter;
    }

    function excludeFromFee(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromFee[account] = true; }
    function includeInFee(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromFee[account] = false; }
    function isExcludedFromFee(address account) public view returns (bool) { return _isExcludedFromFee[account]; }

    function excludedFromTransactionlock(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromTransactionlock[account] = true; }
    function includeInTransactionlock(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromTransactionlock[account] = false; }
    function getIsExcludedFromTransactionlock(address account) external view returns (bool) { return _isExcludedFromTransactionlock[account]; }

    function excludedFromAntiWhale(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromAntiWhale[account] = true; }
    function includeInAntiWhale(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromAntiWhale[account] = false; }
    function _isExcludedFromAntiWhaleFn(address account) external view returns (bool) { return _isExcludedFromAntiWhale[account]; }

    function excludedFromMaxTxAmount(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromMaxTxAmount[account] = true; }
    function includeInMaxTxAmount(address account) external onlyOwner { _isExcludedFromMaxTxAmount[account] = false; }

    function blacklistSingleWallet(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(account != pancakePair, "We can not exclude pancake router");
        require(!_isBlacklisted[account], "Account is already excluded");
        _isBlacklisted[account] = true;
    }
    function unBlacklistSingleWallet(address account) external onlyOwner { _isBlacklisted[account] = false; }
    function isBlacklisted(address account) external view returns (bool) { return _isBlacklisted[account]; }

    function blacklistMultipleWallets(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyOwner {
        require(accounts.length < 800, "Can only blacklist 800 addresses at a time");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _isBlacklisted[accounts[i]] = true;
        }
    }
    function unBlacklistMultipleWallets(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyOwner {
        require(accounts.length < 800, "Can only unblacklist 800 addresses at a time");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _isBlacklisted[accounts[i]] = false;
        }
    }

    function bridgeMint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyBridge {
        bool wasExcluded = _isExcluded[to];
        if (!wasExcluded) excludeFromReward(to);
        _mint(to, amount);
        if (!wasExcluded) _includeInReward(to);
    }

    function _includeInReward(address account) private {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excluded.length; i++) {
            if (_excluded[i] == account) {
                _excluded[i] = _excluded[_excluded.length - 1];
                _tOwned[account] = 0;
                _isExcluded[account] = false;
                _excluded.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    function _mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "BEP20: mint to the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "Tokens value should be greater then Zero");
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        uint256 rAmount = amount.mul(currentRate);
        _rOwned[account] = _rOwned[account].add(rAmount);
        _tOwned[account] = _tOwned[account].add(amount);
        _tTotal = _tTotal.add(amount);
        _rTotal = _rTotal.add(rAmount);
        emit Transfer(address(0), account, amount);
    }

    function bridgeBurn(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyBridge {
        _burn(account, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "BEP20: burn from the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "Tokens value should be greater then Zero");
        require(amount <= balanceOf(account), "Tokens value should be less then equal to your balance");
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        uint256 rAmount = amount.mul(currentRate);
        if (_isExcluded[account]) {
            _tOwned[account] = _tOwned[account].sub(amount);
        }
        _rOwned[account] = _rOwned[account].sub(rAmount);
        _tTotal = _tTotal.sub(amount);
        _rTotal = _rTotal.sub(rAmount);
        emit Transfer(account, address(0), amount);
    }

    function burnTokens(uint256 amount) external {
        _burn(_msgSender(), amount);
    }

    function recoverBNB() external onlyOwner {
        require(address(this).balance > 0, "no BNB");
        (bool s,) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(s);
    }

    function recoverToken(address tokenAddr, address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = tokenAddr.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IBEP20.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "token transfer failed");
    }

    function safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IBEP20.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "token transfer failed");
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

interface IERC20Like {
    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);

    function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256);
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);
}

interface ICTokenLike {
    function mint(uint256) external returns (uint256);
    function redeem(uint256) external returns (uint256);
    function redeemUnderlying(uint256) external returns (uint256);
    function balanceOfUnderlying(address) external returns (uint256);
    function exchangeRateCurrent() external returns (uint256);
}

interface IUniswapV2Like {
    function swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256, uint256, address[] calldata, address, uint256) external returns (uint256[] memory);
    function swapTokensForExactTokens(uint256, uint256, address[] calldata, address, uint256) external returns (uint256[] memory);
    function swapExactETHForTokens(uint256, address[] calldata, address, uint256) external payable returns (uint256[] memory);
    function swapETHForExactTokens(uint256, address[] calldata, address, uint256) external payable returns (uint256[] memory);
    function swapExactTokensForETH(uint256, uint256, address[] calldata, address, uint256) external returns (uint256[] memory);
    function swapTokensForExactETH(uint256, uint256, address[] calldata, address, uint256) external returns (uint256[] memory);
}

interface IDDaiLike {
    function mint(uint256) external returns (uint256);
    function redeem(uint256) external returns (uint256);
}

interface IUniswapV1Like {
    function ethToTokenSwapInput(uint256, uint256) external payable returns (uint256);
    function tokenToEthTransferOutput(uint256, uint256, uint256, address) external returns (uint256);
}

interface IIndestructible {
    function isDestroyed() external view returns (bool);
}

contract DharmaTradeReserveV17 {
    // ---------------- Storage layout ----------------
    address private _owner;                 // slot 0
    address private _newPotentialOwner;     // slot 1
    // slot 2: mapping(uint256 => Role) roles;  Role = { account (160) , paused (8) }
    mapping(uint256 => Role) private _roles;
    address private _primaryDaiRecipient;   // slot 3
    address private _primaryUSDCRecipient;  // slot 4
    uint256 private _daiLimit;              // slot 5
    uint256 private _etherLimit;            // slot 6

    struct Role {
        address account;
        bool paused;
    }

    enum RoleEnum {

        ADJUSTER,             // 1
        WITHDRAWAL_MANAGER,   // 2

    // ---------------- Constants ----------------
    address private constant _DAI = 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F;

    address private constant _CDAI = 0x5d3a536E4D6DbD6114cc1Ead35777bAB948E3643; // placeholder

    address private constant _UNISWAP_USDC_V1 = 0x97deC872013f6B5fB443861090ad931542878126; // placeholder
    address private constant _INDESTRUCTIBLE = 0x0000000000001b84b1cb32787B0D64758d019317; // placeholder
    address private constant _DDAI_HELPER = 0x9328f2Fb3E85A4d24AdC2f68F82737183e85691D; // placeholder
    address private constant _AF84 = 0xaf84687D21736F5e06f738C6F065E88890465E7C; // placeholder
    address private constant _CODE_HASH_HELPER = 0x481b1A16E6675D33f8bBb3a6A58F5a9678649718; // placeholder

    // ---------------- Events ----------------
    event EtherReceived(address sender, uint256 amount);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address previousOwner, address newOwner);
    event RoleModified(uint8 role, address account);
    event RolePaused(uint8 role);
    event RoleUnpaused(uint8 role);
    event Trade(

        address retainedAsset,

        uint256 receivedAmount,
        uint256 retainedAmount

    // ---------------- Modifiers/helpers ----------------
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_isOwner(), "TwoStepOwnable: caller is not the owner.");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOwnerOrRole(uint256 role) {
        if (!_isOwner()) {
            require(_isRole(role), "Caller does not have a required role.");
            require(!_isPaused(role), "Role in question is currently paused.");
        }
        _;
    }

    function _isOwner() internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owner == msg.sender;
    }

    function _isRole(uint256 role) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].account == msg.sender;
    }

    function _isPaused(uint256 role) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].paused;
    }

    // ---------------- Fallback ----------------
    function() external payable {
        emit EtherReceived(msg.sender, msg.value);
    }

    // ---------------- Ownership ----------------
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        _newPotentialOwner = newOwner;
    }

    function cancelOwnershipTransfer() external onlyOwner {
        _newPotentialOwner = address(0);
    }

    function acceptOwnership() external {
        require(msg.sender == _newPotentialOwner, "TwoStepOwnable: current owner must set caller as new potential owner.");
        _newPotentialOwner = address(0);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, msg.sender);
        _owner = msg.sender;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function isOwner() external view returns (bool) {
        return _isOwner();
    }

    // ---------------- Role management ----------------
    function setRole(uint8 role, address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(account != address(0), "Must supply an account.");
        _setRole(role, account);
    }

    function removeRole(uint8 role) external onlyOwner {
        _setRole(role, address(0));
    }

    function _setRole(uint256 role, address account) internal {
        _roles[role].account = account;
        emit RoleModified(uint8(role), account);
    }

    function pause(uint8 role) external onlyOwnerOrRole(uint256(RoleEnum.PAUSER)) {
        Role storage r = _roles[role];
        require(!r.paused, "Role in question is already paused.");
        r.paused = true;
        emit RolePaused(role);
    }

    function unpause(uint8 role) external onlyOwner {
        Role storage r = _roles[role];
        require(r.paused, "Role in question is already unpaused.");
        r.paused = false;
        emit RoleUnpaused(role);
    }

    function isPaused(uint8 role) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isPaused(role);
    }

    function isRole(uint8 role) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isRole(role);
    }

    function getDepositManager() external view returns (address) { return _roles[uint256(RoleEnum.DEPOSIT_MANAGER)].account; }
    function getAdjuster() external view returns (address) { return _roles[uint256(RoleEnum.ADJUSTER)].account; }
    function getWithdrawalManager() external view returns (address) { return _roles[uint256(RoleEnum.WITHDRAWAL_MANAGER)].account; }
    function getReserveTrader() external view returns (address) { return _roles[uint256(RoleEnum.RESERVE_TRADER)].account; }
    function getPauser() external view returns (address) { return _roles[uint256(RoleEnum.PAUSER)].account; }

    function getPrimaryDaiRecipient() external view returns (address) { return _primaryDaiRecipient; }

    function getEtherLimit() external view returns (uint256) { return _etherLimit; }

    function setPrimaryDaiRecipient(address recipient) external onlyOwner {
        _primaryDaiRecipient = recipient;
    }

    function setDaiLimit(uint256 daiLimit) external onlyOwner {
        _daiLimit = daiLimit;
    }

    function setEtherLimit(uint256 etherLimit) external onlyOwner {

    function getVersion() external pure returns (uint256) {

        assembly { impl := mload(add(data, 32)) }
    }

    function getReserves() external view returns (uint256 daiReserves, uint256 dDaiUnderlying, uint256 exchangeRate) {
        daiReserves = IERC20Like(_DAI).balanceOf(address(this));
        dDaiUnderlying = ICTokenLike(_DDAI).balanceOfUnderlying(address(this));
        exchangeRate = ICTokenLike(_DDAI).exchangeRateCurrent();
    }

    // ---------------- Trading (representative implementations) ----------------
    function tradeDaiForEther(
        uint256 daiAmount,
        uint256 quotedEtherAmount,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external onlyOwnerOrRole(uint256(RoleEnum.RESERVE_TRADER)) returns (uint256 totalDaiSold) {
        address[] memory path = _getPath(_DAI, _WETH, false);
        _grantUniswapRouterApprovalIfNecessary(_DAI, daiAmount);
        uint256[] memory amounts = IUniswapV2Like(_UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER).swapTokensForExactETH(

        totalDaiSold = amounts[0];
        emit Trade(msg.sender, _DAI, address(0), address(0), totalDaiSold, quotedEtherAmount, 0);
    }

        address[] memory path = _getPath(_WETH, _DAI, false);
        uint256[] memory amounts = IUniswapV2Like(_UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER).swapExactETHForTokens.value(msg.value)(
            quotedDaiAmount, path, address(this), deadline
        );
        totalDaiBought = amounts[amounts.length - 1];
        _safeTransfer(_DAI, msg.sender, totalDaiBought);
        emit Trade(msg.sender, address(0), _DAI, address(0), msg.value, totalDaiBought, 0);
    }

        address[] memory path = _getPath(_WETH, _DAI, false);

        initiator; amount; smartWallet;

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like(token).transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        require(ok && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "Transfer out failed.");
    }

        if (IERC20Like(token).allowance(address(this), _UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER) < amount) {
            (bool okReset,) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like(token).approve.selector, _UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER, 0));

            (bool okApprove,) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like(token).approve.selector, _UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER, uint256(-1)));
            require(okApprove, "Token approval for Uniswap router failed.");
        }
    }

    function _getPath(address from, address to, bool routeThroughEther) internal pure returns (address[] memory path) {
        uint256 length = routeThroughEther ? 3 : 2;
        path = new address[](length);
        path[0] = from;
        if (routeThroughEther) {
            path[1] = _WETH;
        }
        path[length - 1] = to;
    }

    function _isDharmaSmartWallet(address smartWallet, address adjuster) internal view returns (bool) {
        smartWallet; adjuster;
        return false;
    }
}

        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = tokenIn;
        path[1] = tokenOut;
        uint256[] memory amounts = IUniswapV2Router(SUSHI_ROUTER).swapExactTokensForTokens(amountIn, 1, path, address(this), uint256(-1));
        require(amounts[amounts.length - 1] > 0, "Error Swapping Tokens 2");
        return (amounts[amounts.length - 1], amountIn);
    }

    function _getRevertMsg(bytes memory ret) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (ret.length < 68) return "Transaction reverted silently";
        assembly {
            ret := add(ret, 0x04)
        }
        return abi.decode(ret, (string));
    }
}

            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);

    function pause() external onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) {

    function unpause() external onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) {

    function updateOperatorFilterRegistryAddress(address registry) external {
        if (msg.sender != owner) revert OnlyOwner();

    }

    function revokeOperatorFilterRegistry() external {
        if (msg.sender != owner) revert OnlyOwner();
        require(!isOperatorFilterRegistryRevoked, "Registry revoked");
        isOperatorFilterRegistryRevoked = true;
    }

    // Payment / Withdraw
    // ------------------------------
    function setPaymentRecipient(address recipient) external onlyOwner {
        paymentRecipient = recipient;
    }

        uint256 bal = address(this).balance;

    // Blacklists
    // ------------------------------
    function updateBlackListedApprovals(address[] calldata accounts, bool[] calldata flags) external onlyOwner {
        require(accounts.length == flags.length, "Nb addys doesn't match nb bools.");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
            blacklisted_approvals[accounts[i]] = flags[i];
            emit BlacklistUpdate(accounts[i], flags[i]);
        }
    }

    function updateNonReselableTokens(uint256[] calldata ids, bool[] calldata flags) external onlyOwner {
        require(ids.length == flags.length, "Nb addys doesn't match nb bools.");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; ++i) {
            non_resalable_tokens[ids[i]] = flags[i];
            emit NonReselableTokenUpdate(ids[i], flags[i]);
        }
    }

    function lockTokenMinting(uint256 tokenId) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) {
        tokensLockedMinting[tokenId] = true;
    }

    // ------------------------------
    // ERC165
    // ------------------------------
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 iid) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            iid == 0x01ffc9a7 || // ERC165
            iid == 0xd9b67a26 || // ERC1155
            iid == 0x0e89341c || // ERC1155 metadata URI
            iid == 0x2a55205a || // ERC2981
            iid == 0x5a05180f;   // AccessControlEnumerable

    // ------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ------------------------------
    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) { digits++; temp /= 10; }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    // ============ Simple views ============
    function isCToken() external pure returns (bool) { return true; }
