    function getAllMarkets() public view returns (address[] memory) { return allMarkets; }
    function getAssetsIn(address account) public view returns (address[] memory) { return _accountAssets[account]; }
    function accountAssets(address account, uint256 i) public view returns (address) { return _accountAssets[account][i]; }
    function allMarketsLength() public view returns (uint256) { return allMarkets.length; }

    function checkMembership(address account, address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return markets[cToken].accountMembership[account];
    }

    function isCreditAccount(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return creditLimits[account] != 0;
    }

    // ============ Admin setters ============
    function _setPendingImplementation(address newPending) public {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin");
        pendingComptrollerImplementation = newPending;
    }

    function _become(address unitroller) public {
        require(Unitroller(unitroller).admin() == msg.sender, "only unitroller admin can change brains");
        require(Unitroller(unitroller)._acceptImplementation() == 0, "change not authorized");
    }

    function _setPriceOracle(address newOracle) public returns (uint256) {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin can");
        address oldOracle = oracle;
        oracle = newOracle;
        emit NewPriceOracle(oldOracle, newOracle);
        return 0;
    }

    function _setCloseFactor(uint256 newCloseFactorMantissa) public returns (uint256) {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin");
        uint256 oldCloseFactorMantissa = closeFactorMantissa;
        closeFactorMantissa = newCloseFactorMantissa;
        emit NewCloseFactor(oldCloseFactorMantissa, newCloseFactorMantissa);
        return 0;
    }

    function _setLiquidationIncentive(uint256 newIncentive) public returns (uint256) {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin");
        uint256 old = liquidationIncentiveMantissa;
        liquidationIncentiveMantissa = newIncentive;
        emit NewLiquidationIncentive(old, newIncentive);
        return 0;
    }

    function _setPauseGuardian(address newPauseGuardian) public returns (uint256) {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin can");
        address old = pauseGuardian;
        pauseGuardian = newPauseGuardian;
        emit NewPauseGuardian(old, newPauseGuardian);
        return 0;
    }

    function _setBorrowCapGuardian(address newBorrowCapGuardian) public {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin");
        address old = borrowCapGuardian;
        borrowCapGuardian = newBorrowCapGuardian;
        emit NewBorrowCapGuardian(old, newBorrowCapGuardian);
    }

    function _setSupplyCapGuardian(address newSupplyCapGuardian) public {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin");
        address old = supplyCapGuardian;
        supplyCapGuardian = newSupplyCapGuardian;
        emit NewSupplyCapGuardian(old, newSupplyCapGuardian);
    }

    function _setMarketBorrowCaps(address[] memory cTokens, uint256[] memory newBorrowCaps) public {
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == borrowCapGuardian,
            "only admin or borrow cap guardian can set borrow caps");
        require(cTokens.length != 0 && cTokens.length == newBorrowCaps.length, "invalid input");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < cTokens.length; i++) {
            borrowCaps[cTokens[i]] = newBorrowCaps[i];
            emit NewBorrowCap(cTokens[i], newBorrowCaps[i]);
        }
    }

    function _setMarketSupplyCaps(address[] memory cTokens, uint256[] memory newSupplyCaps) public {
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == supplyCapGuardian,
            "only admin or supply cap guardian can set supply cap");
        require(cTokens.length != 0 && cTokens.length == newSupplyCaps.length, "invalid input");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < cTokens.length; i++) {
            supplyCaps[cTokens[i]] = newSupplyCaps[i];
            emit NewSupplyCap(cTokens[i], newSupplyCaps[i]);
        }
    }

    function _setCreditLimit(address protocol, uint256 creditLimit) public {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin can set protocol credit limit");
        creditLimits[protocol] = creditLimit;
        emit CreditLimitChanged(protocol, creditLimit);
    }

    function _setCollateralFactor(address cToken, uint256 newCollateralFactorMantissa) public returns (uint256) {
        if (msg.sender != admin) {
            emit Failure(1, 6, 0);
            return 1;
        }
        Market storage market = markets[cToken];
        if (!market.isListed) {
            emit Failure(9, 7, 0);
            return 9;
        }
        if (newCollateralFactorMantissa > 0.9e18) {
            emit Failure(6, 8, 0);
            return 6;
        }
        if (newCollateralFactorMantissa != 0 && PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cToken) == 0) {
            emit Failure(13, 9, 0);
            return 13;
        }
        uint256 old = market.collateralFactorMantissa;
        market.collateralFactorMantissa = newCollateralFactorMantissa;
        emit NewCollateralFactor(cToken, old, newCollateralFactorMantissa);
        return 0;
    }

    function _supportMarket(address cToken, uint8 version) public returns (uint256) {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin may support market");
        require(!markets[cToken].isListed, "market already listed");
        require(CToken(cToken).isCToken(), "not cToken");
        Market storage m = markets[cToken];
        m.isListed = true;
        m.collateralFactorMantissa = 0;
        m.version = version;
        _addMarketInternal(cToken);
        emit MarketListed(cToken);
        return 0;
    }

    function _addMarketInternal(address cToken) internal {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < allMarkets.length; i++) {
            require(allMarkets[i] != cToken, "market already added");
        }
        allMarkets.push(cToken);
    }

    function _delistMarket(address cToken) public {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin may delist market");
        require(markets[cToken].isListed, "market not listed");
        require(CToken(cToken).totalSupply() == 0, "market not empty");
        CToken(cToken).isCToken();
        delete markets[cToken];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < allMarkets.length; i++) {
            if (allMarkets[i] == cToken) {
                allMarkets[i] = allMarkets[allMarkets.length - 1];
                allMarkets.length--;
                break;
            }
        }
        emit MarketDelisted(cToken);
    }

    function updateCTokenVersion(address cToken, uint8 newVersion) public {
        require(msg.sender == cToken, "sender must be cToken");
        Market storage m = markets[cToken];
        if (m.isListed) {
            uint8 oldVersion = m.version;
            m.version = newVersion;
            emit NewCTokenVersion(cToken, oldVersion, newVersion);
        }
    }

    // ============ Pause functions ============
    function _setTransferPaused(bool state) public returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == pauseGuardian || msg.sender == admin, "only pause guardian and admin can pause");
        require(msg.sender == admin || state, "only admin can unpause");
        transferGuardianPaused = state;
        emit ActionPaused("Transfer", state);
        return state;
    }

    function _setSeizePaused(bool state) public returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == pauseGuardian || msg.sender == admin, "only pause guardian and admin can pause");
        require(msg.sender == admin || state, "only admin can unpause");
        seizeGuardianPaused = state;
        emit ActionPaused("Seize", state);
        return state;
    }

    function _setMintPaused(address cToken, bool state) public returns (bool) {
        require(markets[cToken].isListed, "cannot pause a market that is not listed");
        require(msg.sender == pauseGuardian || msg.sender == admin, "only pause guardian and admin can pause");
        require(msg.sender == admin || state, "only admin can unpause");
        mintGuardianPaused[cToken] = state;
        emit ActionPaused(cToken, "Mint", state);
        return state;
    }

    function _setBorrowPaused(address cToken, bool state) public returns (bool) {
        require(markets[cToken].isListed, "cannot pause a market that is not listed");
        require(msg.sender == pauseGuardian || msg.sender == admin, "only pause guardian and admin can pause");
        require(msg.sender == admin || state, "only admin can unpause");
        borrowGuardianPaused[cToken] = state;
        emit ActionPaused(cToken, "Borrow", state);
        return state;
    }

    // ============ Hooks (simplified) ============
    function mintAllowed(address cToken, address minter, uint256 mintAmount) external returns (uint256) {
        require(!mintGuardianPaused[cToken], "mint is paused");
        require(!isCreditAccount(minter), "credit account cannot mint");
        if (!markets[cToken].isListed) { return 9; }
        mintAmount;
        return 0;
    }

    function mintVerify(address cToken, address minter, uint256 mintAmount, uint256 mintTokens) external {
        cToken; minter; mintAmount; mintTokens;
    }

    function redeemAllowed(address cToken, address redeemer, uint256 redeemTokens) external returns (uint256) {
        if (!markets[cToken].isListed) { return 9; }
        if (!markets[cToken].accountMembership[redeemer]) return 0;
        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(redeemer, cToken, redeemTokens, 0);
        if (err != 0) return err;
        if (shortfall > 0) return 4;
        return 0;
    }

    function redeemVerify(address cToken, address redeemer, uint256 redeemAmount, uint256 redeemTokens) external pure {
        require(redeemTokens != 0 || redeemAmount == 0, "redeemTokens zero");
        cToken; redeemer;
    }

    function borrowAllowed(address cToken, address borrower, uint256 borrowAmount) external returns (uint256) {
        require(!borrowGuardianPaused[cToken], "borrow is paused");
        if (!markets[cToken].isListed) { return 9; }
        if (!markets[cToken].accountMembership[borrower]) {
            require(msg.sender == cToken, "sender must be cToken");
        }
        if (PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cToken) == 0) return 13;
        uint256 cap = borrowCaps[cToken];
        if (cap != 0) {
            uint256 total = CToken(cToken).totalBorrows();
            require(total + borrowAmount < cap, "market borrow cap reached");
        }
        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(borrower, cToken, 0, borrowAmount);
        if (err != 0) return err;
        if (shortfall > 0) return 4;
        return 0;
    }

    function borrowVerify(address cToken, address borrower, uint256 borrowAmount) external {
        cToken; borrower; borrowAmount;
    }

    function repayBorrowAllowed(address cToken, address payer, address borrower, uint256 repayAmount) external returns (uint256) {
        if (!markets[cToken].isListed) return 9;
        cToken; payer; borrower; repayAmount;
        return 0;
    }

    function repayBorrowVerify(address cToken, address payer, address borrower, uint256 repayAmount, uint256 borrowerIndex) external {
        cToken; payer; borrower; repayAmount; borrowerIndex;
    }

    function liquidateBorrowAllowed(
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address cTokenCollateral,
        address liquidator,
        address borrower,
        uint256 repayAmount
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(!isCreditAccount(borrower), "cannot liquidate credit account");
        if (!markets[cTokenBorrowed].isListed || !markets[cTokenCollateral].isListed) return 9;
        uint256 borrowBalance = CToken(cTokenBorrowed).borrowBalanceStored(borrower);
        uint256 maxClose = mulScalarTruncate(closeFactorMantissa, borrowBalance);
        if (repayAmount > maxClose) return 17;
        liquidator;
        return 0;
    }

    function liquidateBorrowVerify(
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address cTokenCollateral,
        address liquidator,
        address borrower,
        uint256 repayAmount,
        uint256 seizeTokens
    ) external {
        cTokenBorrowed; cTokenCollateral; liquidator; borrower; repayAmount; seizeTokens;
    }

    function seizeAllowed(
        address cTokenCollateral,
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address liquidator,
        address borrower,
        uint256 seizeTokens
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(!isCreditAccount(borrower), "cannot seize from credit account");
        if (!markets[cTokenCollateral].isListed || !markets[cTokenBorrowed].isListed) return 9;
        if (CToken(cTokenCollateral).comptroller() != CToken(cTokenBorrowed).comptroller()) return 2;
        liquidator; seizeTokens;
        return 0;
    }

    function seizeVerify(
        address cTokenCollateral,
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address liquidator,
        address borrower,
        uint256 seizeTokens
    ) external {
        cTokenCollateral; cTokenBorrowed; liquidator; borrower; seizeTokens;
    }

        require(!transferGuardianPaused, "transfer is paused");
        require(!isCreditAccount(dst), "cannot transfer to a credit account");
        return this.redeemAllowed(cToken, src, transferTokens);
    }

    function transferVerify(address cToken, address src, address dst, uint256 transferTokens) external {
        cToken; src; dst; transferTokens;
    }

    // ============ Enter / Exit ============
    function enterMarkets(address[] memory cTokens) public returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory results = new uint256[](cTokens.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < cTokens.length; i++) {
            results[i] = addToMarketInternal(cTokens[i], msg.sender);
        }
        return results;
    }

    function addToMarketInternal(address cToken, address borrower) internal returns (uint256) {
        Market storage m = markets[cToken];
        if (!m.isListed) return 9;
        if (m.accountMembership[borrower]) return 0;
        m.accountMembership[borrower] = true;
        _accountAssets[borrower].push(cToken);
        emit MarketEntered(cToken, borrower);
        return 0;
    }

    function exitMarket(address cTokenAddress) external returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 err, uint256 tokensHeld, uint256 amountOwed, ) = _getAccountSnapshotSafe(cTokenAddress, msg.sender);
        require(amountOwed == 0, "nonzero borrow balance");
        if (err != 0) { emit Failure(12, 2, 0); return err; }
        uint256 allowed = this.redeemAllowed(cTokenAddress, msg.sender, tokensHeld);
        if (allowed != 0) { emit Failure(14, 3, allowed); return allowed; }

        Market storage m = markets[cTokenAddress];
        if (!m.accountMembership[msg.sender]) return 0;

        m.accountMembership[msg.sender] = false;

        address[] storage userAssets = _accountAssets[msg.sender];
        uint256 len = userAssets.length;
        uint256 assetIndex = len;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (userAssets[i] == cTokenAddress) { assetIndex = i; break; }
        }
        assert(assetIndex < len);
        userAssets[assetIndex] = userAssets[len - 1];
        userAssets.length--;

        emit MarketExited(cTokenAddress, msg.sender);
        return 0;
    }

    function _getAccountSnapshotSafe(address cToken, address account)
        internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256)
    {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = cToken.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSignature("getAccountSnapshot(address)", account)
        );
        require(success, "getAccountSnapshot failed");
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256));
    }

    // ============ Liquidity ============
    function getAccountLiquidity(address account) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        return getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(account, address(0), 0, 0);
    }

    function getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(
        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        return getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(account, cTokenModify, redeemTokens, borrowAmount);
    }

    function getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(
        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        if (creditLimits[account] != 0) {
            uint256 limit = creditLimits[account];
            (, , uint256 owed, ) = _getAccountSnapshotSafe(cTokenModify, account);
            if (limit >= owed + borrowAmount) return (0, limit - (owed + borrowAmount), 0);
            return (0, 0, (owed + borrowAmount) - limit);
        }
        uint256 sumCollateral = 0;
        uint256 sumBorrowPlus = 0;
        address[] memory assets = _accountAssets[account];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            address asset = assets[i];
            (uint256 err, uint256 tokens, uint256 borrows, uint256 exchange) = _getAccountSnapshotSafe(asset, account);
            if (err != 0) return (15, 0, 0);
            uint256 price = PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(asset);
            if (price == 0) return (13, 0, 0);
            uint256 collFactor = markets[asset].collateralFactorMantissa;
            uint256 tokensToDenom = mul_(mul_(collFactor, exchange) / MANTISSA_ONE, price) / MANTISSA_ONE;
            sumCollateral += mul_(tokensToDenom, tokens) / MANTISSA_ONE;
            sumBorrowPlus += mul_(price, borrows) / MANTISSA_ONE;
            if (asset == cTokenModify) {
                sumBorrowPlus += mul_(tokensToDenom, redeemTokens) / MANTISSA_ONE;
                sumBorrowPlus += mul_(price, borrowAmount) / MANTISSA_ONE;
            }
        }
        if (sumCollateral > sumBorrowPlus) return (0, sumCollateral - sumBorrowPlus, 0);
        return (0, 0, sumBorrowPlus - sumCollateral);
    }

    function liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens(
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address cTokenCollateral,
        uint256 actualRepayAmount
    ) external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 priceBorrowed = PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cTokenBorrowed);
        uint256 priceCollateral = PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cTokenCollateral);
        if (priceBorrowed == 0 || priceCollateral == 0) return (13, 0);
        uint256 exchangeRate = CToken(cTokenCollateral).exchangeRateStored();
        uint256 numerator = mul_(liquidationIncentiveMantissa, priceBorrowed) / MANTISSA_ONE;
        uint256 denominator = mul_(priceCollateral, exchangeRate) / MANTISSA_ONE;
        uint256 ratio = mul_(numerator, MANTISSA_ONE) / denominator;
        uint256 seizeTokens = mul_(ratio, actualRepayAmount) / MANTISSA_ONE;
        return (0, seizeTokens);
    }

    // ============ Math helpers ============
    function mul_(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (a == 0 || b == 0) return 0;
        uint256 c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "multiplication overflow");
        return c;
    }

    function mulScalarTruncate(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return mul_(x, y) / MANTISSA_ONE;
    }
}

    function isApprovedForAll(address o, address op) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[o][op];
    }

    // ---- Transfer ----
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        // omitted onERC721Received check body
        data;
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(!_sbt.sbtEnabled || from == address(0) || to == address(0), "SBT mode Enabled: token transfer while paused");
        address prev = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(prev == from, "TransferFromIncorrectOwner");
        require(to != address(0), "TransferToZeroAddress");
        // simplified transfer bookkeeping
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        _packedAddressData[from] -= 1;
        _packedAddressData[to] += 1;
        _packedOwnerships[tokenId] = uint256(uint160(to)) | (uint256(uint64(block.timestamp)) << 160);
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    // ---- Mint core ----
    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 quantity) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "MintToZeroAddress");
        require(quantity != 0, "MintZeroQuantity");
        uint256 start = _currentIndex;
        _packedAddressData[to] += quantity;
        _packedOwnerships[start] = uint256(uint160(to)) | (uint256(uint64(block.timestamp)) << 160);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            emit Transfer(address(0), to, start + i);
        }
        _currentIndex = start + quantity;
    }

    // ---- Public interface variants ----
    function publicMint(uint256 quantity) external payable nonReentrant {
        require((_saleFlags >> 8) & 1 == 1, "publicMint is not active");
        require(quantity <= maxSupply, "publicMint: Over max mints per wallet");
        require(_psMintedBS[_currentSeason][msg.sender] + quantity <= maxSupply, "publicMint: reached max per user");
        require(msg.value == quantity * psMintPrice, "wrong price");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "publicMint: Caller is contract.");
        _psMintedBS[_currentSeason][msg.sender] += quantity;
        _safeMint(msg.sender, quantity);
    }

    function whitelistMint(
        uint256 wlType,
        uint256 quantity,
        bytes32[] calldata proof0,
        bytes32[] calldata proof1,
        bytes32[] calldata proof2
    ) external payable nonReentrant {
        proof0; proof1; proof2;
        require((_saleFlags & 1) == 1, "wl not enabled");
        // Merkle proofs check omitted for brevity
        if (wlType == 0) {
            _wlMintedBS[_currentSeason][msg.sender] += quantity;
        } else if (wlType == 1) {
            _wlMintedBS1[_currentSeason][msg.sender] += quantity;
        } else {
            _wlMintedBS2[_currentSeason][msg.sender] += quantity;
        }
        _safeMint(msg.sender, quantity);
    }

    function holdAndMint(uint256 quantity, uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external payable nonReentrant {
        require((_saleFlags >> 24) & 1 == 1, "hm not enabled");
        require(quantity <= hmMintPrice, "HoldAndMintSale: over max");
        require(_hmMintedBS[_currentSeason][msg.sender] + quantity <= hmMintPrice, "no HoldAndMintSale left");
        require(msg.value == quantity * hmMintPrice, "price");
        require(_otherContract != address(0), "other contract not set");
        require(otherContractCount != 0, "count 0");
        require(quantity * otherContractCount == tokenIds.length, "amount must be multiple");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            require(IOwnerOf(_otherContract).ownerOf(tokenIds[i]) == msg.sender, "not owner");
            require(!_otherTokenIdUsed[_currentSeason][tokenIds[i]], "used");
            _otherTokenIdUsed[_currentSeason][tokenIds[i]] = true;
        }
        _hmMintedBS[_currentSeason][msg.sender] += quantity;
        _safeMint(msg.sender, quantity);
    }

    function burnAndMint(uint256 quantity, uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external payable nonReentrant {
        require((_saleFlags >> 16) & 1 == 1, "bm not enabled");
        require(quantity <= wlMintPrice1, "BurnAndMintSale: over max");
        require(_bmMintedBS[_currentSeason][msg.sender] + quantity <= wlMintPrice1, "no BurnAndMintSale left");
        require(msg.value == quantity * bmMintPrice, "price");
        require(_otherContract != address(0), "other not set");
        require(otherContractCount != 0, "cnt 0");
        require(quantity * otherContractCount == tokenIds.length, "amount must be multiple");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            require(IOwnerOf(_otherContract).ownerOf(tokenIds[i]) == msg.sender, "not owner");
            IBurnable(_otherContract).burn(tokenIds[i]);
        }
        _bmMintedBS[_currentSeason][msg.sender] += quantity;
        _safeMint(msg.sender, quantity);
    }

    function ownerMint(uint256 quantity, address to) external onlyOwner {
        _safeMint(to, quantity);
    }

    function burn(uint256 tokenId) external {
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(msg.sender == o, "not owner");
        _packedOwnerships[tokenId] |= (1 << 224);
        _burnCounter++;
        emit Transfer(o, address(0), tokenId);
    }

    // ---- Owner setters ----
    function setBaseURI(string calldata uri) external onlyOwner { _baseURIBySeason[_currentSeason] = uri; }
    function setBaseURIBySeason(string calldata uri, uint256 season) external onlyOwner { _baseURIBySeason[season] = uri; }
    function setHiddenBaseURI(string calldata uri) external onlyOwner { _hiddenBaseURIBySeason[_currentSeason] = uri; }
    function setHiddenBaseURIBySeason(string calldata uri, uint256 season) external onlyOwner { _hiddenBaseURIBySeason[season] = uri; }
    function setCustomTokenURI(uint256 tokenId, string calldata uri) external onlyOwner {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "URI query for nonexistent token");
        _customTokenURI[tokenId] = uri;
    }
    function getCustomTokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "URI query for nonexistent token");
        return _customTokenURI[tokenId];
    }

    function setPsPrice(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { psMintPrice = v; }
    function setWlPrice(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { wlMintPrice = v; }
    function setWlPrice1(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { wlMintPrice1 = v; }
    function setWlPrice2(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { wlMintPrice2 = v; }
    function setHmPrice(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { hmMintPrice = v; }
    function setBmPrice(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { bmMintPrice = v; }
    function setPsMaxMints(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { psMintPrice = v; } // legacy alias
    function setHmMaxMints(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { hmMintPrice = v; }
    function setBmMaxMints(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { wlMintPrice1 = v; }
    function setOtherContract(address a) external onlyOwner { _otherContract = a; _rewardContract = a; }
    function setRewardContract(address a) external onlyOwner { _rewardContract = a; }
    function setWithdrawWallet(address a) external onlyOwner { _withdrawWallet = a; }
    function setDefaultRoyalty(address receiver, uint96 fee) external onlyOwner {
        require(fee <= 10000, "royalty > salePrice");
        require(receiver != address(0), "zero receiver");
        _royaltyInfo = uint256(uint160(receiver)) | (uint256(fee) << 160);
    }
    function setOperatorFilteringEnabled(bool v) external onlyOwner { operatorFilteringEnabled = v; }
    function setSBTMode(bool v) external onlyOwner { _sbt.sbtEnabled = v; }
    function setPublicSale(bool v) external onlyOwner {
        if (v) { _saleFlags |= (1 << 8); } else { _saleFlags &= ~(uint256(1) << 8); }
    }
    function setWhitelistSale(bool v) external onlyOwner {
        if (v) { _saleFlags |= 1; } else { _saleFlags &= ~uint256(1); }
    }
    function setHoldAndMintSale(bool v) external onlyOwner {
        if (v) { _saleFlags |= (1 << 24); } else { _saleFlags &= ~(uint256(1) << 24); }
    }
    function setBurnAndMintSale(bool v) external onlyOwner {
        if (v) { _saleFlags |= (1 << 16); } else { _saleFlags &= ~(uint256(1) << 16); }
    }
    function setReveal(bool v) external onlyOwner { _isRevealedBySeason[_currentSeason] = v; }
    function setRevealBySeason(bool v, uint256 s) external onlyOwner { _isRevealedBySeason[s] = v; }
    function setStakingEnable(bool v) external onlyOwner {
        if (v) { _saleFlags |= (1 << 32); _saleStart = block.timestamp; _saleEnd = 0; }
        else   { _saleEnd = block.timestamp; }
    }
    function setMerkleRoot(bytes32 r) external onlyOwner { _merkleRoot = r; }
    function setMerkleRoot1(bytes32 r) external onlyOwner { _merkleRoot1 = r; }
    function setMerkleRoot2(bytes32 r) external onlyOwner { _merkleRoot2 = r; }
    function setMaxSupply(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v >= totalSupply(), "cannot below current supply");
        maxSupply = v;
    }
    function setOtherContractCount(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { otherContractCount = v; }
    function setWlMaxMintsCap(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { psMintPrice = v; } // placeholder
    function resetWlMinted() external onlyOwner {
        _saleFlags &= ~(uint256(0xffffffff));
        _merkleRoot = 0; _merkleRoot1 = 0; _merkleRoot2 = 0;
        _currentSeason++;
        _seasonStartTokenId[_currentSeason] = _currentIndex;
    }
    function incrementSeason() external onlyOwner {
        _saleFlags &= ~(uint256(0xffffffff));
        _merkleRoot = 0; _merkleRoot1 = 0; _merkleRoot2 = 0;
        _currentSeason++;
        _seasonStartTokenId[_currentSeason] = _currentIndex;
    }
    function setContractStatus(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { _saleFlags = v; }
    function setOtherTokenidUsed(uint256 tokenId, bool used) external onlyOwner {
        _otherTokenIdUsed[_currentSeason][tokenId] = used;
    }
    function setOtherTokenidUsedBySeason(uint256 tokenId, bool used, uint256 season) external onlyOwner {
        _otherTokenIdUsed[season][tokenId] = used;
    }

    // ---- Views ----
    function isSBTEnabled() external view returns (bool) { return _sbt.sbtEnabled; }
    function isRevealed() external view returns (bool) { return _isRevealedBySeason[_currentSeason]; }
    function isRevealedBySeason(uint256 s) external view returns (bool) { return _isRevealedBySeason[s]; }
    function isStakingEnabled() external view returns (bool) { return (_saleFlags >> 32) & 1 == 1; }
    function isWlEnabled() external view returns (bool) { return (_saleFlags & 1) == 1; }
    function isPsEnabled() external view returns (bool) { return (_saleFlags >> 8) & 1 == 1; }
    function isBmEnabled() external view returns (bool) { return (_saleFlags >> 16) & 1 == 1; }
    function isHmEnabled() external view returns (bool) { return (_saleFlags >> 24) & 1 == 1; }
    function getSeason() external view returns (uint256) { return _currentSeason; }
    function otherContract() external view returns (address) { return _otherContract; }
    function rewardContract() external view returns (address) { return _rewardContract; }
    function seasonStartTokenId(uint256 s) external view returns (uint256) { return _seasonStartTokenId[s]; }
    function stakingStartTimestamp() external view returns (uint256) { return _saleStart; }
    function stakingEndTimestamp() external view returns (uint256) { return _saleEnd; }
    function contractURI() external view returns (string memory) { return _symbol; }
    function getContractStatus() external view returns (uint256) { return _saleFlags; }

    function psMinted(address a) external view returns (uint256) { return _psMintedBS[_currentSeason][a]; }

    function wlMinted1(address a) external view returns (uint256) { return _wlMintedBS1[_currentSeason][a]; }
    function wlMinted2(address a) external view returns (uint256) { return _wlMintedBS2[_currentSeason][a]; }

    function wlMintedBySeason(address a, uint256 s) external view returns (uint256) { return _wlMintedBS[s][a]; }
    function wlMintedBySeason1(address a, uint256 s) external view returns (uint256) { return _wlMintedBS1[s][a]; }
    function wlMintedBySeason2(address a, uint256 s) external view returns (uint256) { return _wlMintedBS2[s][a]; }
    function bmMintedBySeason(address a, uint256 s) external view returns (uint256) { return _bmMintedBS[s][a]; }
    function hmMintedBySeason(address a, uint256 s) external view returns (uint256) { return _hmMintedBS[s][a]; }
    function getOtherTokenidUsed(uint256 t) external view returns (bool) { return _otherTokenIdUsed[_currentSeason][t]; }
    function getOtherTokenidUsedBySeason(uint256 t, uint256 s) external view returns (bool) { return _otherTokenIdUsed[s][t]; }

    function maxMintsPerPS() external view returns (uint256) { return maxSupply; }
    function maxMintsPerBM() external view returns (uint256) { return wlMintPrice1; }
    function maxMintsPerHM() external view returns (uint256) { return hmMintPrice; }
    function maxMintsCapPerWL() external view returns (uint256) { return wlMintPrice; }

    function walletOfOwner(address user) external view returns (uint256[] memory tokens) {
        uint256 bal = balanceOf(user);
        tokens = new uint256[](bal);
        uint256 idx;
        for (uint256 i = 1; i < _currentIndex && idx < bal; i++) {
            if (_exists(i) && ownerOf(i) == user) {
                tokens[idx++] = i;
            }
        }
    }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256 tokenId, uint256 salePrice) external view returns (address receiver, uint256 amount) {
        uint256 info = _tokenRoyalty[tokenId];
        if (info == 0) info = _royaltyInfo;
        receiver = address(uint160(info));
        amount = (salePrice * uint96(info >> 160)) / 10000;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "URI query for nonexistent token");
        return _customTokenURI[tokenId];
    }

    // ---- ERC4907 (minimal) ----
    struct UserInfo { address user; uint64 expires; }
    function setUser(uint256 tokenId, address user, uint64 expires) external {
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(msg.sender == o || _operatorApprovals[o][msg.sender] || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == msg.sender, "not authorized");
        _userInfo[tokenId] = uint256(uint160(user)) | (uint256(expires) << 160);
        emit UpdateUser(tokenId, user, expires);
    }
    function userOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        uint256 info = _userInfo[tokenId];
        if (block.timestamp > (info >> 160)) return address(0);
        return address(uint160(info));
    }
    function userExpires(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userInfo[tokenId] >> 160;
    }

    // ---- Staking ----
    function toggleStaking(uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            _toggleStake(tokenIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function _toggleStake(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(msg.sender == ownerOf(tokenId), "not owner");
        require(_exists(tokenId), "no token");
        uint256 s = _stakingStart[tokenId];
        if (s == 0) {
            require((_saleFlags >> 32) & 1 == 1, "staking not enabled");
            _stakingStart[tokenId] = block.timestamp;
        } else {
            uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - s;
            _stakingAccum[tokenId] += elapsed;
            _stakingStart[tokenId] = 0;
            _stakingClaim[tokenId] = 0;
        }
    }

    function claimReward(uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            _claim(tokenIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function _claim(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(msg.sender == ownerOf(tokenId), "not owner");
        require(_exists(tokenId), "no token");
        // reward contract call omitted
        _stakingClaim[tokenId] = block.timestamp;
    }

    function getStakingInfo(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (
        uint256 start,
        uint256 accum,
        uint256 claim,
        bool active,
        uint256 total
    ) {
        start = _stakingStart[tokenId];
        accum = _stakingAccum[tokenId];
        claim = _stakingClaim[tokenId];
        active = start != 0;
        total = active ? accum + (block.timestamp - start) : accum;
    }

    // ---- Withdraw ----
    function withdraw() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        (bool ok, ) = payable(0xE99073F2Ba37B44F5cCcf4758B179485F3984D7F).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(ok);
    }

    // ---- Helpers ----
    function hasWhitelistedOneWL(address, uint256, bytes32[] calldata) external pure returns (bool) { return false; }
    function hasWhitelistedOneWL1(address, uint256, bytes32[] calldata) external pure returns (bool) { return false; }
    function hasWhitelistedOneWL2(address, uint256, bytes32[] calldata) external pure returns (bool) { return false; }
    function isWhitelisted(address, uint256, bytes32[] calldata, bytes32[] calldata, bytes32[] calldata) external pure returns (bool) { return false; }
    function getWhitelistedPrice(address, uint256, bytes32[] calldata, bytes32[] calldata, bytes32[] calldata) external view returns (uint256) { return wlMintPrice; }
    function getWhitelistedMaxMints(address, uint256, bytes32[] calldata, bytes32[] calldata, bytes32[] calldata) external view returns (uint256) { return wlMintPrice1; }
    function getSeasonByTokenId(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "Season query for nonexistent token");
        uint256 s = _currentSeason;
        for (; s > 0; s--) {
            if (_seasonStartTokenId[s] <= tokenId) return s;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
    fallback() external payable {}
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.22;

interface IERC20 {
    function balanceOf(address) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address, uint256) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address, address, uint256) external returns (bool);
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
}

interface IPriceFeed {
    function latestRoundData()
        external
        view
        returns (uint80, int256, uint256, uint256, uint80);
}

contract SolaversePresale {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Errors
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    error EnforcedPause();
    error ExpectedPause();
    error ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall();
    error InvalidInitialization();
    error AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(address account, bytes32 role);
    error AccessControlBadConfirmation();
    error SafeTransferFailed();
    error SafeTransferFromFailed();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Constants
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;
    bytes32 public constant OPERATOR_ROLE =
        keccak256("OPERATOR_ROLE");
    bytes32 public constant EMERGENCY_ROLE =
        keccak256("EMERGENCY_ROLE");

    string public constant name = "Solaverse";
    string public constant symbol = "SOLA";
    uint8 public constant decimals = 18;
    uint8 public constant TOKEN_DECIMALS = 18;
    string public constant TOKEN_NAME = "Solaverse";
    string public constant TOKEN_SYMBOL = "SOLA";
    uint256 public constant TOKEN_PRECISION = 1e18;
    uint256 public constant PRICE_PRECISION = 1e8;
    uint256 public constant MAX_PURCHASE_USD = 1e13;
    uint256 public constant MIN_PURCHASE_USD = 500000000; // 5 USD (8 decimals)
    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_DELAY = 3600;
    uint256 public constant TOKEN_HARD_CAP = 1750000000 * 1e18;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Storage
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Slot 0: reentrancy status flag baseline
    // AccessControl roles
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool)) private _roles;
    mapping(bytes32 => bytes32) private _roleAdmins;

    // Reentrancy status (slot 2 in low-level slot but we mirror behavior)
    uint256 private _reentrancyStatus;

    IPriceFeed public priceFeed;      // slot 2
    address public usdtToken;         // slot 3
    address public usdcToken;         // slot 4
    address public protocolWallet;    // slot 5

    uint256 public totalTokensSold;   // slot 6
    uint256 public totalSoldInUSD;    // slot 7

    mapping(address => bool) public blacklisted; // slot 8
    bool public paused;               // slot 9 (bit 0)
    bool public emergencyShutdownActive; // slot 9 upper

    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public userAllocations; // 10
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public stageSold; // 11

    uint256 public currentStage;  // slot 12
    Stage[] public stages;        // slot 13

    string public baseURI;         // slot 14 (uses slot 0x0e)
    uint256 public heartbeat;      // slot 15
    uint256 public priceGracePeriod; // slot 16 (0x10)
    uint256 public rescueLimit;    // slot 17 (0x11)
    uint256 public deploymentTime; // slot 18 (0x12)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Structs
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    struct Stage {
        uint256 tokensForSale;
        uint256 tokensSold;
        uint256 pricePerToken;
        uint256 endTime;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Events
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    event Initialized(uint64 version);
    event Paused(address account);
    event Unpaused(address account);
    event EmergencyShutdown(address account, uint256 time);
    event EmergencyRecovery(address account, uint256 time);
    event EmergencyStop(address account);
    event EmergencyWithdraw(address token, uint256 amount, address to);
    event AddressBlacklisted(address indexed user, bool status);
    event BaseURIUpdated(string uri);
    event ProtocolWalletUpdated(address oldWallet, address newWallet);
    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event TokenPurchased(address indexed token, address indexed buyer, uint256 usdcAmount, uint256 tokens);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Modifiers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    modifier onlyRole(bytes32 role) {
        if (!hasRole(role, msg.sender)) {
            revert AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(msg.sender, role);
        }
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        if (paused) revert EnforcedPause();
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        if (!paused) revert ExpectedPause();
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        if (_reentrancyStatus == 2) revert ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall();
        _reentrancyStatus = 2;
        _;
        _reentrancyStatus = 1;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Initializer (proxy pattern flag on erc-7201 slot)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    bool private _initialized;

    function initialize(
        address _priceFeed,
        address _usdtToken,
        address _usdcToken,
        address _protocolWallet,
        address _dao,
        address _admin
    ) external {
        if (_initialized) revert InvalidInitialization();
        _initialized = true;

        require(_priceFeed != address(0), "Invalid price feed");
        require(_usdtToken != address(0), "Invalid USDC");
        require(_usdcToken != address(0), "Invalid USDT");
        require(_protocolWallet != address(0), "Invalid protocol wallet");
        require(_dao != address(0), "Invalid DAO");
        require(_admin != address(0), "Invalid admin");

        priceFeed = IPriceFeed(_priceFeed);
        usdtToken = _usdtToken;
        usdcToken = _usdcToken;
        protocolWallet = _protocolWallet;

        baseURI = "ipfs://";
        heartbeat = 3600;

        _initializeStages();

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _admin);
        _grantRole(OPERATOR_ROLE, _dao);
        _grantRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE, _admin);

        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    function _initializeStages() internal {
        // Deployment adds ~48 stages internally; simplified for readability.
        stages.push(Stage(1250000, 0, 6000000000000, block.timestamp + 2592000));
        stages.push(Stage(1275000, 0, 6100000000000, block.timestamp + 5184000));
        for (uint256 i = 2; i < 48; i++) {
            stages.push(Stage(1275000, 0, 6100000000000 + i * 100000000000, block.timestamp + 2592000 * (i + 1)));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AccessControl
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role][account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roleAdmins[role];
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account)
        external
        onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role))
    {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account)
        external
        onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role))
    {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address callerConfirmation) external {
        if (callerConfirmation != msg.sender) revert AccessControlBadConfirmation();
        _revokeRole(role, callerConfirmation);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal returns (bool) {
        if (!_roles[role][account]) {
            _roles[role][account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal returns (bool) {
        if (_roles[role][account]) {
            _roles[role][account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x7965db0b || interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Pause / Emergency
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function pause() external onlyRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE) {
        paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() external onlyRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE) {
        paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function emergencyShutdown() external onlyRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE) {
        require(!emergencyShutdownActive, "Already in emergency shutdown");
        emergencyShutdownActive = true;
        emit EmergencyShutdown(msg.sender, block.timestamp);
    }

    function emergencyRecover() external onlyRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE) {
        require(emergencyShutdownActive, "Not in emergency shutdown");
        emergencyShutdownActive = false;
        emit EmergencyRecovery(msg.sender, block.timestamp);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Blacklist
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function isBlacklisted(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return blacklisted[user];
    }

    function blacklistAddress(address user, bool status)
        external
        onlyRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE)
    {
        require(user != address(0), "Invalid address");
        blacklisted[user] = status;
        emit AddressBlacklisted(user, status);
    }

    function blacklistAddress(address user, bool status, uint256 /*duration*/)
        external
        onlyRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE)
    {
        require(user != address(0), "Invalid address");
        blacklisted[user] = status;
        emit AddressBlacklisted(user, status);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Stages / Pricing
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function addStage(uint256 tokensForSale, uint256 pricePerToken, uint256 endTime)
        external
        onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE)
    {
        require(tokensForSale > 0, "Invalid price");
        require(pricePerToken > 0, "Invalid cap");
        require(endTime > block.timestamp, "Invalid end time");
        stages.push(Stage(tokensForSale, 0, pricePerToken, endTime));
    }

    function setCurrentStage(uint256 stage) external onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        require(stage > currentStage, "Can only move forward in stages");
        currentStage = stage;
        emit BaseURIUpdated(""); // topic-only reuse in original
    }

    function getCurrentStageInfo()
        external
        view
        returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256)
    {
        require(stages.length > currentStage, "No active stage");
        Stage memory s = stages[currentStage];
        return (s.tokensForSale, s.tokensSold, s.pricePerToken, s.endTime, currentStage);
    }

    function stages(uint256 idx)
        public
        view
        returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256)
    {
        Stage memory s = stages[idx];
        return (s.tokensForSale, s.tokensSold, s.pricePerToken, s.endTime);
    }

    function getRemainingTokens() external view returns (uint256) {
        require(stages.length > currentStage, "No active stage");
        return stages[currentStage].tokensForSale * 1e18 - stages[currentStage].tokensSold;
    }

    function getLatestPrice() public view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        (, int256 answer, , uint256 updatedAt, uint80 answeredInRound) =
            priceFeed.latestRoundData();
        require(answer > 0, "Invalid price feed answer");
        require(updatedAt > 0, "Round not complete");
        require(answeredInRound >= 0, "Stale price");
        require(block.timestamp - updatedAt <= heartbeat, "Stale price");
        return (uint256(answer), updatedAt);
    }

    function getLatestPriceTimestamp() external view returns (uint256) {
        (, uint256 ts) = getLatestPrice();
        return ts;
    }

    function getEthInUSD(uint256 ethAmount) external view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 price, ) = getLatestPrice();
        return (price * ethAmount) / 1e18;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Deposits
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function depositCoin(address referrer) external payable nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        require(!blacklisted[msg.sender], "Address is blacklisted");
        require(msg.value > 0, "Deposit amount must be > 0");
        require(referrer != msg.sender, "Cannot self refer");

        uint256 tokens = _processPurchase(address(0), msg.sender, msg.value, 0);
        require(tokens > 0, "Invalid purchase amount");

        (bool ok, ) = protocolWallet.call{value: msg.value}("");
        require(ok, "Native token forwarding failed");

        emit TokenPurchased(address(0), msg.sender, msg.value, tokens);
    }

    function depositCoin(address /*token*/, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        require(!blacklisted[msg.sender], "Address is blacklisted");
        require(amount > 0, "Deposit amount must be > 0");

        uint256 tokens = _processPurchase(address(0), msg.sender, amount, 0);
        uint256 lower = (tokens * 98) / 100;
        uint256 upper = (tokens * 102) / 100;
        require(tokens >= lower && tokens <= upper, "Slippage exceeds 2% tolerance");
    }

    function depositUSDT(uint256 amount, address /*referrer*/) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        require(!blacklisted[msg.sender], "Address is blacklisted");
        _processPurchase(usdtToken, msg.sender, amount, 1);
        IERC20(usdtToken).transferFrom(msg.sender, protocolWallet, amount);
        emit TokenPurchased(usdtToken, msg.sender, amount, 0);
    }

    function depositUSDC(uint256 amount, address /*referrer*/) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        require(!blacklisted[msg.sender], "Address is blacklisted");
        _processPurchase(usdcToken, msg.sender, amount, 1);
        IERC20(usdcToken).transferFrom(msg.sender, protocolWallet, amount);
        emit TokenPurchased(usdcToken, msg.sender, amount, 0);
    }

    function _processPurchase(
        address /*paymentToken*/,
        address /*buyer*/,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 /*flag*/
    ) internal returns (uint256 tokensPurchased) {
        require(stages.length > currentStage, "No active stage");
        Stage storage s = stages[currentStage];
        require(block.timestamp < s.endTime, "Sale period for current stage ended");

        uint256 usdValue;
        if (address(0) != address(0)) {
            usdValue = amount;
        } else {
            (uint256 price, ) = getLatestPrice();
            require(block.timestamp - 0 <= heartbeat, "Stale price");
            require(price > 0, "Invalid price feed value");
            usdValue = (price * amount) / 1e18;
        }

        require(usdValue >= MIN_PURCHASE_USD, "Purchase too small");
        require(usdValue <= MAX_PURCHASE_USD, "Purchase too large");
        require(totalTokensSold < TOKEN_HARD_CAP, "Hard cap exceeded");

        _rollStages();
        tokensPurchased = _allocateTokens(msg.sender, usdValue);
        require(tokensPurchased > 0, "Invalid purchase amount");

        totalTokensSold += tokensPurchased;
        totalSoldInUSD += usdValue;
    }

    function _rollStages() internal {
        while (
            stages.length > currentStage &&
            stages[currentStage].endTime < block.timestamp
        ) {
            currentStage++;
        }
    }

    function _allocateTokens(address buyer, uint256 usdValue)
        internal
        returns (uint256 tokens)
    {
        require(buyer != address(0), "Invalid buyer address");
        require(usdValue > 0, "USD value must be positive");
        require(stages.length > currentStage, "No active stage available");

        uint256 remainingUSD = usdValue;
        uint256 stageIdx = currentStage;
        while (remainingUSD > 0 && stageIdx < stages.length) {
            Stage storage s = stages[stageIdx];
            uint256 available = s.tokensForSale - s.tokensSold;
            require(available > 0, "Invalid stage price");
            uint256 stageValue = (s.pricePerToken * available) / 1e18;
            if (remainingUSD >= stageValue) {
                s.tokensSold = s.tokensForSale;
                userAllocations[buyer][address(uint160(stageIdx))] += available;
                stageSold[stageIdx] += available;
                tokens += available;
                remainingUSD -= stageValue;
                stageIdx++;
            } else {
                uint256 t = (remainingUSD * 1e18) / s.pricePerToken;
                if (t > available) t = available;
                s.tokensSold += t;
                userAllocations[buyer][address(uint160(stageIdx))] += t;
                stageSold[stageIdx] += t;
                tokens += t;
                remainingUSD = 0;
            }
        }
        currentStage = stageIdx;
        require(tokens > 0, "Nothing purchased");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // View helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getUserTokenAllocation(address user) external view returns (uint256 total) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < stages.length; i++) {
            total += userAllocations[user][address(uint160(i))];
        }
    }

    function getUserTotalTokens(address user) external view returns (uint256 total) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < stages.length; i++) {
            total += userAllocations[user][address(uint160(i))];
        }
    }

    function stagesOf(address user)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts)
    {
        uint256 count;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < stages.length; i++) {
            if (userAllocations[user][address(uint160(i))] != 0) count++;
        }
        ids = new uint256[](count);
        amounts = new uint256[](count);
        uint256 j;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < stages.length; i++) {
            uint256 a = userAllocations[user][address(uint160(i))];
            if (a != 0) {
                ids[j] = i;
                amounts[j] = a;
                j++;
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Config
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function setBaseURI(string calldata uri) external onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        baseURI = uri;
        emit BaseURIUpdated(uri);
    }

    function tokenURI() external view returns (string memory) {
        return baseURI;
    }

    function updateProtocolWallet(address newWallet) external onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        require(newWallet != address(0), "Invalid wallet address");
        address old = protocolWallet;
        protocolWallet = newWallet;
        emit ProtocolWalletUpdated(old, newWallet);
    }

    function updateTotalSold(uint256 newValue) external onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        if (priceGracePeriod == 0 || priceGracePeriod < block.timestamp) {
            totalTokensSold = newValue;
            priceGracePeriod = 0;
        } else {
            priceGracePeriod = block.timestamp + 3600;
        }
    }

    function rescueFunds(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        if (rescueLimit == 0 || rescueLimit < block.timestamp) {
            if (token == address(0)) {
                require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
                (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");
                require(ok, "Payout: Transfer coin failed");
            } else {
                uint256 bal = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
                require(bal >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
                _safeTransfer(token, msg.sender, amount);
            }
            rescueLimit = 0;
        } else {
            rescueLimit = block.timestamp + 3600;
        }
    }

    function emergencyWithdraw(address token, uint256 amount)
        external
        onlyRole(EMERGENCY_ROLE)
    {
        require(paused || emergencyShutdownActive, "Contract must be paused or shutdown");
        if (token == address(0)) {
            require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
            (bool ok, ) = protocolWallet.call{value: amount}("");
            require(ok, "Native token transfer failed");
        } else {
            uint256 bal = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
            require(bal >= amount, "Insufficient token balance");
            _safeTransfer(token, protocolWallet, amount);
        }
        emit EmergencyWithdraw(token, amount, protocolWallet);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Safe transfer helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        if (!success || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert SafeTransferFailed();
        }
    }
}

    function lastDecay() external view returns (uint256) { return lastDecay_; }

    function totalPrincipalBilled() external view returns (uint256) { return totalPrincipalBilled_; }
    function totalPayoutGiven() external view returns (uint256) { return totalPayoutGiven_; }
    function currentFee() external view returns (uint256) { return 0; }

            iid == 0x7965db0b ||

            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            _roleMembers[role].push(account);

        if (_roles[role].members[account]) {

        delete fees_;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < newTiers.length; i++) {
            require(newFees[i] < 1000000, "Invalid fee");
            if (i > 0) require(newTiers[i] > newTiers[i - 1], "only increasing order");

        uint256 lastClaimTimestamp,

        return (b.payout, b.payoutClaimed, b.vesting, b.vestingTerm, b.vestingStartTimestamp, b.lastClaimTimestamp, b.truePricePaid);

        return bills_[id];
    }

        return ids;
    }

        view
        returns (uint256[] memory)
    {
        uint256 balance = IERC721(billNft_).balanceOf(user);
        uint256[] memory out = new uint256[](end > balance ? balance - start : end - start);
        uint256 c = 0;
        for (uint256 i = start; i < end && i < balance; i++) {
            uint256 id = IERC721(billNft_).tokenOfOwnerByIndex(user, i);
            if (validBillIds_[id]) out[c++] = id;

        return out;
    }

        return issuedBillIds_;
    }

    function userBillIds() external pure returns (uint256[] memory ids) { return ids; }

        return IERC20(payoutToken_).balanceOf(address(this));
    }

        uint256 timeSinceLast = block.timestamp - lastDecay_;
        uint256 decay = (totalDebt_ * timeSinceLast) / terms_.vestingTerm;
        if (decay > totalDebt_) decay = totalDebt_;
        return decay;
    }

        uint256 price = (terms_.controlVariable * debtRatio()) / 1e18;

        return price;
    }

        Bill storage b = bills_[id];

    }

    // Deposit / claim (skeleton)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function deposit(uint256 amount, uint256 maxPrice, address depositor) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (uint256 billId) {
        require(depositor != address(0), "Invalid address");
        require(depositor == msg.sender || msg.sender == tx.origin, "no deposits to other address");

        _decayDebt();
        _updatePayout();
        uint256 price = billPrice();
        require(price <= maxPrice, "Slippage more than max price");

        uint256 payout = payoutFor(amount);
        require(payout >= 10 ** (IERC20(payoutToken_).decimals() - 2), "Bill too small");
        require(payout <= maxPayout(), "Bill too large");

        totalDebt_ += payout;
        require(totalDebt_ <= terms_.maxDebt, "Max capacity reached");

        totalPayoutGiven_ += payout;
        require(totalPayoutGiven_ <= terms_.maxTotalPayout, "Max total payout exceeded");

        totalPrincipalBilled_ += amount;

        IERC20(principalToken_).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        IERC20(principalToken_).approve(customTreasury_, amount);
        ITreasury(customTreasury_).deposit(amount, payout, address(this));

        billId = IBillNft(billNft_).mint(depositor, address(this));
        validBillIds_[billId] = true;

        Bill storage b = bills_[billId];
        b.payout = payout;
        b.vesting = payout;
        b.vestingTerm = terms_.vestingTerm;
        b.vestingStartTimestamp = block.timestamp;
        b.lastClaimTimestamp = block.timestamp;
        b.truePricePaid = price;

        emit BillCreated(amount, payout, block.timestamp + terms_.vestingTerm, price);
        emit BillPriceChanged(billPrice(), debtRatio());
    }

    function claim(uint256 billId) public nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (uint256 amount) {
        Bill storage b = bills_[billId];
        require(validBillIds_[billId], "not a valid bill id");
        address holder = IERC721(billNft_).ownerOf(billId);
        require(msg.sender == holder || claimApprovals_[uint160(holder)][msg.sender], "not approved");
        uint256 vested = IVestingCurve(vestingCurve_).getVestedPayoutAtTime(
            b.payout, b.vestingTerm, b.vestingStartTimestamp, block.timestamp
        );
        amount = vested - b.payoutClaimed;
        require(amount > 0, "nothing to claim");
        b.payoutClaimed += amount;
        b.lastClaimTimestamp = block.timestamp;
        IERC20(payoutToken_).transfer(holder, amount);
        emit BillClaimed(billId, holder, amount, b.payout - b.payoutClaimed);
    }

    function redeem(uint256 billId) external returns (uint256) { return claim(billId); }

    function batchClaim(uint256[] calldata ids) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) claim(ids[i]);
    }

    function batchRedeem(uint256[] calldata ids) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) claim(ids[i]);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Admin utils
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function transferStuckToken(address token, uint256 amt) external onlyOwner returns (bool) {
        return IERC20(token).transfer(_owner, amt);
    }

    function refillPayoutToken(uint256 amount) external {
        require(_hasAdminOrRole(msg.sender), "Caller is not owner or has required role");
        require(amount > 0, "Amount is 0");
        IERC20(payoutToken_).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        emit BillRefilled(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function _decayDebt() internal {
        uint256 decay = debtDecay();
        totalDebt_ = totalDebt_ > decay ? totalDebt_ - decay : 0;
        lastDecay_ = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _updatePayout() internal {
        lastPayoutUpdate_ = block.timestamp;
    }

    // Placeholder initializer to match observed selector
    function initialize(
        address /*owner_*/,
        bytes calldata,
        Terms calldata t,
        bytes calldata,
        address[] calldata
    ) external {
        require(_status == 0, "Initializable: contract is already initialized");
        _status = 1;
        _owner = msg.sender;
        terms_ = t;
        lastDecay_ = block.timestamp;
        emit Initialized(1);
        emit BillInitialized(t, block.timestamp);
    }

    fallback() external {}
    receive() external payable {}
}
